jobs.title: Controls Systems Engineer — Material Handling & Intralogistics
jobs.description: **Step into a day where your code keeps freight moving** -------------------------------------------------------- You start the morning scanning operational dashboards for anomalies across conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, vision systems, and print\-and\-apply equipment. A minor throughput dip pops on a line — you trace it to a PLC routine, adjust logic in RSLogix 5000 for an Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix rack, validate with the site team, and watch KPIs rebound. Before lunch, you review a contractor’s upgrade plan, ensuring licensed installations meet specs and safety codes. An after\-hours alert comes in — you jump on remotely, triage the MHE controls software, and get the system back online fast. That’s impact you can measure in uptime, safety, and operational excellence. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * Champion a safe workplace by adhering to relevant codes, regulations, and company directives for system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot, modify, and optimize material handling control software for PLC/PC controllers, focusing on Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix platforms and RSLogix 5000\. * Serve as the first‑line escalation for controls troubleshooting on‑site and remotely, during and after business hours; respond quickly to emergencies and coordinate assistance as needed. * Inspect equipment to verify operation within design capabilities and client‑specified conditions. * Scope, schedule, and oversee work performed by outside contractors, including proprietary work, licensed installs, upgrades, and inspections of specialized systems. * Engineer process and reliability improvements from concept through network‑wide implementation. * Monitor industrial networks (Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS‑i) and powertrain systems (motor control, servo drives, VFDs) plus electrical distribution. * Track MHE performance metrics and partner with site teams to eliminate electrical issues driving performance gaps. * Communicate proactively with leadership, operations, and maintenance on technical issues, timelines, and production impacts; clearly convey complex topics and expectations. * Lead failure reviews and process analyses; recommend improvements or retraining to prevent recurrence. * Conduct control system assessments to sustain and elevate equipment reliability. * Build strong relationships with the Client and the Operations Maintenance team; perform additional duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree preferred with 2–5 years of relevant experience; equivalent education/experience considered. * Hands‑on exposure to at least two engineering design cycles (specification, component selection, programming). * 2\+ years working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA‑based monitoring/control. * Independent problem solver able to execute general instructions with minimal oversight. * Schedule flexibility to support nights, weekends, holidays, and varied work areas; comfortable being on‑call on weekends as needed. * Physical capability to stoop, stand, walk, climb stairs/ladders, and lift/carry 50 lbs\+. * Skilled at conveying sensitive and complex information, setting performance expectations, and resolving difficult issues. **Preferred** ------------- * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in control systems troubleshooting/programming. * Background supporting diverse conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.). * Exceptional organization and a curious, investigative mindset. * Advanced math skills, including percentages, fractions, and other financial‑related calculations. **Tools \& technologies** ------------------------- * PLC programming and SCADA experience * Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) **Eligibility** --------------- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description: Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported. We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes. ### **Come Build with Us** We're a NYC\-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office\-first company that values in\-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here. ### **The Opportunity** Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life\-saving therapies, and product helps to shape decisions related to which patients we reach next and how soon. As Director of Product, you will lead a team of product managers covering the full platform, reporting directly to the CEO. You will also keep a hand in the work running discovery, writing the spec, making the call — on the bets that matter most. The roadmap here is not handed down. You will decide what we build, in what order, and what we deliberately don't do, in a market where the right answer is rarely obvious and the stakes are patients starting therapy. If you have led product teams inside someone else's operating model and want to define your own, this is the seat. ### **What You'll Build** **A product team that makes its own calls.** You will coach to a standard in weekly one on ones and roadmap reviews, raise the bar on writing and discovery, and give your PMs enough room to be wrong and get better. The goal is a team that can size a bet and defend it without you in the room. **A roadmap the whole company can bet on.** Sales, implementation, and engineering all plan against what product says is coming. You will set the sequencing across a growing customer base, make the tradeoffs between what one strategic client needs and what the platform needs, and say no clearly enough that people trust the yes. Commitments hold, and when they change, everyone knows why in time to act. **Discovery grounded in how patients actually get to therapy.** Our users are the people running patient support programs, field teams, and hub operations. You will get your team in front of them, translate what you hear into product, and build the customer and market fluency that makes our roadmap hard to copy. Strong opinions are welcome here. Strong opinions without customer contact are not. ### **What Makes You Successful** * 10\+ years in product management at a B2B software company, with a track record of shipping products enterprise customers renewed and expanded. * 5\+ years managing product managers. You have hired, coached, and given hard feedback that made someone better. * Proven ownership of a roadmap end to end from customer discovery and strategy through launch and measured outcomes, not just execution against someone else's plan. * Strong technical fluency. You can work through data models, API integrations, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers and hold your own. Coding is not required. Depth is. * Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You can make a call with incomplete information, explain the reasoning, and change course without drama when the evidence shifts. * Exceptional written communication. You think in documents, and your specs make the decision obvious. * Comfortable working directly with senior customer stakeholders, including the conversations nobody wants to have. * Experience building process where none existed, and the restraint to keep it minimal. **Bonus points if you have:** * Worked in health tech, pharma tech, or life sciences, or know patient support programs, hub services, or specialty pharmacy workflows firsthand. * Built products on top of complex data integrations or healthcare interoperability standards. * Shipped LLM\-powered features that customers actually use. * An early product hire who helped a company scale through growth. **Benefits** * 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision) * 401(k) with employer funded match * Unlimited Vacation * Commuter Benefits * Paid parental leave * Catered lunch on Fridays * Wellness stipend * Great Place to Work Certified The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $225,000\- $260,000 plus equity \+ benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description: Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported. We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes. **About Courier Health** ------------------------ Courier Health is a New York City\-based technology company on a mission to improve the patient experience for hundreds of millions of people living with a chronic condition or rare disease. The company develops and delivers the fastest\-growing patient experience solution for the life sciences industry. Companies that choose Courier Health are achieving double\-digit improvements to patient starts, time\-to\-start and ongoing adherence to life\-altering therapies. As host of the invite\-only Patient Innovators Summit and publisher of *The State of Patient\-Centricity in Biopharma* report, Courier Health is backed by leading investors, including Oak HC/FT, Norwest and Work\-Bench. **Come Build with Us** ---------------------- We're a NYC\-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office\-first company that values in\-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Courier Health is at an inflection point. Last year we grew the number of customers and therapies on our platform by over 400% and raised a $50M Series B to go further, faster. Engineering is growing with it, and we're adding three Engineering Managers to lead the teams that build the platform. You'll lead a team of 4\-7 engineers that owns one part of our product: our AI intake agents, core data, integrations, patient services, field access, or workflows. You'll report to a Director of Engineering, partner with a dedicated Product Manager, and own how your team plans, ships, operates, and grows. This is a management role, not a coding seat. We'll judge you by what your team delivers and how much better your engineers get. You'll be technical enough to review a design, unblock an engineer, and work an incident with the team, and experienced enough that none of the people work is new to you. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Delivery others can plan around.** You'll run your team's operating rhythm: sprint planning, estimation, demos, and retros. When a commitment is at risk, you'll know before anyone asks and say so early. You'll work within our product development process of reviewed PRDs and technical designs. **A team that gets better every quarter.** You'll hire for your own team, from sourcing to close. You'll give direct, specific feedback, run reviews against our engineering career ladder, promote people who have earned it, and address performance gaps early and fairly. **Systems patients depend on.** We handle protected health information for enterprise biopharma customers under HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II. Your team owns the reliability of what it ships: testing, observability, on\-call, and incident response. A data error here means a patient doesn't get the call they need. **A real partnership with Product.** You and your PM share the roadmap. You'll bring engineering's view of scope, sequencing, and cost, push back when the quarter holds more roadmap than capacity, and make the trade\-offs explicit. **How AI changes the way we build.** Agentic AI is part of our product and how we work. You'll lead your team's adoption of AI coding tools so that speed and quality rise together, and you'll measure whether they did. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 2\+ years as an engineering manager in your current or most recent role, leading 4\-7 direct reports. * 10\+ years in software engineering overall. You came up as a senior engineer and are still technically credible: you review designs and code, unblock engineers, and join incidents. * You've done the whole people job: hired onto your own team, delivered hard feedback, managed an underperformer, and promoted someone. * You've established a team's rituals, not just inherited them: planning, estimation, retros, and on\-call. * You've shipped end to end with a Product partner and can name the outcomes you moved, with numbers: cycle time, incident rate, delivery predictability. * You talk about failures in terms of what you'd do differently, not who was at fault. * Experience leading teams on production cloud systems. Our stack is TypeScript/Node, React, GraphQL, AWS (largely Serverless), and PostgreSQL. * Based in New York and in our Nomad office 4\+ days per week. **Bonus points if:** * You've worked in healthcare or another regulated environment that handles PHI (HIPAA, SOC 2\) * You've led a team through rapid growth at an early\-stage company * You've shipped LLM\-powered or agentic features to production, or led a team's move to agentic coding tools * You've worked on enterprise B2B products with heavy data integration (APIs, SFTP, HL7, FHIR, EDI) **Benefits** ------------ * 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision) * 401(k) with employer funded match * Unlimited Vacation * Commuter Benefits * Paid parental leave * Catered lunch on Fridays * Wellness stipend **Compensation** ---------------- The annual salary range for the target level for this role is **$210,000 \- $250,000** \+ equity \+ benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, interview performance, and internal equity. *Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.* Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobs.title: Flight Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Flight Systems Engineering and Test** SiFly Aviation · Santa Clara, CA · Onsite · Full\-time At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. **The role** We fly a lot – and are building methodical ways of turning data from flights into evolved control system decisions. You’ll design test flight campaigns for the questions we need to answer and develop instrumentation that produces trustworthy data. You’ll drive and develop dashboards that tell us whether weight, performance, and reliability are moving the right way. You'll also be a large part of how we tune and validate changes to PX4 — configuration and code — and how the resulting data gets back to the engineers who need it. **What you'll do** * Plan and execute test campaigns end to end — objectives, success criteria, test cards, instrumentation, and safety and site coordination. * Choose the right validation modality for each question: simulation, log replay, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, ground test, or flight. Spend flight time on the highest\-value learning. * Tune and test changes to PX4 — parameters, control and estimation tuning, and configuration — and validate them in the air. * Analyze flight logs and telemetry to diagnose issues across firmware, hardware, and companion computers. * Build and maintain test infrastructure: benches, HIL setups, instrumentation, and the data pipelines and dashboards behind them. * Own the progression from bench test, through integrated ground runs, to flight — and the anomaly reports and configuration records that make a campaign reconstructable. * Generate the flight test evidence used in SiFly’s FAA submissions. * Find, build, and share AI\-assisted approaches to this work — log analysis, test data reduction, reporting — and bring the team along with what works. **What we're looking for** * Hands\-on flight test or systems test on real aircraft, manned or unmanned. You build test setups, not just operate them. * You've closed the loop from controls systems or flight data back into autopilot parameters or code, repeatedly, on real equipment. * Estimation and control fundamentals: coordinate frames, Kalman filtering and sensor fusion, PID analysis. * Data analysis and scripting — Python or equivalent — for reducing test data into something people act on. * Comfortable at the aircraft: instrumentation, harnessing, and debugging on the flight line. * Ability to obtain and use FAA Part 107 certification if not already certified. * First\-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies. * This is a hands\-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development. * You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors. **Nice to have** * Existing FAA Part 107 certification and real drone piloting or field\-testing experience. * Flight test instrumentation design — sensors, DAQ, wiring and installation for test. * ROS 2, MAVSDK, Linux companion computers; safety risk management process for flight testing. **Details** * Onsite in Santa Clara, CA. * Small team, high ownership, and real hardware in the building.

jobs.title: Founding Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You are our first sales engineer, and you own the technical sale. You work alongside our AEs as a partner on every deal, from the first demo through the POC to close. You lead technical discovery, run the demo, design the POC, and answer every question about how our gateway product would actually deploy in a customer's environment. The AE owns the commercial side of the deal and you own whether the buyer believes it will work, so you have as much say in how a deal gets won as anyone on it. Depending on the deal's complexity, you may stay involved after the signature: helping get customers live, doing hands\-on advanced setup (e.g., custom MCP servers, middleware), and stepping into support. You are also one of the strongest voices customers have inside Mintive. You'll see a lot of customer environments up close, so you bring what customers need straight to product and engineering, push for it, and speak confidently to the roadmap in front of a technical buyer. We'd rather you tell us what customers actually need than tell customers what they want to hear. As our first sales engineer, you'll help shape how the function grows: the playbooks we run, how we onboard new people onto the team, and the pillars that guide it. We have strong inbound and a team of five AEs who need you on every deal. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You have 4\+ years of experience, ideally as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, presales engineer, solutions architect, or forward\-deployed engineer, and you understand how a technical sale moves from first call to signature. * You have sold complex technical products (e.g., infrastructure, security, dev tools), not apps. * You come from software engineering or a logic\-based field (e.g., CS, math, physics, engineering). That said, your track record matters more than the degree. * You are hands\-on technical. You can build a custom integration, debug a deployment, and get a POC working yourself. * You communicate clearly with engineers and executives in the same meeting, and you can explain why the product matters to the business as well as how it works. * You make the reps around you more effective, and AEs want you on their deals. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. **Bonus** --------- * DevOps background, and you enjoy being customer\-facing. * Experience with MCP or AI agent tooling. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Ownership of the technical sale, and a real say in how the sales engineering function grows. * A front\-row seat to agentic AI, with room for special projects like building internal agents. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to turn ideas into physical parts, and to turn the making of those parts into a repeatable process. Almost nothing we build can be bought, so we need to build our own as one\-off or low\-volume production. You will own that work: design it, build it, test it, scale it. This is a hands\-on lab role with significant breadth: CAD in the morning, soldering in the afternoon, and Python scripting in between. We expect you to use AI coding tools to develop automations and bespoke tools to improve efficiency. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design and iterate mechanical part design in CAD, for example probe housings, mounts, fixtures, enclosures, and lab hardware. * Own our 3D printing: run and maintain the printers, dial in materials and profiles, manage the queue, and keep turnaround measured in hours. * Build the workflow and automation around 3D printing and CNC, for example scripted slicing and job submission, print farm monitoring, CAM setup, revision control, and part tracking. * Develop processes for low\-volume part production, for example mold design and fabrication, casting, potting, bonding, finishing, and the jigs and fixtures those processes need. * Do the work that makes hardware real: fine\-pitch and through\-hole soldering, cable and harness assembly, routing, and careful assembly of delicate parts. * Build and maintain test fixtures and benchtop setups, and keep lab equipment calibrated, organized, and working. * Write Python to glue the shop together: automation, instrument control, data logging, and part and inventory tracking. * Support the team’s everyday hardware needs, for example specifying and ordering equipment, setting up workstations and lab machines, and keeping the shop stocked. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and research team to understand how each part will actually be used. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Working proficiency in CAD: parametric modeling, assemblies, drawings, and design for manufacturing. * Hands\-on 3D printing experience, for example tuning, troubleshooting, and repair, plus the judgment to know when a part should be printed, machined, or molded. * Strong technician skills: comfortable soldering both boards and wire, building clean harnesses, and assembling precision hardware without breaking it. * Demonstrated experience with Python. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to write a real script, for example file handling, an API call, a serial interface, some data wrangling, without it being a project. * Fluent with AI coding tools and comfortable vibe coding your way to working tooling. * A bias toward building, testing, and improving over designing to completion first. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * PCB layout experience, particularly in Altium. * CNC machining experience, for example CAM programming, fixturing, workholding. * IT and lab infrastructure work, for example specifying and ordering computers, installing software, and managing network and lab equipment. * Personal projects, a shop of your own, robotics or FSAE, or other evidence that you build things unprompted. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of the hardware this company runs on, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * A shop you get to build. We buy the equipment and tooling; you decide what we need and how it runs. * Direct collaboration with our imaging scientists and research team, and with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Turn "swap it again" into "vendor redesign / firmware fix / manufacturing escape found." ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own named failure classes across GPU trays/baseboards, NIC/DPU, motherboard/PCIe switch, memory, power, thermal, cables/connectors, and rack\-scale patterns. * Run recurrence analysis and fleet\-wide defect clustering; detect systemic patterns before they become fleet\-scale loss. * Build vendor technical escalation packages with evidence quality that forces action; partner with OEM/ODM/component manufacturers on firmware, bring\-up, and manufacturing escapes through committed CAPA. * Feed findings into RMA policy, spare strategy, and "do not reseat forever" stop\-rules. * Work the FA intake queue on rotation; keep queue age within SLA ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 2\+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably in high\-performance computing or data center environments. * Proven expertise in firmware analysis, hardware specifications review, and release validation. * Strong experience with RMA processes, including filing claims, vendor negotiations, and pushing for resolutions outside standard protocols. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose and prove complex hardware failures, including grey or intermittent issues, using tools, logic analyzers, or diagnostic software. * Familiarity with data center hardware components (e.g., servers, GPUs, networking equipment) and emerging technologies. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to reliability engineering. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including operations technicians. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments. * Knowledge of vendor ecosystems (e.g., NVIDIA, Dell, HP, Supermicro) and supply chain management. * Certifications in hardware engineering or reliability (e.g., CRE, CompTIA Server\+). * Prior work in a fast\-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXSI. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer to own and scale key parts of the models and infrastructure behind our neural decoding pipeline, from raw functional ultrasound acquisition through image reconstruction, preprocessing, and decoding. This role sits at the frontier of two rapidly converging fields: neural decoding and foundation models. Recent work has shown that brain activity can be mapped into the latent spaces of pretrained deep learning models to reconstruct visual perception and continuous language with remarkable fidelity. This has been demonstrated with fMRI, in research settings. Your job is to bring these techniques to functional ultrasound: a modality with superior spatial and temporal resolution, portability, and a path to consumer deployment. This is a hands\-on role with an unusual amount of surface area. You will scope and lead projects from open question to result with a high degree of independence, and help set the technical direction of our decoding work. You will report to our ML/AI Engineering Lead. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, train, and evaluate models across the pipeline: fUSI reconstruction, signal preprocessing, and downstream decoding, and own the results for the components you lead. * Drive the experimental agenda for your area: form and test hypotheses about why a model is not learning, design ablations, and tune architectures, losses, and training schedules, then turn what you find into decisions the team can act on. * Extend models to new data regimes, for example new dimensionalities (2D to 3D volumetric), new probes, and new subjects, and build the preprocessing pipelines needed to normalize that data for training. * Own the training infrastructure: experiment tracking, config management, checkpointing, mixed\-precision and multi\-GPU training, and profiling, built well enough for the rest of the team to rely on. * Define the evaluation strategy: metrics, pre\-launch tests, and regression checks that tell us when a model is actually better. * Debug numerical and performance problems, for example NaNs under mixed precision, silent shape bugs, page\-cache thrashing, dead gradients, and GPU memory ceilings. * Build inference paths for full\-volume reconstruction and low\-latency real\-time decoding. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and neuroscientists to understand where the data comes from and what its artifacts mean, and help shape how future data is collected. * Track the relevant literature in neural operators, neuroimaging, and neural decoding, reproduce the results that matter to our roadmap, and propose where we should go next. * Review code and designs, and help onboard new engineers and interns as the team grows. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A PhD in machine learning, computer science, electrical engineering, computational neuroscience, physics, or a related field; or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of those fields plus 2 to 3 years of experience building and shipping machine learning systems in a research or product setting. * Strong Python and hands\-on PyTorch development (or an equivalent framework such as JAX or TensorFlow). * A track record of independently taking a model from a paper or a prototype to something that trains reliably on real data. * Evidence of owning an open\-ended technical problem end to end, such as a thesis, publications, open\-source work, or a shipped system. * Comfort with large numerical datasets, for example hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes, and memory\-mapped arrays. * Solid grounding in first principles, for example linear algebra and signal processing. * GPU proficiency: mixed precision, memory profiling, gradient checkpointing, and the ability to diagnose bottlenecks. * Strong software engineering practices: version control, testing, code review, and coding conventions. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * Experience with neural operators (FNO), implicit neural representations, or physics\-informed machine learning architectures. * Exposure to neural decoding, brain\-computer interfaces, or neuroimaging data. * Familiarity with complex\-valued neural networks or spectral methods. * Experience developing real\-time or low\-latency inference systems. * Distributed or multi\-GPU training at scale. * Publications at machine learning or neuroscience venues, or contributions to open\-source machine learning tooling. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of core technical infrastructure at a seed\-stage company, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * Mentorship from our ML/AI Engineering Lead, and direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Multiple U.S. Locations - Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE) - Electrical - All Levels
jobs.description: **About Us** Apollo is a Mission\-Critical Infrastructure Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations Support Services Company. We serve mission\-critical industries globally with commissioning, emergency response, operations support, and owner's representative services. Apollo is currently executing projects in multiple states in the United States, in Canada and Brazil. We hire the best people who can handle critical systems, love challenges, and thrive in a dynamic environment. We focus on understanding each client's needs and are relentless in meeting them. **Location** Multiple U.S. Locations – Atlanta, GA; Ashburn, VA; Chicago, IL; Phoenix, AZ; Columbus, OH; Portland, OR; Jackson, MS **Job Description** We are seeking skilled and motivated professionals of all experience levels to join our team as Data Center Electrical Commissioning Engineers (CxEs). The Electrical CxE will commission electrical systems in data centers, ensuring they meet top performance and reliability standards. This role requires a deep understanding of mission\-critical environments, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. All newly hired team members entering Apollo’s Commissioning Engineer career path begin in the role of Commissioning Engineer in Training (Cx\-EIT). In this role, team members develop and apply technical commissioning knowledge, engineering judgment, and field experience through structured project execution, mentorship, and progressive responsibility within mission\-critical environments. Cx\-EIT team members actively contribute to project execution activities, including technical reviews, systems evaluations, commissioning documentation development, field inspections, functional testing, issue identification and resolution support, and coordination with project stakeholders. Upon successful demonstration of technical competency, achievement of qualification and performance milestones, and management approval, team members may progress into the role of Electrical Commissioning Engineer. Progression timing may vary based on individual performance, project experience, business needs, and completion of required development objectives. Activities will include but are not limited to testing and/or validation of transformers, electrical switchgear, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units, Static Transfer Switch (STS) units, Power Distribution Units (PDU), electrical distribution equipment, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and Building Management and Automation Systems (BMS). This role involves supporting data center construction/commissioning activities, so working hours may include nights and/or weekends. This is an onsite, client\-facing role that may require approximately 90% or more travel to various client locations. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, equivalent professional experience or experience in a related field (including but not limited to electrical field service technician, data center technician or military). **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct commissioning activities for electrical and EPMS/BMS systems in data centers. * Create and implement detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and checklists for Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems. * Review and evaluate design documents, submittals, and equipment specifications. * Conduct site inspections, functional performance tests, and system verifications. * Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations. * Work closely with project teams, including contractors, engineers, and data center operators, to maintain schedule. * Diagnose and resolve system performance, reliability, and safety issues. * Document results/findings and generate comprehensive commissioning reports. * Maintain open and current communication with the client about the status of the project. * Provide training and support to data center staff on system operation and maintenance. * Ensure adherence to industry standards, codes, and regulations. * Attend project meetings and offer technical expertise. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Demands** The following physical demands must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions: * Frequently manipulating, moving, or grasping small parts, devices, or tools. * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office areas, critical facilities and other environments, including tight and confined spaces. * Exposure to low/high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind. * Working and walking on different types of terrain on active construction sites (e.g., concrete flooring, gravel, unpaved roads). * Frequently ascending and descending stairs and ladders to access equipment. * Occasionally positioning oneself under or over equipment. * Occasionally moving equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in commissioning, designing, or constructing electrical systems, especially in data centers or mission\-critical environments. * Extensive knowledge of electricity systems, medium\-to\-low voltage electrical distribution systems, power generation systems, UPS systems and control systems. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clients. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, specifications and engineering design drawings. * Ability to read and operate electrical test equipment. * Skilled in using commissioning software and tools, including MS Office Suite; Mid\-Level and Experienced\-Level candidates should also be proficient with Procore and CxAlloy. * Ability to travel to different data center locations as needed. **Experience Levels** * **Entry\-Level:** 0\-1 years of experience in commissioning or a related field, with a focus on mission\-critical facilities. * **Mid\-Level:** 2\-5 years of experience with demonstrated project management capabilities and a solid understanding of data center systems. * **Experienced\-Level:** 6\+ years of experience, with extensive knowledge of complex mission\-critical systems and leadership experience. **Prerequisites for Employment** * Successful background check, including pre\-employment drug screening * US citizens, permanent residents or any candidate with eligibility to work in the US **What We Offer** Apollo offers its employees a full benefits package, including: * Health and wellness plans (medical, dental, vision, life, disability) * Flexible spending accounts * Paid time off, holidays, and more * Paid parental leave * 401K plan with immediate match benefits * Employee assistance programs * Tuition reimbursement programs Employee discount programs * Apollo challenges the brightest, most talented, and driven individuals in the industry by providing an environment that embraces initiative, diversity, and achievement. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer supporting women, minorities, veterans and people with disabilities. We participate in the Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program.

jobs.title: Senior Production Site Reliability Engineer (PH)
jobs.description: **About the Role \& Team:** The Walt Disney Company is a global leader in entertainment and technology. Walt’s passion was continuously envisioning new ways to move audiences around the world. A passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that spans animation, theme parks, resorts, and a cruise line, as well as sports, news, movies, and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we continually seek new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. The Disney Kids \& Family (DKF) group oversees the creation, development, and production of live\-action and animated television content for children, teenagers, and families under the Disney brand through the Disney Television Animation studio. This content is aired on the group's various cable channels, such as Disney Channel, Disney Junior, Disney XD, and the Disney\+ streaming platform. DKF develops original series, movies, and other content that align with Disney's family\-friendly brand image and appeal to its target audience. These television properties could include distribution deals, marketing strategies, and brand management. DKF has a strong use of commercial and custom software technologies to create its products. The use of technology, engineering, development techniques, and software is essential to its production operations and workflows. We’re looking for an intellectually curious, business\-savvy, analytical powerhouse to join the Disney Kids \& Family Technology team as a Senior Production Systems Reliability Engineer. In this role, you will develop and support cloud solutions for DKF productions and development. This is a Project Hire role without any guarantee of full time placement. **What You Will Do:** The Senior Production Systems Reliability Engineer (SPSRE) is responsible for automating production application processes in support of the production used by DKF to produce its digital production products. This includes the following: * Architect, deploy, and maintain Unreal Engine and Perforce P4 infrastructure on\-prem and in the cloud, including build, caching (DDC), and version\-control services. * Administer and scale Perforce P4 including depot design, replica/edge/proxy topology, and Helix Code Review, to support distributed animation and virtual\-production teams. * Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for Unreal Engine projects. * Support rendering and pipeline automation for Unreal\-based production animation, including integration with existing render orchestration workflows (e.g., AWS Deadline). * Deliver cloud native (AWS, Azure, GCP) and in\-house infrastructure solutions for a wide range of applications. * Responsible for the architecture, deployment, and support of CI/CD pipelines. * Migrating applications and servers between local and cloud platform deployments. * Manage, configure, and implement tools such as Terraform, Helm, GitLab, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Develop software to automate, monitor, and maintain deployed infrastructure. * Work closely with product developers to ensure new features have proper operational support and maintainability. * Responsible for implementing complex solutions to provide hosting services and platforms to various development teams and working in partnership with the team to help drive the standardization and operational support of infrastructure solutions to support the firm’s infrastructure needs. * Create, build, and deliver new technologies or platforms. This will include consultation, designing, building, and supporting development pipelines, automating infrastructure and operations, creating telemetry for monitoring, engineering high reliability, and reinforcing best practices to secure our company and guest data. * Design and development of front\-end applications as needed for automation and tools. * Work closely with the Software Development group to manage and develop tools for managing and automating hardware and software resources. * Generate reports and statistics for various systems using various analytical tools. * Automate and support physical and virtual environments for web and application servers for both production and development. * Participates in researching, testing and implementing optimized technical solutions for our production technology infrastructure and user base. * Provides 3rd tier, extended support to the Systems Engineering, Support Engineering and Software Development groups. * Performs technical administration functions and other miscellaneous technical special projects as assigned by department management. * Influences the direction of product and service development. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * A minimum of 5 years of experience supporting high\-end graphics workflows. * A minimum of 5 years of experience supporting (advanced troubleshooting and configuration experience) Linux / UNIX, Mac OS, and Microsoft Windows\-based systems in a network environment. * A minimum of 5 years of experience working with network administration utilities. * Experience with Unreal Engine in an animation, live\-action, and/or virtual production environment. * Experience with Perforce P4 at an administrative level (server topology, replication, and Code Review). * Understanding of real\-time / production\-animation workflows and how Unreal integrates with DCC and render pipelines (Maya, Nuke, AWS Deadline). * Strong Linux/Unix/Windows administration background. * Previous work experience in a similar discipline (Cloud Engineer, Automation Engineer, Full Stack Engineer). * Strong experience with scripting and programming languages for Web App Development (Python, PowerShell, React, Reach, Rust, bash, etc.) * Ability to use a wide variety of open\-source technologies. * Cloud management platforms and services (experience with AWS, Azure, and Google GCP). This includes cloud migration strategies. * Experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins, etc.) and containerization/orchestration tools (Docker/Kubernetes). * Experience with Virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V, Docker) automation. * Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or an equivalent product. * Experience with infrastructure as code workflows in Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc. * Experience with MySQL and SQL databases. * Experience with Load Balancers (NginX, F5, AWS types). * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, production\-critical environment. * Knowledge of Active Directory and Identity Management services and their application integration (IDP, SAML, LDAP). * Experience with creative applications: ToonBoom, Maya, and Nuke are a plus. * Knowledge of pipeline automation and rendering with AWS Deadline. * Able to communicate technical information effectively, both written and verbally. * Must have a strong customer service orientation and have the ability to work with a diverse user community. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent work experience required. About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: media networks, parks and resorts, studio entertainment, consumer products and interactive media. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world\-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. **The Walt Disney Company is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This position is based in Glendale, CA. The hiring range/pay rate for the Senior Production Site Reliability Engineer is $144\.100 \- 193,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.description: **ABOUT PROMPT.IO Inc.** Prompt.io Inc. is the winning and influence engine partnered with organizations of all size and scale to engage and activate supporters. Prompt.io Inc. is a non\-partisan company and we work with customers of all political stripes. We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission\-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting, and engagement tools. We're a growing tech company where individual contributions can have an outsized impact. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, and are excited to help build what comes next. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Prompt.io Inc. is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale the technology that powers our platform. You'll take ownership of complex technical work, contribute to architecture and technical decisions, and partner closely with Product to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. We're looking for an experienced engineer with strong technical judgment who can take a problem from concept through production, navigate complex systems, and help raise the quality of the engineering team. You'll have meaningful influence over how we build while remaining hands\-on in the code. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, build, test, and maintain scalable applications, services, and APIs. * Own complex technical projects from design and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Contribute to the architecture and technical direction of our SaaS platform. * Collaborate with Product to translate business and product needs into effective technical solutions. * Design and build reusable services, components, and patterns that improve the broader codebase. * Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability, and security challenges. * Work across front\-end, back\-end, and service layers as needed to solve complex problems. * Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs between immediate needs and long\-term maintainability. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive solutions to their root cause. * Provide thoughtful code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing that helps elevate the engineering team. * Contribute to improving engineering standards, practices, and processes. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * 5\-7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating Senior\-level scope and impact. * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science * Significant experience building and maintaining production SaaS or web applications. * Strong experience with Java and modern server\-side application development. * Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern web application development. * Strong experience designing and working with APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. * Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including designing and working with data\-intensive applications. * Experience developing and operating applications in cloud environments. * Strong understanding of application architecture, software design, testing, performance, scalability, security, and data protection. * Experience with Git and modern software development practices. * Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and make sound technical decisions. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a fully remote team. **HOW YOU WORK** * You take ownership of complex problems and see them through from idea to production. * You make thoughtful technical decisions and can clearly communicate the tradeoffs behind them. * You're a creative problem solver who finds practical solutions when challenges arise. * You care about building systems that are reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable. * You balance long\-term technical quality with the need to deliver value to customers. * You provide constructive feedback, share your knowledge, and help make the engineers around you more effective. * You work independently while knowing when collaboration will lead to a better outcome. **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience working in a startup or high\-growth technology environment. * Experience building and scaling SaaS products. * Experience with high\-volume applications, messaging systems, or distributed architectures. * Experience with communications or messaging technology. * Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other engineers. **BENEFITS** **We believe great work starts with supporting great people.** Prompt.io Inc. offers a wide range of benefits, including a 401(k) match, health benefits for you and your family, unlimited flexible time off, philanthropic endeavors, annual team gatherings, professional development opportunities, and more. **COMPENSATION** The salary range for this position is **$125,000–$175,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. **A NOTE TO APPLICANTS** We don't expect every great candidate to check every box. If you're excited about the work and believe you can be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't perfectly match every item above. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** Prompt.io Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada and not require sponsorship of a visa, unless otherwise specified in the posting.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payers, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments, and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== Our Applied AI team is a group of forward deployed engineers (FDEs). They take Concurrence from signed contract to production at our customers, usually across several accounts at once. Each account has its own data, integrations, clinical workflows, and deadlines. This role reports to the Head of Applied AI. Our FDEs are excellent builders. What we need now is someone who makes the whole operation legible. That means knowing at any moment what every FDE is working on, what's at risk, what's blocked and why, and whether we'll hit what we've committed to. This is a hygiene role in the best sense. If work isn't tracked in Linear, we can't plan capacity, judge workloads, measure on\-time delivery, or help people get better at estimating and meeting dates. You'll make Linear the trustworthy source of truth for applied work. You'll do it with the follow\-through, judgment, and technical credibility that make engineers see it as useful rather than bureaucratic. You've been an engineer, and that matters. When an FDE says they're "blocked on platform," you need to know whether that's true. Is it a real platform gap, or applied\-side work that hasn't been done? You need to be able to push back credibly in either direction. Above all, you have *relentless* follow\-through. You don't let things drop, you don't wait to be asked, and you don't stop chasing until it's done. **What you'll own** =================== * **The cross\-account delivery plan.** You'll own the plan across every active deployment: dates, dependencies, FDE capacity, and risk. You're the person who sees conflicts coming two weeks before they hit. * **Linear as the source of truth.** You'll design how Applied AI works in Linear and then hold the team to it. That includes the project structure per account, labels that separate applied blockers from platform blockers, an estimation scale, and a shared definition of done. The result: tickets are current, statuses are honest, and due dates are set and met. * **Accountability on progress.** You'll check in on work before it becomes a surprise. You'll chase updates, surface slips early, and make sure nothing goes quiet. * **Capacity and workload.** You'll know how loaded every FDE really is. That includes the unplanned work that never shows up on a roadmap, like production issues, customer escalations, and safety reviews on live agents. You'll build plans with buffer grounded in real data. * **Fair delivery metrics.** You'll measure on\-time delivery, estimation accuracy, and how early risks get flagged. When something slips, you'll attribute it honestly to customer, platform, or applied causes, so people are judged on what they control. * **The field\-to\-platform loop.** You'll triage blockers between applied and platform, and turn field needs into well\-specified platform tickets. You'll spot patterns across accounts: when three FDEs build the same workaround, that's a platform feature. You'll work with platform leadership on priority and make sure fixes make it back to the account. * **Grounded commitments.** You'll partner with our deployment strategists, who own the day\-to\-day customer relationship, so that the dates we give customers reflect real capacity. * **A lightweight operating rhythm.** Think modern, nimble scrum master, without the dogma. You'l and the interface with platform. * **It isn't ceremony for its own sake.** If a meeting or process isn't producing better decisions, you kill it. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've shipped software as an engineer before moving into program management, and you can still read code, follow a system design discussion, and reason about APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and LLM\-based systems well enough to evaluate a blocker yourself. * You've run delivery as a technical program manager, engineering manager, or delivery lead, including across multiple concurrent teams, customers, or deployments. * You've built a team's execution system from scratch, not just operated one someone else designed. * You're deeply fluent in Linear or a comparable tool, and you've used its API, integrations, or automations to make tracking cheaper for everyone. * You've measured delivery and estimation in a way engineers trusted, and you know how to keep those metrics from being gamed. * You earn engineers' respect rather than their tolerance. You're direct, you ask the uncomfortable question, and people still want you in the room. * You have *relentless* follow\-through. This is the job. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in healthcare or health IT, such as EHR integrations, hospital security reviews, clinical validation cycles, or HIPAA environments * Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or professional services organization * Familiarity with Databricks or other modern data platforms **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $175K \- $230K

But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $175K \- $230K

We're reviewing applications this week. Pay: $85,600\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Memphis
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on campus reliability, you will design what the campus watches and trusts, technically command cross\-discipline SEVs, and build the guardrails that make the next incident smaller. You are the connective tissue across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling. This role demands calm incident leadership, fleet\-scale observability judgment, and the ability to drive reliability work across software and facility boundaries. We are looking for candidates from power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or people who currently work or have worked in facilities like SpaceXSI with power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own monitoring architecture and signal quality: what we alert on, suppress, and trust. Consume NOC noise\-disposition feedback to drive suppression and redesign. Treat alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Provide SEV command support: technical incident leadership, bridge coordination with the NOC, and timeline and severity hygiene. * Run blameless postmortems and drive corrective actions to closed, not filed. * Lead cross\-functional reliability projects spanning compute, network, storage, and facility signal boundaries. * Build and maintain playbooks, run game days, and keep cross\-discipline dependency maps current. Own runbook quality jointly with the NOC (SRE designs; NOC operates and corrects). * Define error budgets and availability objectives at campus and service boundaries as adopted by the business. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response for SEV\-class events in the Memphis / Southaven data center campus. **PROFILE SIGNALS:** * Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or facilities like SpaceXSI — current or prior — spanning power, compute, cooling, or related plant systems. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. Treats alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Cross\-team facilitation and systems engineering depth across software and facility boundaries. **SUCCESS MEASURED BY:** * MTTD / MTTR trend for SEV\-class events * % of SEVs with a blameless postmortem and closed action items * Alert actionable ratio * Recurrence rate of incident classes * Monitoring coverage of critical dependencies across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, plant operations, or large\-scale production operations, preferably in power plants, nuclear power plants, high\-performance computing, or data center environments. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. * Experience working across at least two of: compute, network, storage, power, and cooling / facilities telemetry. * Experience writing and operating playbooks or runbooks with a 24/7 operations, control room, or NOC partner. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Java, Go, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to reliability engineering. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including NOC, data center operations, and infrastructure engineering. **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, or other high\-consequence industrial control environments. * Current or prior work in data centers or facilities like SpaceXSI spanning power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems. * Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments. * Hands\-on definition and use of SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets at service or campus boundaries. * Experience running game days, dependency mapping, and closed\-loop corrective action programs. * Familiarity with data center hardware and plant signals (servers, GPUs, networking, power, cooling) in addition to software telemetry. * Prior work in a fast\-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXSI. ### *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*
