We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on Hardware, you will serve as an expert focused on firmware, hardware specifications, vendor relations, and failure analysis. You will proactively identify and resolve hardware issues, manage RMA processes, and stay ahead of emerging hardware technologies to support SpaceXSI's data center operations. This role demands deep technical expertise in hardware diagnostics, and forward\-looking hardware evaluation. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Analyze firmware packages and hardware specifications for upcoming releases for compatibility, performance, and reliability in SpaceXSI's data center environment. Run security scanning and CVE / vulnerability analysis on firmware and related components. Flag safety issues (electrical, thermal, power\-protection, fail\-safe behavior) before the package hits the floor. * Investigate and diagnose hardware failures, including "grey failures" (ambiguous or intermittent issues), proving them as true hardware defects through rigorous testing and data analysis. * Manage vendor relationships, including initiating RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) claims, negotiating beyond standard processes when necessary, and holding vendors accountable for resolutions. * Collaborate with Data Center Operations Technicians to troubleshoot, repair, and optimize hardware systems in real\-time. * Develop and implement monitoring tools, scripts, and processes to detect hardware anomalies early and minimize downtime. * Document failure modes, RCAs, AFR / reliability models, RMA outcomes, and hardware evaluations into a team knowledge base. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response for hardware\-related issues in the Memphis data center ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 2\+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably in high\-performance computing or data center environments. * Proven expertise in firmware analysis, hardware specifications review, and release validation. * Strong experience with RMA processes, including filing claims, vendor negotiations, and pushing for resolutions outside standard protocols. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose and prove complex hardware failures, including grey or intermittent issues, using tools, logic analyzers, or diagnostic software. * Familiarity with data center hardware components (e.g., servers, GPUs, networking equipment) and emerging technologies. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to reliability engineering. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including operations technicians. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments. * Knowledge of vendor ecosystems (e.g., NVIDIA, Dell, HP, Supermicro) and supply chain management. * Certifications in hardware engineering or reliability (e.g., CRE, CompTIA Server\+). * Prior work in a fast\-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXSI. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** ------------- * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

support.### ### **Key Responsibilities (Essential Functions)** * **Backend \& API Development** + Design, build, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs that power BankSocial's products. + Model data, write efficient queries, and improve the performance and reliability of production services. * **Frontend, Web \& Mobile Development** + Build responsive web and mobile features in We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission\-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting and engagement tools. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, and are excited to help build what comes next. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Prompt.io Inc. is looking for a Software Engineer to help build, maintain, and improve the technology that powers our platform. You'll work closely with Product to develop new features, improve existing functionality, and ensure our applications are reliable, scalable, and maintainable. production web applications, services, and APIs. * **Own features and technical projects** from development through deployment and ongoing maintenance. * **Collaborate with Engineering and Product** to scope, design, and deliver new features and improvements. * **Develop and maintain** services and APIs that power our applications. * **Write** clean, reusable, well\-tested, and maintainable code. * **Work across front\-end and back\-end systems** to deliver complete solutions. * **Troubleshoot and resolve** bugs, performance issues, and production problems. * **Contribute to** the performance, scalability, reliability, and security of our applications. * **Participate in** code reviews, technical discussions, and team planning. * **Contribute to** improving our development practices and overall code quality. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating the ability to independently contribute to production software. * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science. * Strong experience developing web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Experience with front\-end frameworks such as React. * Experience with Java or another object\-oriented programming language. * Experience building and consuming APIs and working with service\-based architectures. * Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases. * Familiarity with microservices and cloud\-based applications. * Experience with Git and modern software development practices. * Understanding of software testing, security, performance, and maintainability. * Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot technical problems and deliver solutions. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. **HOW YOU WORK** * You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. * You're a creative problem solver who finds practical solutions when challenges arise. * You care about building quality software that is reliable and maintainable. * You balance attention to detail with getting meaningful work into production. * You communicate clearly and collaborate well with Engineering, Product, and other teams. * You seek feedback, share what you know, and contribute to making the team better. * You work effectively in a fully remote environment and manage your time and priorities well. **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience working in a startup or high\-growth technology environment. * Experience building SaaS products. * Experience with high\-volume applications, APIs, or messaging systems. * Experience with communications or messaging technology. **BENEFITS** **We believe great work starts with supporting great people.** Prompt.io Inc. offers a wide range of benefits, including a 401(k) match, health **What You’ll Do*** Design, develop, test, and implement software applications and technical solutions that address business needs. * Help design, build, and implement Document AI capabilities, contributing to pilots and broader rollout. * Design and develop data solutions involving warehouses, pipelines, integrations, and data shared across enterprise systems. * Work with business stakeholders and end users to understand workflows, pain points, and requirements. * Build, support, and improve solutions from development through production, with growing ownership over time. * Develop and maintain data transformations, integrations, and pipelines using SQL, dbt, Snowflake, APIs, and related tools and concepts. * Build applications and supporting services that bring data, automation, and AI capabilities into practical business workflows. * Identify opportunities to apply Document AI and automation to business workflows. * Contribute to technical design decisions with documentation, code review, source control, deployment practices, monitoring, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis. **What You’ll Bring*** 3–5 years of professional software development experience, with strong hands\-on coding skills and experience delivering production software. * Experience designing, building, and implementing software solutions through production deployment and ongoing improvement. * Experience with Document AI, intelligent document processing, OCR, data warehousing, or closely related technologies. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data. * Experience or familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, data pipelines, data transformation, and data integration. * Experience designing or integrating APIs and connecting applications with systems and data sources. * Experience contributing to a small or collaborative engineering team and delivering solutions from design through implementation. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders or end users to translate needs into effective technical solutions. * Ability to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, evaluate approaches, and move work forward. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical decisions to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic databases. * An iOS or Android smartphone capable of accessing ORC systems. * Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable application\-development technologies. * Experience building AI/ML or LLM\-enabled application features. * Experience in right\-of\-way, utilities, infrastructure, real estate, or professional services. **What Success Looks Like*** Develop a strong understanding of ORC’s business, systems, data, users, and operational workflows. * Contribute to designing and building ORC’s Document AI pilots and supporting their rollout. * Contribute to data warehousing, pipelines, and integration across systems. * Grow into owning technical solutions with increasing independence. * Build trusted relationships with stakeholders and turn their challenges into practical, maintainable software. * Deliver reliable software and data solutions that solve validated problems and are adopted by their users. * Build sound technical judgment about when to build, integrate, or automate. * Contribute to a small engineering team through ownership, clear communication, and hands\-on delivery. **What We Offer** This posting covers a single level. The pay range is $121,479– $140,916\. Every candidate is assessed and evaluated during the hiring process to determine their level based on factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. Your offer will reflect the level that best matches your experience.* Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) with company match, plus disability coverage. * Paid time off, sick time, and paid holidays. * Tuition reimbursement and paid professional development. * ClassPass and Breethe memberships. * Recognition programs and room to grow. Employees must avoid any relationship or activity that might impair, or even appear to impair, their ability to make objective and fair decisions when performing their jobs. To avoid conflicts of interest, employees are prohibited from performing any services for clients or perceived clients during nonworking time that are normally performed by ORC, including the sale of real estate. Employees will spend prolonged periods sitting and performing computer\-based tasks, including typing, data entry, and virtual communication, while also regularly traveling to landowner properties, project sites, and government facilities, some of which may be in rural or remote locations with limited accessibility. Driving is an essential function of the role and may involve extended periods and long\-distance travel. Fieldwork may require walking over uneven terrain, standing, or navigating outdoor environments, with routine exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain, and snow. The role also involves frequent interaction with a diverse range of individuals, including landowners, government officials, and members of the public, requiring the ability to communicate effectively and maintain professionalism across differing personalities and potentially challenging situations. Flexibility in scheduling is necessary to accommodate travel, site access, and stakeholder availability, along with adherence to safety protocols in both office and field settings.### **About O.R. Colan Associates (ORC)** Since 1969, ORC has been a leading ROW service provider for public agencies, utilities, and energy clients, driving responsible infrastructure progress nationwide. With over 400 experts across 30 offices in 18 states, headquartered in Charlotte, N.C., we’re committed to community\-focused solutions.

As a member of the Platform Core team, you will be responsible for the lowest layers of the software stack on the devices setting the pace for how fast we can push the frontier of AI. Our team's software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric. Our mission is to expose the full capability of that hardware — limited only by physics — to the rest of the stack, all while retaining the smallest, most robust footprint possible. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Build and maintain the lean, high\-reliability Linux\-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric. * Write (or rewrite) high\-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware. * Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including: * + Rigorous resolution and root\-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability. + Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management. * Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware – and then bring up our OS and software stack on it. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Hands\-on systems programming experience in C or C\+\+. * Strong operating systems fundamentals (scheduling, memory management, I/O) — you must be able to articulate in extreme detail how a computer works, from the hardware all the way up to high\-level applications. * Understanding of computer networking, both in the host (OS stack) as well as common network devices like switches and routers. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack — transferable experience with another production\-grade kernel is okay, too! * Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more). * Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare\-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware. * Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers — ideally for high\-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency. * Understanding of major peripheral hardware interface standards (Ethernet, PCIe, I2C, SPI, etc.) — you can critically review a schematic, and debug these interfaces if needed. * Experience with product security, OS/system hardening, and secure boot schemes. ### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $180,000 \- $440,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Advantage Design Group** Advantage Design Group, a multimedia production and software development firm, is the largest online orientations producer in North America. Advantage Orientation is the company's cloud\-based solution currently deployed by over 400 higher education institutions in three countries. The platform invites engagement with interactive and media\-rich content, transforming enrollment into an onboarding experience for students and staff. Advantage Design Group provides customized creative and technical services, including content development, branded interface design, video production, advanced programming, and unlimited training. The platform also features a robust administrative panel for managing content and tracking, monitoring, and analyzing user data. **About the Opportunity** We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who wants to stay close to the code and have a real say in how our next platform is designed and built. You'll spend about 70% of your time writing C\# and .NET code and 30% on architecture and design. The work includes multi\-tenancy, data at scale, domain boundaries, messaging, performance, and the long\-term evolution of the platform. You will also work with client technical teams, so you can hear the problems firsthand and build solutions that work across hundreds of organizations. **Why Jacksonville?** Grow your career at Advantage and make coastal Northeast Florida home. Jacksonville offers 22 miles of beaches, the nation's largest urban park system, the St. Johns River and a creative food and arts scene. Florida also has no personal state income tax, which means more of your paycheck stays with you. **What You Do** * Design and build production applications in C\# and .NET. * Help shape the architecture of ADG's next platform, including multi\-tenancy, domain boundaries, messaging, and scalability. * Solve complex SQL Server performance problems and build APIs and client integrations. * Evaluate technical options and explain the tradeoffs behind your recommendations. * Work with client technical teams and contribute to the standards our engineering team uses. **Required Experience** * At least six years of professional C\# and .NET development experience, including current hands\-on production work. * Experience contributing to application or platform architecture. * Strong SQL Server skills and experience building APIs and integrations. * Ability to solve complex technical problems and explain your approach clearly. * Multi\-tenant SaaS applications or Microsoft Azure. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred. In lieu of a degree, candidates with at least six years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, including demonstrated expertise in software architecture and the design and development of scalable platforms, will be considered. **How You Work** The way you work with people matters as much as the technical decisions you make. In this role, we will be expected to: * Explain technical choices clearly to engineers, client teams, and colleagues outside engineering, and listen closely when they see a problem differently. * Look past the initial request to understand what a client needs and how a decision will affect the people using the platform. * Ask good questions, test assumptions, and weigh the long\-term consequences before committing a solution. **Preferred Experience** * Event\-driven systems, messaging, queues, or event buses. * Large\-scale data environments or platform modernization. * Work directly with clients and partners with technical teams. **Compensation and Benefits** The salary is $140,000–$168,000, depending on experience. Benefits include a 401(k) match, profit sharing, health, dental and vision coverage, paid vacation, flex time, gym membership, and company\-funded training. **Work Location** This full\-time role is based in Jacksonville, Florida, and begins onsite so you can work closely with the team while learning about our platform and clients. Once you're established in the role, the schedule moves to hybrid, with two remote days per week. **Interested in Joining Our Team?** Apply Here! (https://advantage\-design\-group.breezy.hr/) Learn more about us at AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://advantagedesigngroup.com/), and explore Welcome.AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://welcome.advantagedesigngroup.com/). *Advantage Design Group® is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Software Engineering
jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** AHEAD is looking for an experienced Principal Engineer to help shape, build, and evolve the platforms that power our business. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. You’ll join an experienced engineering team that builds real products, adopts new tools early, sweats the details, and trades ideas constantly. Our current stack includes Next.js, JavaScript, Golang, dbt, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL. You’ll work across application, service, data, and platform layers, with the autonomy to make a visible impact on important enterprise systems. This is a principal\-level role for someone who can move comfortably between user needs, business outcomes, system architecture, implementation, and production support. We care about the depth of your engineering judgment more than a specific list of languages. Experience with equivalent technologies such as Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or similar is welcome. ### **Building in the Age of AI** AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We are building with an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) first mindset. AI tools and coding agents should accelerate research, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational analysis, while human judgment remains accountable for what ships. We’re looking for engineers who use these tools fluently without trusting them blindly. * Use AI tools and coding agents throughout the development lifecycle to move faster on exploration, scaffolding, refactors, tests, documentation, and research. * Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, data quality, security, reliability, edge cases, and correctness. * Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, guardrails, and workflows that make the whole team more effective. ### **What you'll do** * Own complex initiatives end to end, from understanding the user’s need and business outcome through architecture, delivery, production support, and continuous improvement. * Design and build pragmatic, secure, and scalable solutions across Next.js applications, JavaScript services, Golang services, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, data pipelines, and platform integrations. * Use AI tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery, then review, test, secure, and harden everything you ship. * Engage across the full development lifecycle: problem framing, analysis, design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, observability, debugging, and support. * Lead architecture reviews and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and raise the bar on quality, security, reliability, and maintainability. * Partner directly with product, design, data, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into executable plans. * Identify and reduce technical risk, including fragile integrations, poor data quality, unclear ownership, security gaps, operational blind spots, and unsustainable technical debt. * Mentor engineers, shape the engineering roadmap, and help define how AHEAD builds and operates software. ### **What does the ideal candidate look like?** * 8\+ years building and operating software systems, with 10\+ years preferred and a track record of leading significant work end to end. * Principal\-level engineering judgment. You can simplify complex problems, recognize weak solutions, explain tradeoffs clearly, and make decisions that hold up in production. * An AIDLC\-first mindset and demonstrated fluency with AI development tools or coding agents, paired with the discipline to inspect, test, secure, and own everything you ship. * Strong experience with modern web and service development, especially Next.js, JavaScript or TypeScript, and Golang. * Strong experience with data engineering and relational systems, including dbt, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, schema design, query performance, migrations, data quality, and data integrity. * Stack\-agnostic adaptability. Equivalent experience with Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or other modern languages and frameworks is welcome. * A strong foundation in software architecture and the practices that keep systems reliable, including secure development, automated testing, continuous integration, deployment automation, observability, and containerization. * Clear, direct communication. You can express technical intent precisely to engineers, stakeholders, and the AI tools you work with. * The instincts of a technical leader: you influence through credibility, mentor others, raise the level of the people around you, and help teams deliver with accountability. ### **Why you'll love it here** * Join an experienced team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation, curiosity, and practical engineering judgment are the norm. * Help define how a modern engineering organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle while maintaining a high bar for security, quality, and reliability. * Influence architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy beyond a single project or team. * Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where sustainable, effective work matters. *The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On\-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.* **Why AHEAD:** Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. **USA Employment Benefits include:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * Paid company holidays * Paid time off * Paid parental and caregiver leave * Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details. **Use of AI:** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Notice or contact us at privacy@ahead.com. You may opt\-out of the review or analysis of your application and resume by AI tools by using the General Application. Please include the role you wish to apply for in the Additional Information field. You may also choose to opt\-out of recording and transcription at any time, including after joining an interview. Candidates will not be penalized for choosing to opt\-out. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer
jobs.description: Lead Product Engineer \- Electrical / Mechanical **AirPro Diagnostics \| Jacksonville, FL (On Site)** **Department:** Hardware Product Engineering **Reports To:** Chief Technology Officer **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt **Travel:** Occasional About AirPro AirPro Diagnostics designs, builds, and supports diagnostic and ADAS calibration technology used by collision repair and auto glass professionals. We engineer our own hardware, develop our own software, and manufacture products in our Jacksonville facility. Our engineers work across the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototype through production and field support. The Opportunity We are seeking a hands\-on Lead Product Engineer with strong electrical engineering expertise and broad mechanical design capability. This role will own the development of electromechanical products used daily in automotive repair environments. A primary focus will be leading the transition from aging commercial tablet\-based hardware to a new single\-board\-computer platform with a custom carrier board. You will oversee electronics integration, mechanical design, manufacturing readiness, validation, and continuous product improvement. As our first dedicated hardware engineer, you will help establish engineering standards, influence product architecture, and build future technical teams. Key Responsibilities Electrical \& Electronics * Review and improve schematics, PCB layouts, and carrier board designs. * Design wiring harnesses, power systems, connector interfaces, and sensor integrations. * Build, test, and troubleshoot prototypes using scopes, meters, and diagnostic tools. * Maintain engineering documentation, BOMs, schematics, and revision control. * Support EMI/ESD, thermal, ingress protection, and reliability requirements. Embedded \& Control Systems * Configure and troubleshoot single\-board computers, industrial PCs, sensors, and control systems. * Work with USB, CAN, RS\-232/485, I2C/SPI, Bluetooth, and Wi\-Fi interfaces. * Develop engineering utilities, automation tools, calibration software, and test scripts in Python or C/C\+\+. * Collaborate closely with software and firmware teams. Mechanical \& Product Design * Design enclosures, frames, fixtures, mounts, and adjustable mechanisms using 3D CAD. * Create production drawings with appropriate tolerances and GD\&T. * Prototype and iterate designs using in\-house equipment. * Own critical alignment and accuracy requirements related to ADAS calibration systems. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI\-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production\-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end\-to\-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI\-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel. Build production AI applications. Design and develop production\-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost. Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations. jobs.title: Data Science Manager, Security Compliance Engineering, Stores Security
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Security is moving from something builders stop for to something that runs quietly inside how they already work: guidance that shows up in their tools as they code, and continuous checks that replace the weeks\-long review queue. Behind that shift is data. Knowing which controls a service actually needs, surfacing where real risk lives across a massive portfolio, whether the guidance we give is accurate enough to trust, and whether any of it is genuinely reducing risk. You'll lead the data science and data engineering team that answers those questions and makes that whole model measurable. Proving efficacy at scale is where you'll have the biggest impact. It's easy to ship guidance, but hard to know it's working: that it's accurate, that builders act on it, that fewer issues reach production because of it. You'll own the data that turns those into answers leaders can act on, and the feedback loop that uses every issue we find to make the guidance smarter so the same problem never recurs. You'll be the leader who gets the craft of data scientists, data engineers, and business intelligence engineers, and can bring them together as one group with a shared direction. You'll set the vision, raise the technical bar, and build the foundations good science depends on: trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. You'll love this role if you enjoy: * Turning security from a gate into a default, and proving with data that the shift actually works. * Finding where risk really lives, using data and models to surface the issues and high\-risk code that matter most before they reach production. * Answering hard measurement questions at scale: is our guidance accurate, are builders acting on it, are fewer issues reaching production? * Working across disciplines, using science, analytics, and engineering together so each makes the others stronger. * Standing up something new: shaping the strategy, culture, and standards for a team ready for its first dedicated data leader. * Growing engineers and scientists and watching them take on bigger scope because of how you invested in them. Key job responsibilities * Set the strategy, roadmap, and technical direction for a combined data science and data engineering team, turning an ambiguous, fast\-moving security mission into clear, prioritized work and partnering with tech and business leadership to shape the vision. * Own how we measure whether embedded security is working: build the metrics, experiments, and analysis that show whether guidance is accurate, whether builders act on it, and whether fewer issues reach production because of it. * Lead the data science behind risk identification and the compounding feedback loop: surface where real risk lives across a large portfolio, scope which controls each service needs, and make sure every issue found feeds back into smarter guidance so the same problem does not recur. * Determine the right mix of science, data engineering, and BI resources, use those disciplines to complement rather than duplicate one another, and lead senior individual contributors credibly across both the science and engineering sides of the team. * Hold the bar on quality and delivery: judge whether outputs are trustworthy and ready to inform decisions or ship, without letting work be under\-scoped or over\-engineered, and invest in the data foundation of trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. Own the results and credit the people who deliver them. * Grow the team and manage ambiguity: develop scientists and engineers into bigger scope, support in\-flight discipline transitions, establish the shared standards and data culture that let the team deliver without you, and mitigate risks and escalate with good judgment before they become roadblocks. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of building quantitative solutions as a scientist or science manager experience * 2\+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience * 5\+ years of applying statistical models for large\-scale application and building automated analytical systems experience * PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field * Knowledge of Python or R or other scripting language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in a least one area of Machine Learning (NLP, Regression, Classification, Clustering, or Anomaly Detection) * Experience with fairness in machine learning and artificial intelligence to detect and remove bias in ML/AI systems Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. In addition to providing management and support of Amazon Web Services vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** As a Data Engineer supporting Billing \& Payments Engineering, you'll join the Finance Data Engineering team and build the foundation for accurate, scalable billing and revenue data across Anthropic. You'll work closely with Billing Engineering, Finance and Accounting, as well as Product and other partners, to turn billing and payments data into reliable metrics, reporting and insights. You'll make sure teams have trustworthy data that scales with our growth, and you'll lead your own projects to enable self\-serve insights that help teams make data\-driven decisions. **Responsibilities:** * Partner with Billing Engineering, Finance and Accounting to understand their data and reporting needs, and translate them into technical requirements * Design, build and maintain data models and pipelines in dbt that transform raw billing, usage and payments data into canonical datasets * Own revenue data accuracy and reconciliation, making sure billing, usage and revenue data tie out across systems * Define success metrics for billing systems, and build the data models and monitoring to track them * Set high data integrity standards and SLAs for timely, accurate delivery of billing and revenue data * Share on\-call and data operations responsibilities for Finance Data Engineering pipelines * Build dashboards and self\-serve data products that track core metrics and deliver insights across the company * Champion best practices for dbt, data modeling and SQL * Influence the Billing Engineering roadmap from a data systems perspective * Become an expert in our data models and data architecture **You may be a good fit if you have:** * 5\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer or in a similar role * Expertise in SQL and Python, and in building multi\-step data pipelines with tools like dbt * Experience with workflow orchestration tools like Airflow, and version control with GitHub * Familiarity with billing concepts such as invoicing, payments, credits, refunds and subscriptions, and experience working with data from billing systems * Experience building dashboards and reporting in tools like Hex for multiple cross\-functional teams * A bias for action and urgency, without letting perfect be the enemy of the effective * A full\-stack mindset: you do what it takes to solve a problem end to end, even when it goes beyond the original scope * Comfort with ambiguity, and the initiative to create clarity and keep work moving * A passion for Anthropic's mission of building helpful, honest and harmless AI **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience partnering with billing, finance or accounting teams on revenue metrics and reconciliation * Experience building an analytics or data engineering function from an early stage The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.\  For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary:$320,000\—$405,000 USD**Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:\ **A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:**\ We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.\  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from\ @anthropic.com\ email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit\ anthropic.com/careers\ directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**\ Learn about\ our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Principal System Performance Architect
jobs.description: **Principal System Performance Telemetry Architect** ---------------------------------------------------- Do you want to shape the performance telemetry, profiling? Optimization architecture behind the next generation of AI infrastructure, edge platforms, and physical AI systems? In Arm’s Central Technology Group, we are seeking a highly motivated System Architect to join our diverse technology team covering all aspects of system architecture! This role is ideal for someone deeply interested in performance optimization, profiling methodologies, and system\-level analysis. The successful candidate will help define how performance data is captured, correlated, and consumed from pre\-silicon modeling through silicon bring\-up, debug, validation, deployment, and ongoing platform optimization. You will work closely with power architects, silicon architects, SoC architects, software teams, and tooling teams to ensure future platforms provide the right transparency for performance modeling, power\-performance analysis, workload optimization, and real\-world deployment debugging! **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define the performance telemetry and profiling architecture for next\-generation platforms spanning CPUs, AI accelerators, GPUs, memory systems, interconnects, I/O, networking, storage, and multi\-die/chiplet systems. * Drive architecture guidance, platform specifications, and reference architectures for system\-wide performance observability across Arm\-based infrastructure, edge, and physical AI platforms. * Collaborate with SoC architects, IP architects, platform architects, silicon architects, power architects, and software teams to define performance telemetry requirements and ensure profiling capabilities are designed into future platforms from the outset. * Work closely with power architects, silicon architects, SoC architects, and performance modeling teams to define telemetry requirements that support performance modeling, power\-performance optimization, and architectural tradeoff analysis. * Develop platform\-level performance analysis strategies for heterogeneous systems, including AI infrastructure, edge AI platforms, automotive or robotics\-oriented platforms, composable systems, and multi\-die architectures. * Define how performance data from CPUs, caches, memory controllers, interconnects, accelerators, PCIe/CXL fabrics, networking interfaces, storage, and other system components can be collected, correlated, and consumed. * Translate customer, ecosystem, and software\-tooling requirements into scalable performance telemetry architecture spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, hypervisors, drivers, runtime software, orchestration layers, and developer tools. * Define standardized performance telemetry models supporting workload characterization, utilization analysis, latency and bandwidth analysis, power\-performance tradeoffs, bottleneck detection, and system optimization. * Work with profiling and performance tools teams to ensure Arm platforms expose the right architectural hooks for effective use by tools such as Linux perf, Performance Studio, and other industry\-standard analysis environments. * Participate in silicon bring\-up, silicon debug, performance validation, and platform deployment activities by helping define the data, tools, and analysis flows needed to diagnose performance issues. * Collaborate with software, firmware, and tools teams to ensure profiling data can be correlated across hardware counters, traces, operating\-system events, runtime behavior, and application\-level workload characteristics. * Validated experience in system architecture, performance engineering, performance analysis, or profiling for sophisticated compute platforms. * Strong interest in performance optimization, workload analysis, bottleneck identification, and system\-level performance tuning. * Understanding of heterogeneous computing systems, including CPUs, accelerators, memory systems, cache hierarchies, system interconnects, I/O, networking, storage, and multi\-die/chiplet architectures. * Hands\-on experience using profiler and performance analysis tools such as NVIDIA Nsight, Intel VTune, Linux perf, Windows Performance Analyzer, Arm Streamline, Arm Performance Studio, or similar tools. * Experience defining or using performance telemetry, hardware performance counters, trace mechanisms, profiling infrastructure, or system observability capabilities. * Familiarity with performance analysis methodologies such as workload characterization, bottleneck analysis, latency analysis, bandwidth analysis, utilization analysis, and power\-performance optimization. * Experience collaborating with silicon architects, power architects, performance modeling teams, software teams, and platform engineers to analyze and optimize system behavior. * Understanding of how performance data is exposed and consumed across hardware, firmware, operating systems, virtualization layers, runtime softw rience with cloud\-scale or fleet\-scale performance observability, capacity planning, workload placement, or infrastructure optimization. * Understanding of platform power management, thermal behavior, RAS, and how these interact with system performance. **Salary Range:** ----------------- $249,900\-$338,100 per year We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process. **Our 10x Mindset** ------------------- At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x\-mindset (opens in new window) **Use of AI in Your Application** --------------------------------- At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI\-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you. **Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations** ---------------------------------------------- At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. jobs.description: **Requisition ID**: 68027 **Title**: Software QA Engineer remote **Salary Range:** **Salary Minimum:** $94,000 **Salary Maximum:** $165,000 *Arthrex is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. Arthrex is actively seeking a Software QA Engineer\-Automation who works directly with the Engineering departments within Arthrex with good critical thinking skills who is eager to learn new technologies. The Software Quality Engineer tests and performs quality analysis of application functionality to ensure that Arthrex business systems meet user requirements, work as intended, and are within quality management limits and standards. Excellent communications and analytical skills, strong technical project management skills will be essential for this position. Join our talented team at a global medical device company focused on Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™.* **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Support complex release projects including various testing activities – test planning; project estimation and scheduling; resource planning, training, and oversight; test development; test execution; defect management; daily/weekly status reporting; and project closure. Apply test methodology, define test strategy and types of testing to be performed, and ensure comprehensive testing is performed on the project to assure the quality of an application’s usability, functionality, security, and performance. Ensure Arthrex SQA standards and processes are followed. Responsible for the entire testing project. * Perform testing assignments including integrations with other systems, performance testing if needed, and migration of data from one database or system to another in large implementation or major release projects. * Work with infrastructure and application development teams to establish and maintain test environments. * Communicate issues identified during testing activities to application development team lead and manager, assist in the triage and resolution, advise on design/architectural solutions, and recommend process/application improvements to management. * Represent SQA on application/project teams and in software development, project planning, and requirement gathering meetings. Attend project status meetings and provide SQA status, work with PM to define SQA tasks and estimates for the project schedule. Complete SQA tasks and meet deadlines, for individual or multiple projects. * Contribute to SQA metrics such as requirements coverage, test case readiness, test execution progress, and defect counts and statistics in SQA test management tool. * Automate test cases using the automated testing framework that is built in C\#. Add automated test cases to the nightly automation run. Ensure test cases are passing daily and log bugs when necessary if failed. **Knowledge:** * Intermediate to Expert level testing skills and possesses partial to solid knowledge of assigned Arthrex business systems. * Understands how to develop test cases, automated scripts, test plan documentation, and test summary reports. * Can perform highly complex technical testing tasks and mentor others. * Full knowledge of industry practices, FDA guidelines and standards **Skills:** * Working knowledge of the Software Development Life cycle and SQA’s role in it through proven explanation of the process. * Solid understanding of programming languages and several technologies including relational databases, SQL and XML/JSON, C\#, Python, Mongo DB a plus. Experience with Selenium, Appium, Jenkins. * Demonstrated ability to document test plans, test cases, test results. * Experience with Jira, Xray or any test management system and Agile practice. * Demonstrate problem solving, organizational, and analytical skills. * High attention to detail and accuracy. * Project management skills with ability to identify urgencies, risks and competing priorities and constraints * Experience provisioning and managing cloud security, identity, and compliance. * Advanced understanding of all application and automation infrastructure processes and interdependencies. **Education/Experience:** * High School diploma or equivalent required. * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred. * Level 2\= 2\+ years relevant Software QA Engineer\-Automation experience required. jobs.title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Description **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, migrates, and transforms customer technology environments across Microsoft, cloud, virtualization, servers, networking, security, and data protection. This is a Professional Services engineering role focused on project delivery and technical execution, from discovery and assessment through solution design, implementation, testing, documentation, and project completion. The Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer works directly with customers, project managers, architects, engineers, and technology vendors to translate business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. The role requires strong technical problem\-solving skills, the ability to independently execute complex implementations, and the ability to communicate technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. The engineer will lead and participate in infrastructure assessments, migrations, upgrades, integrations, and new technology deployments across single\-site and multi\-site environments. Upon completion, the engineer ensures solutions are fully documented, validated, and transitioned to the appropriate customer or operational team. This position reports to the Managing Consultant or designated Service Delivery leadership. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES\- MAY INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING** **INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING** * Design, implement, and migrate customer infrastructure across servers, Microsoft, cloud, virtualization, networking, security, and data protection. * Conduct infrastructure discovery and assessments to identify dependencies, configuration requirements, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement. * Design and implement Microsoft technologies including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Entra ID, and related identity services. * Design and implement Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments, including compute, storage, networking, identity, backup, monitoring, and migration services. * Implement VMware and Hyper\-V environments, including hosts, virtual machines, storage, resource allocation, high availability, and workload migrations. * Configure and troubleshoot networking technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, and firewalls. * Implement security controls across identity, endpoints, servers, networks, cloud, and applications, including MFA, least privilege, endpoint protection, and secure configuration. * Design and implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions using platforms such as Veeam and Cohesity * Troubleshoot complex technical issues encountered during implementations and migrations and perform root\-cause analysis. * Validate implementations against defined technical requirements and project outcomes. **PROFESSIONAL SERVICES \& PROJECT DELIVERY** * Participate in customer discovery, technical assessments, solution design, and project planning. * Translate customer requirements into practical, secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. * Execute installations, migrations, upgrades, integrations, and infrastructure transformations in accordance with project scope. * Work with Project Managers to identify technical dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and implementation timelines. * Coordinate technical activities with customers, architects, engineers, vendors, and third\-party providers. * Communicate technical findings, project status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly and proactively. * Execute implementation, testing, validation, and change activities during scheduled project windows. * Provide knowledge transfer and complete technical documentation for customer and operational handoff. * Contribute to engineering standards, reference architectures, reusable solutions, and delivery methodologies. Other duties as assigned Requirements **MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * 3–5 years of experience in Professional Services, consulting, systems integration, or project\-based engineering. * Strong experience with Microsoft technologies, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID. * Hands\-on experience with Azure and/or hybrid infrastructure. * Experience with VMware and/or Hyper\-V. * Working knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, and firewalls. * Experience with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery technologies. * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and root\-cause analysis skills. * Developing technical designs, implementation plans, testing procedures, rollback plans, and as\-built documentation. * Ability to independently execute technical implementations and manage multiple project priorities. * Strong customer\-facing communication and collaboration skills. **PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Delivering infrastructure projects within a consulting, systems integration, or Professional Services organization. * Conduct infrastructure assessments and developing technical recommendations. * Ability to perform Azure migrations and hybrid infrastructure. * Deploy and implement Veeam, Cohesity or comparable enterprise backup platforms. * Understanding of switches, firewalls, and wireless * Microsoft Entra ID, automation, or other modern infrastructure technologies. * Relevant Microsoft, Azure, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA, or Veeam certifications. **OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Applies structured troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and sound technical judgment across interconnected application, server, cloud, virtualization, network, and security systems. * Communicates clearly and professionally, translates technical concepts for varied audiences, and produces accurate documentation suitable for customers and support teams. * Works effectively with customers, engineers, service desk personnel, project managers, vendors, and application owners in remote, office, data center, and client\-site settings. * Demonstrates ownership, professionalism, attention to detail, continuous learning, and disciplined adherence to security, change management, documentation, and service delivery standards. **TRAVEL:** This role may be performed remotely or in a hybrid capacity based on business needs. Travel to customer offices, data centers, and other project locations may be required for discovery, installation, migration, maintenance, troubleshooting, cutover, or recovery activities. Travel expectations will vary by assignment and customer location. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer, communicate verbally and in writing, participate in virtual and in\-person meetings, and remain stationary for extended periods. The employee may also perform hands\-on work in office, server\-room, and data\-center environments. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach, bend, work near equipment racks and cabling, and lift or move equipment or materials up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job involve normal vision for computer\-based work, equipment identification, cabling, and technical documentation review. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The work environment may be remote, office\-based, client\-site based, or within server rooms and data centers depending on operational and project requirements. The employee may occasionally work during evenings or weekends for planned maintenance or urgent service restoration. The noise level is generally quiet to moderate and may be higher near infrastructure equipment. Salary Description $100,000 \- $115,000 plus bonus eligiblity
