jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The world’s largest law firm won’t be a law firm. Join us in building it.** ============================================================================= August allows law firms to compound their expertise by building an autonomous organization of AI agents that run the firm's knowledge work. We partner closely with our firms and grow alongside them through sharing revenue on our agents and equity in the firms we transform. We believe that in five years, more than 95% of legal work will be concentrated among a select few elite law firms. The firms that get there will be the ones that rebuild how they deliver it. We're partnering with those firms and building the engine they run on to become the biggest legal service provider in the world. We invest in partnerships, not just licenses. We sell finished legal work alongside our firms and take a share of what it earns. This enables them to scale their services and lets us grow along with it. That means we’re chasing the legal services market ($1T), which dwarfs the global legal tech market ($40b). The problem is hard. An engine of agents sits underneath every matter we touch, connected to every step of a lawyer's workflow, in an industry where there is no margin for error. We’re challenged with building the perfectly accurate, infallibly secure, and yet all\-powerful engine for legal work. We're already live with several excellent firms and the early results are better than we expected. Lean team, in person, New York, backed by leading investors, growing fast. Every role at August is a chance to remake an industry while the window is open. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Solutions Engineer, you will work directly with law firms to turn complex legal workflows into working AI solutions. You will embed with clients, understand their processes and technical environment, and own deployments from discovery and prototyping through integration, go\-live, and adoption. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role: you will run working sessions, build and test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help people put AI to work. You should enjoy getting into the technical details as much as explaining what you’ve built to the people who will use it. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Embed with client organizations and run structured discovery across teams and practice groups, mapping workflows, systems, and data flows to identify where AI can have the greatest impact. * Work one\-on\-one with lawyers, paralegals, legal ops staff, and technical stakeholders to translate day\-to\-day pain points into clear requirements and practical solutions. * Build and test lightweight proofs\-of\-concept for document review, form filling, intake, drafting, redlining, and matter management, using APIs, scripts, and workflow automation tools where needed. * Configure AI workflows and connect them to client systems, working with technical teams on integrations, troubleshooting, and validation before rollout. * Run hands\-on demos and training sessions that help users understand how the solutions work and adopt them in their daily practice. * Own the go\-live from kickoff through adoption, coordinating technical resources on both sides and resolving issues as they arise. * Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for client stakeholders, running structured check\-ins and business reviews to understand what’s working and what needs improvement. * Translate findings from deployments into actionable feedback for August’s engineering team, including reproducible issues, integration needs, and opportunities to improve the product. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * Strong technical problem\-solving skills: you can break down an unfamiliar workflow, understand how its systems fit together, and build a practical solution. * Comfort writing lightweight scripts, working with APIs and structured data, and debugging integrations. Experience with Python or JavaScript is especially useful. * Strong product sense: you understand what makes a workflow painful and can translate that understanding into something people actually use. * Business acumen and clear communication: you can earn trust with a managing partner, a legal ops analyst, and a technical stakeholder, and explain complex ideas in straightforward terms. * Natural curiosity and comfort with ambiguity: you ask good questions, investigate beyond the obvious answer, and take ownership when there is no established playbook. * 1–3 years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, software engineering, or a similarly hands\-on technical role. Experience working directly with customers is valuable; a background in law or legal services is a plus. * Familiarity with AI tools, LLM\-powered applications, or workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n is helpful. * Excitement about working in person at our NYC office with a team that values precision, pace, and constant reinvention. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical insurance coverage * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave * Centralized office equipment ordering for all employees * Equinox or Chelsea Piers gym membership * In\-office perks: lunch, dinner, snacks, drinks, and more * Budget for intra\-office travel * Team\-building events * Relocation support to NYC (as needed) **Why Join August** ------------------- * **Founding Impact:** Shape not just your role but the company. * **Uncapped Upside:** Competitive base \+ commission, early equity ownership. * **Top\-tier Team:** Work alongside people who move fast, think clearly, and care deeply. * **Category\-Defining Work:** Help build the first true AI agents for the legal profession. * **Fast Growth:** Scale your career as we scale the company. * **In\-person in NYC:** Collaborative, talent dense and high energy environment * **Global Reach: Our clients span 4 continents and use August in multiple languages and jurisdictions** * **Frontier of Applied AI:** August has access to proprietary data inaccessible to foundation model providers. We build agents to automate all challenging knowledge work. Compensation Range: $100K \- $160K

jobs.title: ML Engineer, Behavior Planning
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are seeking a ML Engineer to join the Behavior Planning Team. This is a high\-impact role where you will sit at the frontier of autonomous vehicle technology. You won't just be applying AI and ML methods; you will be advancing the state\-of\-the\-art for how a self\-driving system reasons about the world, interacts with humans on the road, and masters complex, high\-dimensional decision\-making. **In this role you will** * Define the architecture of our onboard planning models: Develop and deploy large\-scale models trained with Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning that enable the Aurora Driver to navigate complex environments with human\-like fluidity and superhuman safety. * Revolutionize evaluation: Develop powerful offboard critic models that can evaluate driving behavior at scale, identifying subtle nuances in comfort, progress, and safety that traditional heuristics miss. * Build our next\-generation simulation engine: Architect cutting\-edge offboard foundation models that power our simulation engine, creating realistic "world models" to test the Aurora Driver against an infinite variety of edge cases. * Bridge research and production: Reach new frontiers of autonomous driving technology by pushing forward the state\-of\-the\-art, but also deploy your models on real production vehicles that drive on public roads and must meet the highest standards of safety. **Required qualifications** * BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of experience developing state\-of\-the\-art ML models, either in a research or production setting. * Hands\-on experience working on Imitation Learning or Reinforcement Learning applied to physical or simulated agents. * Experience training large models on massive datasets using distributed computing. * Fluency in Python, with a focus on writing high\-performance, maintainable code. * Deep experience with PyTorch (preferred) or another modern ML framework, and a mastery of modern ML architectures including Transformers and Diffusion Models. **Desirable qualifications** * A track record of publications in top\-tier ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CoRL, CVPR, AAAI). * Experience deploying complex ML systems in production environments. * Experience in developing generative models or neural simulators for synthetic data generation. * Fluency with C\+\+, with a focus on writing high\-performance, safe, and maintainable code. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes. As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance. Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors. Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing. **About the Role** ------------------ We're building our first Forward Deployed Engineering team to turn those opportunities into software customers use. You'll be one of the first two engineers shaping the function, with the responsibility to understand a customer's problem, decide what is worth building, and take the solution from an initial idea to a reliable deployment. This is a hands\-on software engineering role. You will write and review code, work through messy data, design integrations and applications, and own how your software behaves after release. You'll also spend time with customers: asking questions, observing workflows, explaining tradeoffs, and testing whether what you've built actually solves the problem. You'll report to our Head of Strategic Accounts and work alongside our account\-facing Solutions Directors, and have a dotted\-line relationship with Engineering. You'll combine direct customer engagement with substantial hands\-on build time. The role is based in New York or San Francisco with 25\-50% travel. **Two paths into the role.** You may have already worked as an FDE or customer\-facing software engineer, with real ownership from discovery through deployment. You may also be a strong software engineer ready for more customer exposure. For that second path, meaningful manufacturing or industrial workflow experience is particularly important. We care more about what you've built and owned than whether you've held the FDE title. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Understand and scope.** Work directly with customer business and technical teams to identify a valuable use case. Turn broad requests into a focused scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a practical delivery plan. Know when existing Axion capabilities are sufficient, when new software is needed, and when a request should be narrowed or declined. * **Build and deploy.** Design and implement the data integrations, business logic, APIs, applications, and AI\-enabled workflows needed for the solution. Deliver usable software iteratively, with tests, clear interfaces, appropriate access controls, and a deployment approach agreed with Engineering. Use AI where it helps; use deterministic software where correctness and repeatability call for it. * **Validate and own.** Reconcile outputs against source data and agreed business rules. Evaluate model behavior when AI is part of the solution. Work with users to validate accuracy, usability, and business value. Monitor deployments, resolve issues, document how the system works, and establish a clear ongoing support model. * **Help the work scale.** Partner with account teams to connect technical delivery to customer adoption and new use cases. Work with Product and Engineering to identify patterns worth reusing, rather than creating a separate product for every customer. Help establish the engineering practices, delivery standards, and working relationships for the FDE team. **What you Bring** ------------------ * **Engineering.** Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of personally shipping and maintaining production software. You can work independently across backend/application logic, data models, APIs, testing, and debugging. You're comfortable reasoning about reliability, permissions, failure cases, and the tradeoffs between a fast first release and a maintainable system. + **Useful experience.** Python and SQL; full\-stack application development with TypeScript/React or comparable tools; enterprise data and API integrations; applied AI or agent workflows with rigorous evaluation; and manufacturing, quality, reliability, supply\-chain, or service operations. You do not need every item on this list. Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated delivery are more important than familiarity with a particular framework. * **Customer ownership.** You enjoy understanding how people work and translating an ambiguous problem into a useful solution. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues, take responsibility for outcomes, and can push back constructively when a request is not the right thing to build. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Battelle delivers when others can’t. We conduct research and development, manage national laboratories, design and manufacture products and deliver critical services for our clients—whether they are a multi\-national corporation, a small start\-up or a government agency. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. **Job Summary** --------------- We are currently seeking an **AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level**. This position is a full\-time opportunity located in **Columbus, Ohio.** Battelle is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level to help improve laboratory efficiency through practical AI, automation, and data solutions. Working alongside scientists, technicians, quality staff, and technology teams, this role will identify repetitive or time\-consuming work and develop tools that simplify laboratory workflows, reduce manual and redundant efforts, improve data quality, and support faster, more consistent operations — while capturing data for use in larger AI and machine learning initiatives. This is a hands\-on learning role. Initial projects may include AI\-assisted data review, sample and inventory tracking, workflow automation, dashboards, laboratory scheduling, document search, and tools that help staff access and use laboratory information more effectively. **Responsibilities** -------------------- As an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level, the selected individual will develop and deploy practical AI and automation solutions that enhance laboratory operations and data quality. Responsibilities may include: * Assist with building practical AI tools, low\-code applications, dashboards, forms, and automated workflows using approved platforms * Help organize and analyze laboratory data to improve sample tracking, inventory, scheduling, instrument utilization, reporting, and turnaround time * Learn and document laboratory workflows to identify bottlenecks, manual steps, and opportunities for AI or automation * Use approved tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Visual Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SharePoint, Python, and SQL * Support integration among laboratory systems, instrument data, spreadsheets, databases, and business applications * Help develop and maintain internal data management systems and electronic notebooks across multiple laboratory environments * Participate in requirements gathering, testing, validation, documentation, training, and end\-user support * Capture and report metrics such as time saved, reduced manual entries, fewer errors, improved data access, and increased user adoption * Follow requirements for cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI, quality, safety, and change control within both internal and client frameworks **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Laboratory Science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Zero to two years of relevant experience, including internships, co\-ops, research, coursework, or significant projects * Interest in applying AI, data, software, or automation to improve laboratory operations * Foundational experience with one or more of the following: Microsoft Power Platform, generative AI tool use and development, Python, SQL, data visualization, workflow automation, or application development * Ability to learn laboratory processes, collaborate with end users, solve practical problems, and communicate clearly * Basic understanding of data quality, testing, documentation, and the responsible use of technology * \[INSERT TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS] * Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of any employment Visa at this time. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Laboratory, research, manufacturing, environmental, healthcare, or other technical operating experience * Exposure to LIMS, electronic laboratory notebooks, scientific instruments, sample tracking, inventory, or quality systems * Experience developing AI\-assisted tools, prompts, workflows, dashboards, or applications through coursework or projects * Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, root\-cause analysis, Git, APIs, or cloud services **Compensation Data** --------------------- Battelle is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is $71,200 – $101,400 per year, in addition to our comprehensive benefits package. A candidate's salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to education, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. Salary ranges may vary based on geographic location and market conditions. **Benefits: Live an Extraordinary Life** We care about your well\-being, not just on the job. Battelle offers comprehensive and competitive benefits to help you live your best life. * **Balance life through a compressed work schedule**: Most of our team follows a flexible, compressed work schedule that allows for every other Friday off—giving you a dedicated day to accomplish things in your personal life without using vacation time. * **Enjoy enhanced work flexibility, including a hybrid arrangement:** You have options for where and when you work. Our Together with Flexibility model allows you to work 60% in\-office and 40% remote, with Monday and Tuesday as common in\-office days, dependent on team and position needs. * **Take time to recharge**: You get paid time off to support work\-life balance and keep motivated. * **Prioritize wellness**: Stay healthy with medical, dental, and vision coverage with wellness incentives and benefits plus a variety of optional supplemental benefits. * **Better together**: Coverage for partners, gender\-affirming care and health support, and family formation support. * **Build your financial future**: Build financial stability with an industry\-leading 401(k) retirement savings plan. For most employees, we put in 5 percent whether you contribute or not, and match your contributions on top of that. * **Advance your education**: Tuition assistance is available to pursue higher education. **A Work Environment Where You Succeed** For brilliant minds in science, technology, engineering and business operations, Battelle is the place to do the greatest good by solving humanity’s most pressing challenges and creating a safer, healthier and more secure world. You will have the opportunity to thrive in a culture that inspires you to: * Apply your talent to challenging and meaningful projects * Receive select funding to pursue ideas in scientific and technological discovery * Partner with world\-class experts in a collaborative environment * Nurture and develop the next generation of scientific leaders * Give back to and improve our communities **Vaccinations \& Safety Protocols** *Battelle may require employees, based on job duties, work location, and/or its clients’ requirements to follow certain safety protocols and to be vaccinated against a variety of viruses, bacteria, and diseases as a condition of employment and continued employment and to provide documentation that they are fully vaccinated. If applicable, Battelle will provide reasonable accommodations based on a qualified disability or medical condition through the Americans with Disabilities Act or the Rehabilitation Act or for a sincerely held religious belief under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (and related state laws).* *Battelle is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment and opportunities for advancement, compensation, training, and growth according to individual merit, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, genetic information, disability, veteran\-status veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Federal, state, or local law. Our goal is for each staff member to have the opportunity to grow to the limits of their abilities and to achieve personal and organizational objectives. We will support positive programs for equal treatment of all staff and full utilization of all qualified employees at all levels within Battelle.* The above statements are intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, activities and skills required of staff members. **No statement herein is intended to imply any authorities to commit Battelle unless special written permission is granted by Battelle's Legal Department.** For more information about our other openings, please visit www.battelle.org/careers

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Baxter Manufacturing, a division of ITW Food Equipment Group, is seeking a Software Engineer to support software and connected\-product development for commercial food equipment. This position serves as the technical lead between Baxter and third\-party software development partners. Responsibilities include defining requirements, coordinating development, testing and validating completed software, troubleshooting field issues, and supporting releases throughout the product lifecycle. The role supports embedded controls, touchscreen interfaces, connected applications, Microsoft Azure cloud services, APIs, databases, and wireless connectivity. Most major software development is performed by external partners; however, the engineer must have sufficient software experience to understand and troubleshoot code, evaluate proposed solutions, and perform smaller software or firmware updates when appropriate. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead assigned software projects from requirements through development, validation, release, and field support. * Translate product, customer, service, and engineering needs into clear software requirements, scopes of work, and acceptance criteria. * Coordinate priorities, schedules, technical issues, defects, and releases with third\-party software developers. * Review proposed solutions and verify completed software meets functional, reliability, usability, and cybersecurity requirements. * Support embedded control software, touchscreen applications, microcontrollers, and ESP32\-based connectivity solutions. * Support Microsoft Azure systems used for device provisioning, over\-the\-air updates, telemetry, diagnostics, and connected\-equipment management. * Troubleshoot communication between equipment, embedded controllers, networks, applications, APIs, and cloud services. * Use tools such as Postman to test APIs and troubleshoot software integrations. * Document defects, verify corrective actions, and approve software changes prior to release. * Troubleshoot software and connectivity issues found during engineering testing, manufacturing, or on equipment installed in the field. * Use telemetry, logs, diagnostic information, and laboratory testing to identify root cause and corrective actions. * Support Wi\-Fi connectivity and customer cybersecurity requirements, including security questionnaires, trust\-center reviews, and technical discussions with customer IT organizations. * Communicate software architecture, network requirements, data flows, cloud connectivity, and update processes to technical and non\-technical audiences. 100% on site role interacting with production and other departments * **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 2\+ years of professional experience in software development, embedded systems, connected products, or software systems engineering. * Experience with software requirements, testing, troubleshooting, release, and lifecycle support. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to coordinate technical work performed by external development partners. **Technical Qualifications** Working knowledge or experience with several of the following: * C * C\# * TypeScript * SQL * ASP.NET Core Web API * Microsoft Azure * REST APIs * Postman * Embedded systems and microcontrollers * ESP32 development * Wi\-Fi networking * IoT or connected\-device systems Expert\-level experience in every technology is not required. The engineer must have sufficient technical depth to define requirements, communicate effectively with developers, troubleshoot issues, evaluate solutions, validate completed work, and make smaller software changes when needed. **Compensation Information:** Salaried Exempt Role $80,000 \- $85,000 *ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.* *As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

You’ll write production code every day while shaping the technical direction of the platform, working alongside engineering teams and stakeholders. **What you’ll do** * Design and build multi\-agent AI systems, including task delegation between agents, state management, and secure communication. * Build MCP servers and clients that securely connect large language models (LLMs) to enterprise data sources and developer tools. * Contribute to the architecture of an internal AI platform, with a focus on performance, low latency, and a smooth developer experience. * Write high\-quality, production\-ready code, build prototypes, and help set engineering best practices for AI development. * Write clear design documents, mentor engineers, and explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. **What we’re looking for** * 8–12 years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong programming skills in Python or Java. * Solid system design skills: you can break down complex problems, weigh trade\-offs, and design services that hold up at scale. * Experience building and deploying on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with Docker and Kubernetes. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to have** * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications: RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering. * Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI. * Experience with MCP, or with tool calling and function calling in LLM APIs. * Experience with TypeScript or Go. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. **Work location and authorization** * This is an **onsite role** in Morrisville, NC. jobs.title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
jobs.description: BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan. https://bioagelabs.com We discover drug targets for aging and age\-related disease by combining longitudinal human data with causal evidence from genetics and animal models, structured ontologies and curated external knowledge. A knowledge graph harmonizes these disparate sources to enable scientific discovery of targets, indications and mechanism of action. We are seeking a **Knowledge Graph Engineer** with hands\-on experience in data engineering and graph technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable knowledge graph solutions. You will translate ontologies and semantic models into production systems, develop pipelines that connect enterprise data to graph platforms, and build queries that support downstream analytics and intelligent applications. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with an understanding of graph modeling and semantic data. You will own solutions from architecture and technology selection through implementation, testing, and performance optimization, working closely with data engineers, AI teams, and stakeholders to turn business requirements into reliable systems. **What you will do** -------------------- * Maintain and extend our knowledge graph, including its schema, ingestion pipelines and query layer (Neo4j, Cypher, Apache Jena Fuseki, BigQuery on Google Cloud). * Build and run validation and data\-governance pipelines to maintain data quality, consistency, and performance. This covers schema and constraint checks, identifier reconciliation, provenance and versioning. * Maintain our ontologies and semantic models with the biology and data science teams, and develop the mapping tool scientists use to annotate new terms and analyses. This includes the validation that keeps their mappings consistent with the graph. * Integrate knowledge graph solutions with cloud platforms and enterprise data ecosystems, including Google Cloud and BigQuery. * Collaborate with data engineers, data science, AI and biology teams to make graph data accessible and useful for downstream applications. * Write clean, testable, production\-grade code and apply engineering best practices throughout development and delivery. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, data engineering, AI or a related field, with 3\+ years of industry experience in data engineering. * Experience working with biological or biomedical data, such as genomics, proteomics, clinical or phenotype data, and familiarity with standard biomedical ontologies and identifiers (e.g. UniProt, Gene Ontology, EFO, MONDO). **Technical qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with graph databases such as Neo4j, Stardog or GraphDB, including writing and optimizing queries in Cypher or SPARQL. * Working knowledge of semantic modelling concepts and standards such as RDF and OWL, and the ability to turn an ontology into a working schema. * Experience designing and building APIs (e.g. REST or GraphQL, using frameworks such as FastAPI) that give applications and users access to graph data. * Experience building data\-quality or validation frameworks. * Familiarity with Google Cloud and BigQuery. * Strong Python and working knowledge of JavaScript for building data pipelines, graph integrations, and production applications. * Strong software engineering practices, including data modeling, system design, testing, documentation and version control. * (Preferred) Experience with LLM or agent systems * (Preferred) Experience with Open Targets and other drug\-discovery knowledge bases. **Collaboration and ownership** * Strong problem\-solving skills and sound technical judgment when requirements are still evolving or design priorities compete. * Ability to take ownership of a solution from initial design through implementation and ongoing maintenance. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture decisions and technical trade\-offs to clients and stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively across data engineering, biologists and AI teams. **Our company** BioAge is a clinical\-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for metabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging. The Company's lead product candidate, BGE\-102, is a potent, orally available, brain\-penetrant small\-molecule NLRP3 inhibitor being developed for cardiovascular risk and retinal diseases including diabetic macular edema. BGE\-102 has completed a Phase 1 SAD/MAD trial demonstrating a well\-tolerated profile and potential best\-in\-class reductions in hsCRP and other inflammatory biomarkers in participants with obesity and elevated inflammation. Phase 2 cardiovascular risk proof\-of\-concept data are anticipated in H2 2026, and Phase 1b/2a diabetic macular edema proof\-of\-concept data are anticipated in mid 2027\. The Company is also developing long\-acting injectable and oral small molecule APJ agonists for obesity. BioAge’s additional preclinical programs, which leverage insights from the Company’s proprietary discovery platform built on human longevity data, address key pathways involved in metabolic aging. BioAge has been listed on Nasdaq (BIOA) since 2024\. For additional information about BioAge, visit the company’s website at https://bioagelabs.com. **Our workplace** BioAge offers competitive salary, a comprehensive compensation package, and generous paid time off in addition to company\-observed holidays. We provide comprehensive health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance) and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching employer contributions, and we support families through childcare and fertility benefits. We also pride ourselves in giving employees many opportunities for career development, including a generous annual budget for continued learning and a dedication to training and skill development. Many positions (including this one) are remote, allowing our team members to work from anywhere. The salary for this role is expected to be approximately $140,000 \- $175,000, depending on experience. We are open to the concept that different experience levels add value to the team in different ways, and therefore will consider a variety of experience and offer commensurate pay. At BioAge, we embrace diversity and differences while we learn from each other, and we believe that every team member has an important role to play. We are an equal opportunity employer. BioAge prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. BioAge conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
jobs.description: **Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT) **Hours:** Full\-time **Location:** Midvale, UT (On\-site with occasional remote flexibility) \#LI\-Onsite **You report to:** Software Engineering Manager **Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000\-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience. **Our Benefits:** * Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection. * 401(k) with Employer Match * Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work\-life balance. * Equity \& Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full\-time employees. * Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact. * Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products. **This Role:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale\-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device\-to\-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread. A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field. **You Will:** * **Develop connectivity\-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi\-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device\-to\-cloud messaging. * **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast. * **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app. * **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable. * **Work across the device\-to\-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end\-to\-end, from the radio to the app. * **Use modern tools:** Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation. * **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support. **You Have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5\+ years of directly relevant experience. * 3\+ years writing production firmware in C/C\+\+ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex\-M). * Experience with a real\-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP\-IDF, nRF Connect SDK). * Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT. * Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning. * Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN). * Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop). * Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts. * Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD. * Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work. **Nice to Have:** You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas. * Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs. * Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native). * Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z\-Wave. * Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot). * Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting. * Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion. **To Apply:** * Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open\-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills. * **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position. **About BioLite:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel\-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connected, whether at home, on the road, or off the grid. Rooted in innovation and motivated by impact, we're building a future where renewable energy is accessible to all. We believe in a bright and safe future, and that includes life at work. BioLite and Goal Zero are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where everyone is encouraged to show up as their full selves. We know that inclusion makes our solutions better and our team stronger.

jobs.title: AI Engineering – New College Graduate 2027
jobs.description: **About Bitdeer AI:** Bitdeer AI, a full\-stack AI cloud provider (AI Data Center, IaaS, PaaS, MaaS) under Bitdeer Technologies Group and a preferred NVIDIA Cloud Partner, is engineered to power the AI of tomorrow. With the group's 3 Gigawatts of power capacity deployed and under development globally, Bitdeer holds a decisive advantage in the AI era: the massive energy, physical infrastructure, and compute foundation required to run intelligence at global scale. Operating across strategic international hubs, including the United States, Singapore, and Europe, we build on one core promise: One Cloud, Infinite Possibilities. **Our Two Core Missions**: * Transforming Hyperscale Power into Useful AI: We take the extreme complexity of gigawatt\-scale energy grids, liquid\-cooled data center topologies, and low\-latency networking fabrics, and turn that raw physical power into accessible, high\-performance AI Cloud that directly drives real\-world intelligence. * Building an Integrated Full\-Stack Cloud Platform: We engineer the complete software layer, spanning bare\-metal provisioning, managed Kubernetes, distributed training pipelines, high\-throughput AI Inference engines, and Model\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS) with serverless APIs, empowering enterprises to seamlessly train, fine\-tune, deploy, and serve next\-generation AI intelligence. **We are seeking** **2027 New College Graduates:** Why Start Your Career at Bitdeer AI? We don't just look at the infrastructure layer, we build across the entire value chain for our full\-stack cloud. At Bitdeer AI, you will architect the actual backbone of global artificial intelligence. From foundation\-level hardware orchestration and low\-latency Inference systems to upper\-layer MaaS platforms and AI Agents environments, you will solve high\-scale systems challenges that few companies on Earth have the power capacity to attempt. Your work will directly power the global AI ecosystem, from ambitious startups and elite research institutions to global enterprises. Artificial intelligence is reshaping human potential, but the future of AI relies on real\-world compute, reliable infrastructure and engineering, and massive power. Don't just witness the AI revolution. Power it. Join Bitdeer AI, and build the intelligence for infinite possibilities. **What you will be responsible for** We are looking for key talents to develop in the following areas: * Cloud Service Platform: Development of large\-scale, highly available AI cloud services, including GPU virtual machines, bare\-metal services, container services, cloud networking, storage, billing, monitoring, security, and multi\-region resource management. * Kubernetes Service Platform: Development of managed Kubernetes services with GPU\-native orchestration, intelligent scheduling, distributed workload management, cluster lifecycle management, observability, resource isolation, and support for large\-scale AI training and inference workloads. * AI Model Training and Inference Platform: Development of distributed training, model fine\-tuning, model deployment, inference acceleration, serverless inference, model APIs, model evaluation, and production\-grade LLM and multimodal model\-serving capabilities. * AI Agent Platform: Development of enterprise AI Agent platforms, including Agent building, workflow orchestration, tool integration, retrieval\-augmented generation, memory systems, sandbox execution, multi\-Agent collaboration, evaluation, observability, security, and large\-scale Agent runtime infrastructure. * Advanced AI Systems: Development of GPU resource scheduling, distributed systems, high\-performance networking, cloud\-native infrastructure, MLOps and LLMOps platforms, AI application marketplaces, and automated operation systems for large\-scale AI infrastructure. Career Opportunities within the Program: * Cloud Platform Engineering * AI Operations, MLOps \& Site Reliability Engineering * MaaS, Model Serving \& AI Training Infrastructure * AI Agent \& Application Engineering * AI \& Cloud Security Engineering * AI Research Successful candidates will start in one of the above areas based on the interview assessment and business needs. Opportunities to rotate across different roles will also be provided as part of career development. **How you will stand out** * Fresh graduates (Bachelors, Masters, PhD) from all disciplines and/or candidates with up to 2 years of related work experience. * Strong programming ability in one or more languages, including Go, Python, C\+\+, Java, Rust, or related technologies. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Terraform, OpenStack, Prometheus, Grafana, Argo, Istio, PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues, distributed storage, or other cloud\-native technologies is highly preferred. * Experience in developing or operating large\-scale cloud platforms, Kubernetes platforms, AI training platforms, inference platforms, or Agent platforms is highly preferred. * Deep enthusiasm for cutting\-edge AI infrastructure, cloud\-native technologies, and building large\-scale, globally distributed systems. * Proven achievements in academics, engineering projects, top\-tier publications, open\-source contributions, or programming/algorithm competitions. * A strong ownership mentality, engineering discipline, and a commitment to creating a meaningful impact early in your career as we build the foundation for next\-generation AI. **What you will experience working with us** * A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives. * An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start\-up spirit. * A fast\-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts. * The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry. * Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems. * Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities. * Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring. Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

jobs.description: Locations: **San Francisco, California; Sausalito, California** Additional Locations: **Sausalito, CA** **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** **Team Overview** BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values\-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi\-asset. We deliver world\-class service to all of our clients, from wealth advisors to family offices to endowments and foundations. **About this Role** At BlackRock SMA Solution we obsess with our clients: we put them front and central to everything we do. The focus of this role is to contribute to BlackRock codebase and collaborate with users to identify their needs and help them be more efficient. Our platform is called Arya and is based on microservices architecture with our web application being the interface with users. connectivity, zero\-trust egress and service perimeters to protect workloads without limiting the platform’s ability to grow. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines that help product well as IAM perimeters and Workload Identity. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company. * Strong infrastructure as code practice. * Hands\-on experience running AI or ML workloads in production, tooling around them. * Approach incidents without blame, communicate directly, take ownership of platform outcomes and turn lessons learned into practical improvements that help other engineers No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Synthetic Data
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · San Francisco Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code. ### **Research Engineer, Synthetic Data** ### **About the Role** As a Research Engineer on the Synth Data team at SpaceXAI, you’ll invent and scale the synthetic data that teaches our models new capabilities. You own the full loop: spotting a capability the model is missing, designing a data generation strategy, building reliable pipelines and verifiers, and validating that the resulting data actually moves the model. You form hypotheses about what data will help, build the systems to produce it at scale, run ablations, and read the resulting traces and training signals to understand why it worked (or didn’t). Your datasets go directly into frontier training runs, and shape the development of Grok models. ### **What you’ll work on** * Designing end\-to\-end synthetic data recipes that turn raw sources (traces, documents, codebases, workflows) into large, diverse, verifiable task sets. * Building strong verification and anti\-hacking mechanisms so rewards are simple to compute and hard to game. * Controlling difficulty and diversity so data stays learnable and reflects real usage instead of collapsing into templates. * Running targeted ablations and analyses that demonstrate a dataset caused a capability improvement (and ruling out grader or data artifacts). * Iterating from traces and training results to close specific gaps, then turning successful one\-off recipes into reusable infrastructure. * Partnering with research and other RL Data teams to translate model capability goals into concrete synthetic data plans. ### **You may be a fit if** * You have research experience on synthetic or post\-training data, in industry or academia. You've designed a data generation method, shipped the data into training, and can show its impact to the model you’re training. * You have strong software engineering fundamentals and have built non\-trivial data pipelines, agent systems, or evaluation frameworks. * You have taste for what makes a good training task: hard enough to teach something real, simple enough to grade reliably, and resistant to reward hacking. * You are careful and systematic — understanding both aggregate metrics and close reading of raw outputs. * You enjoy turning messy, open\-ended problems into repeatable, high\-quality data production systems. ### **ing** If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2\-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

jobs.description: **Job Overview:** As the Senior Manager of Automated Scoring, you will play an integral part of the machine learning team, which consists of mathematicians, data scientists, psychometricians, linguists, and software engineers. jobs.title: Workforce Modernization Architect
jobs.description: Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting\-edge technology with compassionate, high\-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we're solving today's unemployment challenges with smart software, world\-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you'll feel right at home here. Career Team is looking for a Workforce Modernization Architect who designs solutions around people, processes, and compliance; not code. Many of Career Team's customers run federally funded workforce development programs. These programs must submit reports to federal agencies in strictly defined formats, such as the WIOA Participant Individual Record Layout (PIRL), and follow detailed logic rules. You'll make sure our government software platform is built to meet those requirements from the start, translate federal reporting specifications into clear business rules, work with technical teams to make sure the system calculates and formats data correctly, and help customers submit accurate, on\-time reports. ### **Role Overview:** * **Own federal reporting requirements.** Interpret federal reporting specifications, data standards, and program guidance, with a focus on PIRL and related U.S. Department of Labor and Department of Education reporting. Turn them into detailed functional requirements. * **Define reporting logic.** Write clear, testable business rules for how the system must calculate each reported value. This includes: * + Reporting periods and date ranges + Who counts in each reporting population, including participants, exiters, and co\-enrollments across WIOA titles (Title I, Title II, Title III, Title IV) + Unduplicated counts and deduplication + Enrollment, program participation, and exit logic + Age and status calculated as of specific dates + Handling of missing, refused, or conflicting data * **Specify output formats.** Document required file layouts, field definitions, code lists, ordering, and file naming conventions (CSV, XML, fixed\-width, or agency\-specific templates) so exports pass federal validation the first time. * **Solve compliance issues.** Find the root cause of reporting and compliance problems, whether they come from system logic, data entry, or unclear guidance, and lead them through to a documented fix. * **Resolve ambiguity.** Identify gaps or contradictions in federal guidance. Research agency FAQs, TEGLs, and technical assistance resources. Document how the system handles edge cases and the reasoning behind each decision. * **Lead testing and quality assurance.** Build test scenarios and expected results for reporting logic. Partner with QA to review system outputs against specifications and federal validation tools, such as DOL's WIPS edit checks. Trace errors back to the rule or data that caused them. * **Bridge state case management systems.** Apply your knowledge of how different state case management systems capture and structure participant data. Anticipate integration, mapping, and consistency challenges across customers in multiple states. * **Track regulatory change.** Monitor updates to federal specifications, PIRL versions, and reporting cycles. Assess how changes affect the system and customers, and plan updates ahead of deadlines. * **Build data quality in.** Recommend intake workflows, required fields, and validation checks that keep bad data out of the system, instead of fixing it at report time. * **Support customers during reporting cycles.** Help program staff understand their reports, troubleshoot validation errors, and answer questions from grant managers, monitors, and auditors. ### **Qualifications:** * Experience in workforce development, including programmatic experience in at least one WIOA program: Title I (Adult, Dislocated Worker, Youth), Title II (Adult Education and Family Literacy), Title III (Wagner\-Peyser Employment Service), Title IV (Vocational Rehabilitation), or Title V (Senior Community Service Employment Program) * Hands\-on experience with PIRL and federal reporting for grant\-funded programs * Hands\-on experience with more than one state case management system * Experience with government software, either as a user, implementer, or administrator in a public\-sector setting * Grant management experience, including an understanding of how reporting ties to performance, funding, and compliance * A proven ability to read and interpret technical federal specifications and translate them into precise, unambiguous requirements * Strong logical reasoning. You're comfortable expressing rules as clear conditions (if/then logic, inclusion and exclusion criteria, date calculations) and working through edge cases methodically * Familiarity with testing and quality assurance practic onsumer Privacy Act ("CCPA").** Career Team is committed to complying with the CCPA and all data privacy and laws in the jurisdictions in which it recruits and hires employees. Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business\-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. Below are the categories of Personal Information we collect and the purposes for which we intend to use this information: **Identifying information**, such as your full name, gender, date of birth, and signature; **Demographic data**, such as race, ethnic origin, marital status, disability, and veteran or military status; **Contact information**, such as your home address, telephone numbers, email addresses, and emergency contact information; **Dependent's or other individual's information**, such as their full name, address, date of birth, and Social Security numbers (SSN); **National identifiers**, such as SSN, passport and visa information, and immigration status and documentation; **Educational and professional background**, such as your work history, academic and professional qualifications, educational records, references, and interview notes; **Employment details**, such as your job title, position, hire dates, compensation, performance and disciplinary records, and vacation and sick leave records; **Financial information**, such as banking details, tax information, payroll information, and withholdings; **Health and Safety information**, such as health conditions (if relevant to your employment), job restrictions, workplace illness and injury information, and health insurance policy information; **Information Systems (IS) information**, such as your search history, browsing history, login information, and IP addresses on the Company's information systems and networks; **Biometric information**, such as facial recognition, fingerprints, iris or retina scans, keystroke, or other physical patterns; and **Geolocation data**, such as time and physical location related to use of an internet website, application, device, or physical access to a Company office location. The Company collects Personal Information to use or disclose as appropriate to: (1\) Comply with all applicable laws and regulations; (2\) Recruit and evaluate job applicants and candidates for employment; (3\) Conduct background checks; (4\) Manage your employment relationship with us, including for: (a) onboarding processes; (b) timekeeping, payroll, and expense report administration; (c) employee benefits administration; (d) employee training and development requirements; (d) the creation, maintenance, and security of your online employee accounts; (e) reaching your emergency contacts when needed, such as when you are not reachable or are injured or ill; (f) workers' compensation claims management; (g) employee job performance, including goals and performance reviews, promotions, discipline, and termination; and (h) other human resources purposes; (5\) Manage and monitor employee access to company facilities, equipment, and systems; (6\) Conduct internal audits and workplace investigations; (7\) Investigate and enforce compliance with and potential breaches of Company policies and procedures; (8\) Engage in corporate transactions requiring review of employee records, such as for evaluating potential mergers and acquisitions of the Company; (9\) Maintain commercial insurance policies and coverages, including for workers' compensation and other liability insurance; (10\) Perform workforce analytics, data analytics, and benchmarking; (11\) Administer and maintain the Company's operations, including for safety purposes; (12\) For client marketing purposes; (13\) Exercise or defend the legal rights of the Company and its employees, and affiliates, customers, contractors, and agents; and (14\) to comply with requirements of government grants, including, but not limited to, program and audit requirements.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Blockchain
jobs.description: Ann Arbor, MI ; Austin, TX ; San Francisco, CA **Requisition ID** 2026\-127767 **Category** Engineering \& Software Development **Position type** Regular **Pay range** USD $164,000\.00 \- $205,000\.00 / Year **Application deadline** 2026\-10\-16 **Your opportunity** -------------------- At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in\-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s). Schwab Technology Services (STS) Research \& Development team is responsible for exploring innovative technologies and identifying ways that organizations throughout Schwab might benefit from their application. The Incubation Lab is the group that builds pilots to production ready standards. We stand up working systems, run them against real financial workflows, and produce evidence that a capability is viable before it becomes a production commitment. This role is hands\-on – you will spend most of your time building full stack solutions. You will design, develop, and maintain modern front\-end applications and back\-end services. You build with private and/or permissioned blockchain networks, write and deploy the smart contracts that run on them, and integrate those networks with the ledgers, order flow, and recordkeeping systems that the firm already depends on. Current work centers on tokenized cash and tokenized funds, on\-chain compliance controls, and reconciliation between chain state and books of record. Engineers in the lab also contribute to adjacent research in AI/ML, cloud\-native design, and digital trust. **Key Responsibilities:** * Clearly explain complex technical ideas to business partners in a way that helps them understand the impact and possibilities, bridging the gap between tech and strategy. * Evaluate different blockchain architectures, smart contract frameworks, and tokenization methodologies to assess their applicability to our business. * Stay at the forefront of blockchain innovation, identifying new opportunities in digital identity, decentralized finance (DeFi), tokenized securities, and interoperability. * Contribute to the company’s blockchain and digital assets strategy through whitepapers, presentations, and internal education initiatives. * Engage with industry consortia, regulators, and technology partners to understand emerging trends and best practices. * Build and operate permissioned EVM networks used for experimentation: validator configuration, node infrastructure, observability, transaction signing, and upgrade paths. * Design, implement, test, and deploy smart contracts for tokenized instruments, including issuance, redemption, transfer restrictions, and lifecycle events. * Implement on\-chain compliance controls (allowlists, role\-based permissioning, transfer\-agent style constraints) and evaluate token standards against the regulatory requirements a given instrument carries. * Integrate chain activity with off\-chain systems: event listeners that translate ledger and order events into mint and burn operations, and reconciliation pipelines that true token supply against the authoritative system of record. * Evaluate platforms, execution environments, and vendor infrastructure against defined criteria, then publish the comparison so architecture decisions rest on measured behavior rather than vendor claims. * Write the engineering record for each experiment: what was built, what it demonstrated, where it failed, and what would need to change for production use. * Work directly with partners across product, operations, risk, and compliance to turn a business question into a testable technical hypothesis, and explain results in terms those partners can act on. * Support other R\&D initiatives in areas like AI/ML, cloud\-native application design, spatial computing, and digital identity/trust, contributing architectural insight and cross\-domain thinking. **What you have** ----------------- **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production ownership of systems you designed. * 3\+ years of experience in blockchain development, crypto asset management, or related fields. * Strong understanding of blockchain architectures (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Layer 2 solutions) and crypto wallet infrastructure. * Experience running blockchain infrastructure, not only deploying to it. Permissioned or consortium networks (Besu, Quorum, or comparable) are directly relevant. * Experience in working with secure wallet solutions, including key management (MPC, HSMs, cold storage, custodial vs. non\-custodial models), and the operational controls each requires. * Familiarity with tokenization of assets, including securities, stablecoins, and smart contracts (ERC\-20, ERC\-721, ERC\-1155, etc.). * Working knowledge of Ethereum and the EVM at the level required to debug it: gas mechanics, storage layout, the proxy and upgrade patterns in common use, and the failure modes each introduces. * Proficiency in multiple programming languages such as Solidity, Rust, Python, Go, or Java. * Experience with cryptographic protocols, DeFi applications, and blockchain interoperability solutions. * Strong analytical skills and ability to translate research findings into real\-world applications. * Ability to write clearly for an audience that includes non\-engineers, and to defend a technical position while remaining open to being wrong. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Full\-stack product development experience. * Experience within fintech, financial institutions, or technology\-driven R\&D teams. * Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks related to digital assets (SEC, FINRA, AML/KYC, MiCA). * Prior experience working at a financial institution, fintech, or blockchain startup. * Hands\-on experience with Zero\-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs), Decentralized Identity (DID), or Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs). * Cross\-chain messaging and interoperability protocols. * Understanding of financial services infrastructure, including payments, settlements, and capital markets. * A secondary skillset in one or more emerging technology area outside of crypto technology: e.g. AI/ML/GenAI, Spatial Computing, Cloud Native Design, Digital Trust. In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities. **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis. We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future: * 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan * Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28\-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions * Paid parental leave and family building benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Health, dental, and vision insurance ### **Share:** * Facebook * LinkedIn * X * Email **Eligible Schwabbies receive** ------------------------------- * **Medical, dental and vision benefits** --------------------------------------- * **401(k) and employee stock purchase plans** -------------------------------------------- * **Tuition reimbursement to keep developing your career** -------------------------------------------------------- * **Paid parental leave and adoption/family building benefits** ------------------------------------------------------------- * **Sabbatical leave available after five years of employment** -------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Chartmetric** Chartmetric, Inc. is a 10\-year\-old startup specializing in music data analytics. We are trusted by Universal MusicGroup, Sony, Warner, and Apple Music, as well as hundreds of other music companies and industry professionals. Our team has created a self\-service data dashboard for the music industry to better understand the activity happening around artists. Together, we combine hundreds of thousands of real\-time data points across iTunes, Spotify, YouTube, Google, Amazon, X, and others through our beautifully designed tool in order to make sense of the increasingly complex landscape of the music industry. **About the role** We are looking for a versatile, experienced Senior Software Engineer to join Chartmetric’s Engineering team. You’ll be a true full\-stack engineer, comfortable building polished user experiences, backend services, APIs, and data\-driven systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS. This is also an AI\-first engineering role. You’ll use tools like Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test, and ship software. You’ll also build AI agents for internal workflows and customer\-facing product experiences. We’re looking for someone with strong technical judgment, broad engineering depth, and experience leading important projects from idea through production. **What you'll do*** Lead significant technical projects from architecture and design through deployment and production support * Use Claude Code, Codex, and AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining a high quality bar * Build AI\-powered product features and internal agents using RAG, prompts, tools, and evaluations * Design scalable APIs, services, and data\-intensive systems * Improve engineering productivity through reusable tooling, automation, and development workflows * Mentor teammates and contribute to architecture, code reviews, incident response, and engineering standards * Build and own full\-stack product features across React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS **Qualifications*** Strong senior\-level experience building and operating production software * Strong system design, debugging, testing, and production engineering skills * Strong ownership, product judgment, and ability to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions * Previous experience as a Tech Lead, project lead, or technical owner is strongly preferred * 6\+ years experience Bonus Points * Data Engineering experience with Python, ClickHouse, Snowflake, or Airflow * Experience building analytics or other data\-intensive products **The pay range for this role is:** 140,000 \- 160,000 USD per year(New York) 140,000 \- 160,000 USD per year(HQ)

jobs.description: **ABOUT CHURCHILL DOWNS INCORPORATED** **Churchill Downs Incorporated (“CDI”) (Nasdaq: CHDN)** has been creating extraordinary entertainment experiences for more than 150 years, beginning with one of the most iconic and enduring events in sports and entertainment—the Kentucky Derby. Through the acquisition, development, and operation of live and historical racing entertainment venues, the expansion of online wagering services and other technology businesses, and the ownership and operation of regional casino gaming properties, CDI offers diverse career opportunities across the country. Our success is driven by dedicated team members who are passionate about delivering exceptional experiences, embracing innovation, and helping shape the future of entertainment. **Job Summary** --------------- **Program Start Date: June 2027** * Introducing CDImmerse, an innovative rotation program specifically designed for emerging professionals seeking a transformative experience within Churchill Downs Incorporated (CDI) – an iconic brand. Tailored for recent graduates, CDImmerse stands out as a highly coveted program that offers a distinctive gateway to launch your career in Information Technology. * Throughout the program, participants will engage in a comprehensive exploration of career opportunities through immersion in four six\-month rotations over a span of two years. This hands\-on experience provides an insider's perspective, laying a solid foundation for your professional journey. * CDImmerse goes beyond the ordinary by facilitating meaningful connections with a diverse array of leaders.
