jobs.title: Change & Release Manager
jobs.description: **Company Description** We're partnering with **Quant**, a global leader in digital transformation and technology solutions, seeking a **Change \& Release Manager** to join their team. **About Quant:** Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro. The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On\-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction\-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met. Through our Tokenized Deposits\-as\-a\-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross\-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it. **Job Description** **Change \& Release Manager** **Role summary** Owns the change\-management function for the engagement: ensures every production change flows through either automation or a governed, auditable manual procedure. Directs the Release Engineers and Infrastructure Engineer on execution and owns the AWS tenancy relationship. **Key responsibilities** * Own the change\-control process and chair the change\-advisory board. * Ensure every production change flows through automation or a governed, auditable manual procedure. * Own the AWS tenancy relationship and its governance. * Direct the Release and Infrastructure Engineers on the Terraform estate, Helm charts and CI/CD pipeline for chain\-node deployments. * Report on change success and change\-related incidents to the Engagement Director. **Qualifications** **Required experience \& qualifications** * 5\+ years in change/release management (ITIL\-aligned), ideally with infrastructure\-as\-code environments. * Strong coordination across engineering and operations. * Risk\-assessment and rollback\-planning discipline; comfort with formal audit requirements. * ITIL certification preferred. **Success measures** * Change\-success rate. * Change\-related incident rate. * Audit findings on change\-governance evidence. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000\+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain\-of\-custody documentation. jobs.title: Staff GTM Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Revenue Operations **Compensation** ---------------- * $210K – $250K **About CodeRabbit** -------------------- CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open\-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things. We are a fast\-moving, well\-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1\.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve. **The Opportunity** ------------------- At CodeRabbit, our agents already write, review, and ship our Salesforce and internal tooling code. A Linear label or Slack emoji starts a pipeline: an agent plans the change, a human approves, the agent builds and tests it in a sandbox and opens a pull request, a second model reviews it, and guard hooks stop anything that could hurt production. This is our GTM Systems harness. We're looking for a Staff GTM Systems Engineer to own it and to architect the systems it builds: the pipeline generation, quote\-to\-cash, provisioning, and billing integrations behind a company growing from PLG into enterprise sales, and the internal tools our GTM teams run on. You'll be the senior technical voice in Business Systems, setting the patterns that engineers, analysts and agents all follow. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own and evolve the agentic engineering harness: the Agent Build pipeline, guard hooks, worktree tooling, CI, model routing and the permission tiers that keep agents safe around production. * Design and build internal tools and agents as full\-stack applications (TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres, MCP servers) where off\-the\-shelf software falls short. * Build in Salesforce at a deep level: Apex service and selector patterns, triggers, LWC, Platform Events, permission sets and the metadata deployment model. * Set the engineering standards for Business Systems: architecture reviews, code review, testing, release and production runbooks, and how agent\-written work gets reviewed and shipped. * Give the analysts and engineers on the team the platform to build their own agents, such as the Sales OS Agent and Data Quality Agent. * Partner with Finance, GTM, Deal Desk, and the Data teams to turn ambiguous business needs into systems that hold up at the next stage of scale. * Raise the technical bar across the team through pairing, reviews and design docs, and reduce our dependence on outside consultants over time. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Deep, hands\-on Salesforce engineering: Apex, LWC, data modeling, sharing and security, and source\-driven deployment with the Salesforce CLI. * Strong full\-stack software engineering beyond Salesforce, with production web apps, APIs and databases you have built and run. * Real experience building with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex, including the guardrails that make agent output safe to ship: tests, CI gates, review, and scoped permissions. * A track record integrating GTM systems end to end, such as CRM to billing, CPQ, provisioning, the data warehouse and reverse ETL, pipeline generation workflows. * Staff\-level judgment: you have owned architecture across systems you did not build, made decisions with teams that do not report to you, and changed how a team works. * Clear writing. Your design docs, PR descriptions and runbooks let others act without a meeting. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * At least 7\+ years of Salesforce and full\-stack engineering. * Production experience with Python, TypeScript and Next.js. * Experience with Chargebee, Stripe, Zuora or another subscription billing platform, including usage\-based or marketplace billing (AWS, GCP, GitHub Marketplace). * Experience building MCP servers, LLM evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows for agents. * Experience with BigQuery, dbt, Clay, or event\-driven integration patterns. * Familiarity with developer\-tools or technical B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including a PLG to sales\-led transition. Target salary for this role is $210k\-$250k, plus equity. Actual salary will be based on candidate skills, experience and location. Compensation Range: $210K \- $250K

On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 11/30/2026 **The Opportunity** As a Sr AI Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load\-to\-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. Right\-size GPU and serverless capacity, tune batching, caching, and quantization, and give teams clear visibility into what their workloads cost. * **Safety and Governance:** Implement guardrails, prompt and output logging, PII handling, access controls, and model and dataset lineage so AI systems meet our security and customer data commitments. * **Best Practices:** Drive the adoption of modern software development practices across AI work, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Mentorship:** Mentor engineers and data scientists on production ML and distributed systems, and raise the operational bar of every team that builds on the platform. * **Incident Management:** Lead the response and resolution for complex production incidents involving AI services, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures. **The Skills and Experience You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant time as a senior or staff engineer owning production infrastructure that other engineering teams depend on. * 4\+ years building and operating machine learning or AI platforms, with models you've taken from notebook to production traffic and then kept healthy. * Strong development language skills ideally using TypeScript/js, Java, or Go, with the software engineering discipline to build libraries other teams adopt willingly. * Extensive AWS experience with production systems, ideally including EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, Redpanda, MSK/Kafka, S3, and Secrets Manager, plus infrastructure\-as\-code with Pulumi, Terraform or similar. * Hands\-on experience serving models at scale: containerized inference, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and the tradeoffs between real\-time, streaming, and batch scoring. * Practical experience with LLM systems in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt and context management, tool\-calling or agent frameworks, and managed model APIs such as Amazon Bedrock. * Prov ous problem spaces, writing clear system design documents and operations runbooks, and driving alignment across Engineering, Product, and Operations. * Proven mentoring track record, especially helping engineers and data scientists grow in system design, observability, and operational excellence. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain trade\-offs and system behavior clearly to engineers, product managers, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with model fine\-tuning, distillation, or parameter\-efficient training, and a clear point of view on when it beats prompting. * Background in marketplace, pricing, forecasting, or document extraction problems. jobs.title: Electrical Schematic/PCB Design Engineer (Semiconductor Test Hardware)
jobs.description: **About the role:** We’re looking for an engineer who can translate customer inputs—Word specs, Excel netlists/BOMs, interface requirements, and legacy drawings—into robust **electrical schematics** that drive high‑quality **PCB designs** for semiconductor test hardware (probe, final test load boards, interface/fixture boards, handler interface, and related assemblies). You’ll own schematic capture and collaborate closely with PCB layout, mechanical, test, and manufacturing partners to deliver first‑pass success on fast‑moving customer programs. **What you’ll do:** * Own schematic capture **from ambiguous or mixed customer inputs; clarify requirements, define architecture, and drive parts selection and library needs.** * **Create well‑constrained designs** that account for ATE realities (signal integrity, crosstalk, leakage, guarding/guard rings, Kelvin connections, relay/mux topologies, pogo/contactor constraints, ESD, thermal). * **Partner with PCB layout** to enforce design rules for high‑density, high‑pin‑count boards (fan‑out, length/phase matching, differential pairs, controlled impedance, reference plane strategy, return current). * **Generate and maintain deliverables**: schematics, netlists, constraints, design notes, BOMs, test points, release packages, and ECOs. * **Interface with customers** (design reviews, DFM/DFT tradeoffs, risk/mitigation plans) and internal cross‑functional teams (ME, Test, Supply Chain, CM). * **Shepherd designs through build**: fab/assembly bring‑up support, issue triage, corrective actions, and documentation updates. * **Continuously improve** our libraries, checklists, and design standards for ATE hardware. **Required qualifications:** * 3–8\+ years **in electrical design for** PCB‑based products**; at least** 2\+ years **specifically in** semiconductor test hardware **or** high‑density mixed‑signal boards **(probe/final test, load boards, DUT/contactor boards, or similar).** * **Schematic capture proficiency** in multiple CAD environments, including **Cadence Allegro/Concept HDL** **OrCad** and **Altium Designer** (you can interpret and adapt across tools). * Strong grasp of **signal integrity** and **power integrity** fundamentals: termination, return paths, reference plane stitching, decoupling strategy, controlled impedance, crosstalk mitigation. * Experience with **mixed‑signal** and **low‑leakage/low‑noise** design (sensor or precision analog helpful), **switch/mux/relay** trees, level shifting, protection, and **EMC/ESD** practices. * Comfortable reading/creating **BOMs, netlists, constraints**, and coordinating part selections with the library/CM team (second sources, lifecycles, lead times). * Ability to convert **informal customer artifacts** (spreadsheets, drawings, legacy PDFs) into a **clean, reviewable schematic** with clear notes/assumptions. * Excellent documentation, version control, and **ECO discipline**; clear, concise communication with customers and vendors. **Nice to have:** * **Background in** ATE platforms **(e.g., Advantest, Teradyne) and** DUT/socket/contactor **constraints.** * Experience with **high‑current power distribution**, **RF/coax routing basics**, or **wide‑bandwidth measurement paths**. * Familiarity with **DFM/DFT for probe and final test**: stacking height, planarity, warpage, fiducials, test access, probe card specifics. * Prior work with **constraint‑driven flows** (rules for length/phase, topology, via budgets) and **SI/PI simulation** tools (e.g., Sigrity, HyperLynx). * Scripting/automation for CAD (Altium scripts, SKILL, Python) and **PLM/ERP** integration. * Experience collaborating with **overseas layout partners** or CMs and doing supplier bring‑up. **What success looks like in 30 days:** * **You’ve shipped at least one schematic package from customer inputs to layout handoff with** zero critical ECOs**.** * You’ve introduced at least one **library or checklist improvement** that reduces review time or rework. * You’re the **go‑to** for translating messy specs into **clear, test‑ready schematics**. **Compensation \& benefits:** * Competitive salary with performance bonus; 401(k) with match; paid time off and holidays. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Do you have at least 3 years of experience in electrical design for PCB\-based products, with at least 2 of those years specifically in semiconductor test hardware or high\-density mixed\-signal boards? * Do you have proficiency with schematic capture in multiple CAD environments, including Cadence Allegro/Concept HDL, OrCad, and Altium Designer? Work Location: In person

DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.* \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-TH1 **About DTN:** DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather\-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision\-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world. At DTN, we value **clarity,** **trust** , and **action** . We’re a team of problem\-solvers, outcome\-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do. * **Trust Built:** We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non\-negotiable. * **Confidence\-Driven:** We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act. * **Built for Industry:** We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts. * **Future\-Forward:** We see what’s coming\- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning. **Recruitment Fraud Notice:** DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process. If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@dtn.com to verify the legitimacy of any communication. jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer, Reporting Pro
jobs.description: The Forward Deployment Engineer, Reporting Pro helps customers adopt DeepHealth’s Reporting Pro correctly. The role combines radiology reporting depth, clinical workflow knowledge and customer communication to design how Reporting Pro is configured for each customer, build report templates and structured reporting content with radiologists, coach implementation teams, resolve complex technical issues, and turn recurring field needs into standard product workflows, including AI\-assisted report drafting as it is released. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Service Engineering Lead, Enterprise Intelligence, and working closely with the DxS lead Forward Deployment Engineer. It operates within DeepHealth’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly. The role sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Own technical solution design and configuration of Reporting Pro for assigned customers, mapping reporting workflow to configuration (report templates, macros, structured reporting, speech recognition, sign\-off and addendum rules, critical results, user roles). * Lead technical discovery with customers and implementation teams, covering reporting workflow, legacy reporting systems, HL7 order and result flows, report distribution to RIS and EHR, network and security requirements. * Build and validate report templates and structured reporting content with radiologists, and plan migration of templates and macros from legacy reporting systems through cutover. * Partner with the assigned implementation counterpart for this workstream to adopt learnings and best practices into customer configuration and implementations; train and coach implementation teams and customer reporting administrators on correct configuration; publish configuration standards, template libraries and deployment playbooks. * Serve as customer\-facing technical lead during go\-lives, hypercare and escalations, communicating status, options and expectations to clinical and IT stakeholders. * Provide implementation support as the L3 escalation point for Reporting Pro issues in assigned accounts, including report delivery failures, root cause analysis and resolution with engineering (approximately 20–30% of time). * Convert recurring customer needs into standardized workflows and product requirements, distinguishing product gaps from configuration or training issues. * Own escalation of engineering issues for assigned accounts: triage, document reproducible defects, track status with engineering and close the loop with customers. * Support site reliability (SRE) for assigned accounts: monitor service health with observability tools, participate in incident response and drive reliability improvements with engineering. * Own the AI adoption strategy for Reporting Pro: define requirements, expected customer impact and success criteria, and feed them back to Product and Engineering. * Configure, deploy and support customer adoption of AI\-enabled reporting workflows (e.g., AI report drafting using priors and clinical data) as they are released, coordinating rollout, site readiness and customer adoption with the Technical Delivery Manager and Product Manager. * Validate releases and hotfixes against representative customer configurations before and after deployment. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. **Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Information Systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (required). * 8\+ years of overall experience in healthcare IT, medical imaging or clinical systems (required). * 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role for radiology reporting systems (e.g., PowerScribe, Fluency or similar), such as reporting system administrator, applications/technical consultant, implementation engineer or L3 engineer (required). * Working knowledge of HL7 v2 (ADT, ORM, ORU), including how orders link to reports and how signed reports, addenda and corrections are distributed to RIS and EHR (required). * Hands\-on configuration of report templates, macros, structured reporting and speech recognition, including at least one reporting system go\-live or migration (required). * Strong understanding of radiology clinical workflow, including RIS, worklists, reading, dictation, sign\-off and critical results communication (required). * Working knowledge of cloud\-hosted applications (GCP, AWS or Azure), storage, networking and SSO/authentication (required). * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical decisions to radiologists, IT leaders and executives, including in escalated situations (required). * Imaging informatics or clinical credential such as CIIP, PARCA or ARRT(R) (preferred). * Experience with AI\-assisted or LLM\-based report generation in radiology, and working knowledge of DICOM and PACS integration (preferred). * Experience in a regulated medical device environment (FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304\). * Microsoft Office experience required. **Quality Standards** * Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co\-workers, visitors, and vendors. * Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. * Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. * Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. * Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. * Practices universal safety precautions. * Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. * Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. * Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. * Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. **Travel** This position requires domestic / international travel up to 25%, primarily for customer discovery, go\-lives and escalations. **Working Environment** Remote (United States) **Salary Range:** $125,000\.00\-$135,000\.00

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Model Launches, DeepMind (Fixed-Term Contract)
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in program management. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with AI/ML model launches, inference infrastructure, capacity planning, and Large Language Model (LLM) serving stacks like Gemini and GenMedia. * Experience working effectively with distributed engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. * Proven ability to lead fast\-moving launch programs and establish repeatable governance, tracking workflows, and executive reporting. **About the job** ----------------- Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers. Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs. As a Technical Program Manager for Model Launches, you will drive serving readiness and execution for Google's newest Gemini and GenMedia models. In this 6\-month fixed\-term contract (FTC) role, you will act as the platform launch lead across the GenAI serving stack. You will own the end\-to\-end launch lifecycle from intake and workback planning through private preview, early access, and general availability. Sit at the intersection of model research, platform engineering, SRE, and product areas, you will ensure multimodal and LLM launches land smoothly on schedule. You will orchestrate readiness checklists, quota/QPS planning, bug triage, and launch war rooms to support rapid release timelines across global time zones. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 0% bonus target Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Act as the primary liaison between model development, platform engineering, SRE, and product teams to align launch scope, schedules, dependencies, and readiness. * Maintain model launch checklists and tracking hotlists across Engineering, SRE, and Safety teams to proactively unblock P0 bugs and mitigate technical risks. * Partner with product teams and SREs to collect QPS forecasts, verify capacity provisioning, and coordinate pre\-launch endpoint access. * Lead launch war rooms and cross\-team syncs, maintain the model launch roadmap, and deliver executive updates and post\-launch retrospectives to scale workflows. * Own the end\-to\-end serving platform launch lifecycle for new Gemini and GenMedia LLMs across all milestones, from intake to general availability. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and submit your application via the Jobs Hub.** Join the Discovery family, where quality and service are at the heart of everything we do! **This role will be located at one of Discovery Land Company’s Corporate Office locations in Beverly Hills, California.** **Discovery Land Company** is seeking a full\-time, year\-round **Principal AI Engineer** to join the **Artificial Intelligence** Department. **Job Summary:** Discovery Land Company (DLC) develops and operates private club communities across the U.S. and internationally. DLC's AI team builds the platforms, agents, and workflows that help corporate and club teams work faster with less manual effort. The Principal AI Engineer is the senior technical leader for DLC's AI program, reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence. You will co\-own DLC's AI strategy and roadmap with the VP of AI, set the technical direction and engineering standards for all AI solutions, and own the highest\-impact AI use cases end to end: scope the business problem with department leaders, design the solution, build it, ship it, and measure the hours saved. Time will be split across technical strategy and standards, product ownership, and hands\-on engineering. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Set Technical Direction and Standards: + Co\-own DLC's AI strategy and 1\-year and 3\-year roadmap with the VP of AI, including platform choices and investment priorities. + Define and own DLC's AI reference architecture across agents, MCP integrations, retrieval, and Microsoft 365 automation. + Set and enforce engineering standards for evaluation, logging, guardrails, security, and code review across all production AI solutions. + Lead technical evaluation and selection of AI platforms, models, and vendors. + Mentor engineers and Department AI Leads, and serve as final technical reviewer on AI solution designs. * Own Product Delivery: + Partner with departments across DLC to identify and prioritize use cases by hours saved and risk. + Write clear requirements, success metrics, and solution plans for each AI use case. + Manage the backlog and maintain a consistent delivery cadence. * Drive Adoption: + Deliver training, documentation, and feedback loops for end users at the corporate and club levels. + Track adoption metrics and use them to improve deployed solutions. * Build and Deploy AI Solutions: + Build agents, skills, and automations on Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, Claude API, and Claude Agent SDK). + Build and maintain MCP server integrations that connect Claude to business systems (CRM, marketing automation, ERP, and document stores). + Build workflows in n8n and/or Microsoft Power Automate and Copilot Studio, integrated with SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Outlook via Microsoft Graph. + Build retrieval and knowledge base solutions on Microsoft 365 and related tooling. + Implement evaluation, logging, and guardrails for all production AI solutions. * Co\-lead AI Governance and Security: + Follow DLC data classification rules and ensure member, guest, and employee data is handled under the strictest applicable privacy standard (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA). + Lead technical vendor security reviews for new AI tools and connectors. * What Success Looks Like: + First 6 months - Ship 3 or more production AI use cases with documented hours saved. - Define reusable MCP and Power Automate integration patterns that scale across properties and publish them as DLC standards. - Track adoption metrics and report them monthly to the VP of AI. - Publish DLC's AI reference architecture and engineering standards, applied to all new AI builds. Deliver the technical portion of DLC's 1\-year and 3\-year AI roadmap jointly with the VP of AI. - **Skills \& Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of combined experience in software engineering and product management, including at least 3 years shipping LLM\-based products or internal tools to production. * Hands\-on production experience with Claude and the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude Code, the Claude API (tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs), MCP, and Agent Skills. * Strong experience with the Microsoft 365 stack: Entra ID, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and Teams. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL. * Experience integrating enterprise SaaS platforms via REST APIs and connectors. * Track record of translating ambiguous business requests into shipped solutions with measurable outcomes. * Demonstrated ownership of technical strategy, reference architecture, or engineering standards adopted across multiple teams or business units. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews. * Clear written communication for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience with Oracle CX (Sales Cloud, Eloqua), Sage Intacct, or CData Connect AI preferred. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Power BI, or Dataverse preferred. * AWS experience (Bedrock, IAM, Lambda) preferred. * Experience with RAG, evaluation frameworks, and LLM observability. * Background in hospitality, real estate, or multi\-site operations preferred. Experience building internal AI training or enablement programs preferred. * **Additional Requirements:** * Flexibility and ability to pivot to new projects and desire to work in fast\-paced environment. * Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to deliver service to members, guests, and team members. * Ability to work in a team environment. * Ability to stay calm and focused during the busiest of times. * Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English; additional languages preferred. * Must be able to work flexible work hours/schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Long hours may be required due to business demands. Ability to meet the physical demands of the position including, but not limited to, working indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, standing, walking, and moving for periods of greater than eight (8\) hours, and lifting and carrying items sometimes greater than fifty (50\) pounds. * **Benefits** * Competitive Pay * Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits * 401k Contribution * Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays * Employee Meals, Referral Incentives, and Recognition Programs * Holiday Pay * Professional development and upward mobility opportunities Work\-Family Culture * Discovery Land Company's good faith estimate of the salary range it reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire is $250k plus bonus. **About Us** Discovery Land Company is a U.S.\-based real estate developer and operator of private residential communities with a world\-renowned portfolio of domestic and international properties. The mission of Discovery Land Company is to create one\-of\-a\-kind environments that provide individuals and families the freedom, security, and resources to learn, grow, and play in some of the most beautiful places in the world. For more information about our company, please visit: http://www.discoverylandco.com .

jobs.title: Specialist, Business Analysis & Support
jobs.description: Office: Office of Data and Technology Date Posted: 10/13/2026 Salary Range: 1\-5 / $87,024 \- $98,195 NTE Date: N/A **Position Overview** The mission of the Office of Data and Technology is to support schools and the district as a whole to use technology and data effectively to accelerate student achievement. The Office includes the following teams: * The **Information Technology** team provides DCPS students and staff in every school with the infrastructure, systems, and support to use technology effectively to accelerate student achievement. * The **Data** team ensures stakeholders at all levels of the organization have access to accurate, timely, and relevant data, conducting analysis and research, and building school\-based capacity to use data tools to inform planning and decision\-making. * The **Enterprise Application** team leads the district’s efforts to ensure all DCPS students and staff, in every school, have application technology and systems needed to be successful. The Specialist, Business Analysis \& Support serves as a key liaison between program stakeholders and technical teams, supporting the successful delivery of data and technology solutions across DCPS. This role is responsible for facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business needs, coordinating project activities, and supporting implementation efforts. The Specialist works closely with the Manager, Technical Projects to ensure solutions are aligned with stakeholder needs, technical feasibility, and district priorities. The Specialist will be part of a Technical Projects Management (TPM) team that works with cross\-functional teams, including application developers, data specialists, program teams, and office leaders, to deliver high\-impact solutions such as enterprise applications, dashboards, and data storage solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong project management and project coordination experience, an understanding of K\-12 education data systems and technology needs, and business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and requirements documentation skills. This individual demonstrates exceptional organizational discipline and is skilled at maintaining project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, and project documentation across multiple concurrent initiatives. The Specialist, Business Analysis \& Support will report to the Manager, Technical Projects. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** *The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing of all responsibilities, duties, and/or skills required. Other duties may be assigned.* * **Business Analysis \& Solution Planning** + Lead requirements gathering activities through interviews, workshops, process mapping, and stakeholder engagement. + Document business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and related project artifacts. + Translate business requirements into actionable work items for development teams. + Partner with the Manager, Technical Projects on requirements discovery and solution planning for complex, cross\-functional initiatives. * **Project Management** + Coordinate and support activities throughout the project lifecycle for data systems and technology products developed by ODT, including planning, requirements development, testing, implementation, and post\-deployment support. + Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, action logs, and status reports to ensure transparency, accountability, and alignment across project teams. Work with cross\-functional teams on projects using proven methodologies for structured planning and execution, while applying Agile/Scrum practices to foster iterative development, stakeholder collaboration, and rapid delivery cycles. + Coordinate project dependencies, milestones, and release activities across multiple initiatives to support successful program delivery. * **Stakeholder Engagement** + Work closely with software developers, data engineers, and QA teams to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and alignment with district priorities. + Collaborate with program stakeholders and technical teams to define project goals, business requirements, delivery timelines, and success metrics. + Support the Technical Projects Management team in translating DCPS programmatic needs into technical requirements and product features. + Facilitate project meetings, requirement workshops, status reviews, user demonstrations, and stakeholder feedback sessions. + Serve as a primary point of contact for project stakeholders, ensuring timely communication of decisions, risks, actions, and project outcomes. * **Technical Oversight** + Coordinate with application developers and data engineers to ensure product alignment to defined business requirements. + Coordinate quality assurance and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities, ensuring business requirements are validated and documented prior to release. + Maintain project documentation, templates, standards, and governance artifacts to improve consistency, transparency, and delivery effectiveness across ODT initiatives. + Work with ODT technical teams to establish and maintain release schedules, change management processes, and deployment strategies in collaboration with software and data engineering teams. * **Continuous Improvement** + Monitor product usage and impact; gather feedback for iterative improvements. + Collaborate with the Technical Projects Management team to design and implement repeatable processes for project intake, prioritization, and execution to improve efficiency and transparency. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree and three to five years of related work experience. * Master's degree preferred. * Previous exposure to or experience in the education sector a plus. * Demonstrated experience coordinating technology, data, or operational projects from initiation through implementation. * Strong understanding of project management methodologies, Agile practices, software development lifecycles, and change management principles. * Experience eliciting, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements throughout a project lifecycle. * Strong understanding of education data systems (e.g., SIS, LMS, assessment platforms) and data governance principles. * Ability to facilitate meetings, manage competing priorities, track dependencies, and coordinate stakeholders across multiple workstreams. * Crisp verbal and written communication is a must. * Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Trello). * Adept at navigating fast\-paced, ambiguous environments independently—such as managing shifting priorities, unclear requirements, or evolving stakeholder expectations. **DCPS Values** --------------- * **STUDENTS FIRST**: We recognize students as whole children and put their needs first in everything we do. * **COURAGE**: We have the audacity to learn from our successes and failures, to try new things, and to lead the nation as a proof point of PK\-12 success. * **EQUITY**: We work proactively to eliminate opportunity gaps by interrupting institutional bias and investing in effective strategies to ensure every student succeeds. * **EXCELLENCE**: We work with integrity and hold ourselves accountable for exemplary outcomes, service, and interactions. * **TEAMWORK**: We recognize that our greatest asset is our collective vision and ability to work collaboratively and authentically. * **JOY**: We enjoy our collective work and will enthusiastically celebrate our success and each other. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodation and/or application assistance is available upon request at all stages of the application and employment process. To request accommodation, please contact dcps.eeo\-ada@k12\.dc.gov.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, New PhD Graduate
jobs.description: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It's a big mission, and that's where you come in! At Duolingo, you'll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact\-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You'll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world\-class minds — while doing work that's both meaningful and fun. Join our life\-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. Read our blog to learn more. **About the role...** **You will...** * Solve our most ambitious problems with the right tool for the task * Collaborate cross\-functionally to bring your ideas to life in the product * Identify problems, prototype solutions, evaluate their return on investment, and then implement the best solution at scale to improve the lives of our millions of learners each day * Share your findings both within Duolingo as well as to the broader research community **✅ You have...** * You have an Ph.D. in computer science or related technical field (or expect to by August 2027\) * A portfolio of impactful work, in the form of (for example) publications, open\-source projects, or AI internships * Ability to relocate to Pittsburgh, PA or New York, NY * A creative, interdisciplinary, and entrepreneurial approach to R\&D * Strong debugging and critical thinking skills **❤️ Why you'll love working here...** * Language learning opportunities * Catered in\-house lunches and breakfast * Company\-wide Hackathon * PTO and company holidays * Frequent company\-wide dinners, monthly celebrations, social clubs, and so much more! **Benefits:** Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well\-being with our benefits here. **Job Alerts:** Sign up for job alerts here. **Accommodations:** We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. **Fraud Warning:** Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double\-check these details before sharing any information. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer – AI Code Evaluation (Remote)
jobs.description: **Company Description** Our client is a leading organization in the artificial intelligence industry, collaborating with top technology companies and AI research teams to advance the development of next\-generation AI systems. The company is seeking talented software engineers to contribute to innovative projects focused on evaluating AI\-generated code, solving complex programming challenges, and improving the reasoning, accuracy, and performance of advanced AI models. This opportunity offers the flexibility of remote contract work, competitive compensation, and the chance to contribute to cutting\-edge artificial intelligence initiatives alongside highly skilled technical professionals. **Job Description** Our client is seeking talented Junior Software Engineers to participate in an innovative artificial intelligence initiative focused on improving the quality, accuracy, and technical capabilities of advanced AI models. This fully remote, contract\-based opportunity is designed for software engineers with experience at leading technology companies who are interested in applying their programming knowledge to real\-world AI development challenges. Selected professionals will evaluate AI\-generated code, develop complex programming challenges, analyze technical solutions, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, efficiency, maintainability, and overall software quality. * Develop challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases. * Review and assess AI\-generated technical reasoning involving algorithms, data structures, debugging, software architecture, and system design. * Identify errors, inefficiencies, and potential improvements in AI\-generated software solutions. * Provide clear, detailed, and actionable written technical feedback to support continuous AI model improvement. * Apply software engineering best practices to assess code quality and technical decision\-making. * Contribute to projects focused on advancing the capabilities of next\-generation AI systems. **Position Details** * **Job Title:** Junior Software Engineer – AI Code Evaluation * **Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote * **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor * **Compensation:** USD $150–$200 per hour * **Available Opportunities:** Up to 100 positions * **Preferred Location:** United States and other English\-speaking countries * **Industry:** Artificial Intelligence / Software Engineering **Why Consider This Opportunity?** This position offers software engineers the opportunity to apply their technical expertise to advanced artificial intelligence projects while working remotely. Candidates will contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI\-generated software, gaining exposure to emerging technologies and complex engineering challenges. **Join an exciting initiative helping shape the future of AI\-powered software development.** **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Minimum of **1 year of professional experience as a Software Engineer at a leading technology company**, with at least part of that experience gained within the last 3 years. * Strong programming fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, debugging, and code optimization. * Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, and software engineering best practices. * Ability to review, evaluate, and identify errors or inefficiencies in complex code. * Experience analyzing technical solutions and assessing code correctness, quality, and maintainability. * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and provide detailed feedback. * Ability to work independently in a fully remote, contractor\-based environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working at a top\-tier technology company or within a highly technical software engineering environment. * Based in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, or another English\-speaking country. * Experience conducting code reviews, developing technical assessments, or designing programming challenges. * Familiarity with evaluating AI\-generated code or working with AI\-assisted software development tools. * Ability to create challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases. * Strong understanding of software engineering concepts involving algorithms, debugging, architecture, and system design. **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are particularly interested in software engineers who have gained hands\-on experience at leading technology organizations and can demonstrate strong technical judgment, programming proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex engineering concepts clearly. Candidates should be comfortable evaluating sophisticated software solutions, identifying technical weaknesses, and contributing to the improvement of advanced AI systems. **Important:** This opportunity is intended for engineers with relevant professional experience. Recent graduates without qualifying software engineering experience may not meet the selection criteria. **Additional Information** **Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor **Compensation:** USD $150–$200 per hour **Open Positions:** Up to 100 opportunities **Preferred Locations:** United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and other English\-speaking countries. **About the Opportunity** This is a project\-based opportunity for software engineers interested in contributing to advanced artificial intelligence development. Selected candidates will work remotely on technical assignments involving AI\-generated code evaluation, software engineering challenges, debugging, and technical reasoning. **Application and Selection Process** Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an application and may be required to participate in technical assessments to demonstrate their software engineering knowledge, analytical capabilities, and written communication skills. Participation in the selection process does not guarantee an assignment or contract offer. **Important Considerations** * Candidates must have relevant professional software engineering experience. * Previous employment at a leading technology company is an important selection criterion. * Strong written English communication skills are essential. * Applicants should be comfortable working independently and providing detailed technical evaluations. * Final selection, compensation, project assignments, and contractual terms are subject to client evaluation and approval.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description: We are looking for a visionary and hands\-on **Senior Data Architect** to lead our data modeling, integration patterns, and semantic dataset initiatives. In this role, you will be the bridge between traditional data engineering and cutting\-edge AI systems. You will work side\-by\-side with our AI Engineers to design agent\-ready datasets and Model Context Protocol (MCP) data\-access patterns, while partnering with Data Engineers to establish robust, scalable ingestion, transformation, quality, and monitoring standards. If you are passionate about multi\-cloud cost, usage, resource, and financial datasets, and love architecting clean, scalable analytical engines in Google Cloud (GCP) / BigQuery, we want to hear from you. Req\# 1104608458 **Responsibilities** * Data Architecture \& Modeling: Define the target data architecture for multi\-cloud cost, usage, resource, contract, financial, metadata, and operational datasets. Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models optimized for BigQuery analytical workloads * Documentation \& Governance: Create source\-to\-target mappings, transformation rules, data contracts, lineage documentation, and business definitions. Define clear ownership boundaries across raw, standardized, curated, and analytics\-ready data layers * Semantic \& Domain Modeling: Establish canonical entities, domain models, semantic datasets, and reusable dimensions for traditional reporting as well as modern AI\-agent use cases * Integration \& Ingestion Design: Design integration patterns for APIs, files, databases, event streams, and semi\-structured enterprise data. Ensure data is properly mapped, normalized, and reconciled * AI \& Agent Readiness: Partner with AI Engineers to design safe, discoverable, read\-only BigQuery datasets and MCP tools for agent access. Define query and schema standards that enable reliable agent reasoning, structured responses, analytics, and recommendations * Performance \& Cost Optimization: Review SQL queries, data pipelines, schemas, and integration designs for quality, scalability, maintainability, performance, and cost efficiency. Define BigQuery best practices for partitioning, clustering, materialized views, and query optimization * Data Governance \& Leadership: Establish governance standards for lineage, ownership, access control, retention, data classification, quality, and freshness. Participate in architecture and code reviews, offering technical leadership across the data domain **Requirements** * Experience: Strong professional background in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or backend/data platform development * Data Modeling: Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, canonical, and domain\-oriented data modeling * Cloud Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills and hands\-on experience designing large\-scale analytical datasets, data marts, and multi\-source integration pipelines, specifically using Google Cloud BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses) * GCP Ecosystem: Strong GCP knowledge, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, service accounts, Pub/Sub, and GKE integration patterns * Mapping \& Specifications: Proven ability to produce source\-to\-target mappings, transformation specifications, data contracts, and lineage documentation * Performance Tuning: Expertise in BigQuery partitioning, clustering, performance tuning, and cost\-efficient query design * Programming \& Integration: Hands\-on Python experience for data services, Proofs of Concept (POCs), transformations, or API integrations. Experience with REST APIs, event\-driven integration, batch processing, and semi\-structured data * Governance \& Security: Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, reconciliation, schema evolution, and least\-privilege access patterns * Collaboration \& Review: Experience conducting architecture reviews, mentoring engineers, and driving consensus across cross\-functional technical teams **We offer** * Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (Subsidized) * Health Savings Account * Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability (Company Provided) * Life and AD\&D Insurance (Company Provided) * Employee Assistance Program * Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions * Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Paid Time Off – the employee will be eligible to accrue 15\-25 paid days, depending on specific level and tenure with EPAM (accrual eligibility may change over time) * Paid Holidays \- nine (9\) total per year * Legal Plan and Identity Theft Protection * Accident Insurance * Employee Discounts * Pet Insurance * Employee Stock Purchase Program * If otherwise eligible, participation in the discretionary annual bonus program * If otherwise eligible and hired into a qualifying level, participation in the discretionary Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) Program **This Remote Position Cannot be Performed in New York City.** EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our clients, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential. Engineer the Future with a Career at EPAM This posting includes a good faith range of the salary EPAM would reasonably expect to pay the selected candidate. The range provided reflects base salary only. Individual compensation offers within the range are based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to: geographic location, experience, credentials, education, training; the demand for the role; and overall business and labor market considerations. Most candidates are hired at a salary within the range disclosed. Salary range: $170,000 \- $210,000\. In addition, the details highlighted in this job posting above are a general description of all other expected benefits and compensation for the position. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. Candidates with existing transferable H\-1B status may be considered. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Transportation Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Lochner and Egis are entering an exciting new chapter as one organization. We have combined decades of trusted U.S. engineering expertise with the global reach, technical excellence, and career opportunities of a leading international engineering, consulting, and infrastructure firm. While our name has changed, our commitment to our people, clients, and communities is stronger than ever. At Egis, every project is an opportunity to create lasting impact. We collaborate with public and private clients to design and deliver innovative transportation, aviation, rail, transit, water, structural, environmental, and infrastructure solutions that connect communities and improve everyday life.
