jobs.title: Software Engineer- Full Stack
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Full Stack Software Engineer – Software Product Engineering Come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems that help patients! The Software Product Engineering team is looking for a full stack engineer. Are you determined to own and complete complicated and technically ambitious work? Are you passionate about technology, with extensive full stack development experience across both front\-end and back\-end systems? Our team is actively adopting AI across the development lifecycle to help us build better software, faster, and we're looking for engineers who are excited to be part of that evolution while bringing strong engineering fundamentals. If so, please apply. **What You'll Be Doing:** As part of a collaborative team of versatile engineers, you will build reusable, composable software components, taking them from design and requirement specifications through implementation, testing, and integration into Software Product Engineering's next\-generation platform ecosystem. By continuously improving the design, building for maintainability, and ensuring the product meets both business and patient needs, your work will transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. **How You'll Succeed :** * Develop, test, and deploy components into provisioned cloud platform environments through automated Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD) processes. * Review and implement technical designs, translating them into APIs, user interfaces, libraries, and services across a range of programming languages while adhering to Lilly's architecture, design, implementation, and security standards. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate design exploration, implementation, testing, and debugging, while owning the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. * Build and integrate AI capabilities into products, such as LLM\-powered features and agent tools, where they improve patient and user outcomes. * Build working knowledge of medical device delivery models and quality systems, including GxP expectations, to ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements and timelines. * Integrate open source and licensed components into larger solutions, making practical reuse decisions and ensuring dependencies are sourced through approved enterprise channels (e.g., Artifactory) and meet security and licensing requirements. * Investigate and propose solutions to development and design problems through open collaboration and healthy debate, including scope estimation and forecasting. * Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, stakeholders, and vendors within the team and across Lilly. * Establish strong relationships with technical leaders and architects to influence technology direction for Software Product Engineering platforms and products. * Practice effective source control, code review, and collaborative programming to drive high\-quality outcomes. * Partner with data professionals to implement database and data warehousing solutions. * Complete projects with minimal supervision and direction. **What You Should Bring :** * Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications using containerized services and microservices architectures on AWS or Azure. * Exposure to large\-scale architectural patterns, ideally with hands\-on experience implementing event\-driven systems using Apache Kafka (or similar) for scalable, resilient processing. * Strong object\-oriented programming skills, excellent debugging skills, and expertise with data serialization, REST APIs, and version control. * Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) for building front\-end and back\-end services, along with HTML, CSS, and SASS; Python experience is a plus. * Experience building applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, or Nuxt) and modern build tooling (e.g., Vite, Webpack). * Familiarity with build automation and containerization technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your development workflow; familiarity with LLM application patterns such as RAG, tool use, or MCP is a plus. * A proven track record of Agile software development, demonstrated through a portfo tems * Experience with multiple languages (polyglot programming), including JavaScript/TypeScript or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) * Professional experience delivering software solutions across the full development life cycle, including project initiation, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, support, and retirement * Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1\. Additional Information Position based in San Francisco, California with a hybrid work model. About the organization Tech @ Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Tech @ Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. Lilly's Software Product Engineering (SPE) organization is focused on building core foundational software platforms to accelerate our ability to reach and support patients, digitally. This organization is powered by software engineering experts that solve challenging problems around patient engagement and drug discovery with code. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $66,000 \- $158,400 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: AI Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry\-leading expertise and its unified *E360 RCM*™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M\+ processed claims, and expert human\-in\-the\-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out\-of\-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data\-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi\-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's \#1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest\-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years. **Position Summary** The **AI Engineer** is a hands\-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting. The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form. * Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders. * Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions. * Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation. * Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers. * Train and fine\-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO. * Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage. * Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice. * Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting. * Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks. * Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing. * Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write\-ups. * Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on. ### **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning language models. * Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it. * Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques. * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-based agents or multi\-turn systems. * Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held\-out sets and automated grading. * Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely. * Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners. * Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred. * Experience training models to produce structured or schema\-constrained output is highly preferred. * Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred. * Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred. * Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred. * Publications or open\-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine\-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred. * Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred. * Timely and regular attendance. * Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered * To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites** * Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. * This is a 100% hands\-on individual contributor role. The AI Engineer owns experiments from design through code, training, and results. * Expect roughly half of the role to focus on reinforcement learning and model training, with the remainder split between knowledge engineering, data analysis, and evaluation. * Success requires sustained, close collaboration with domain experts and a genuine working understanding of the subject matter. * The underlying knowledge evolves over time. The AI Engineer must design data, training, and evaluation approaches that adapt to change without starting over. * All work must comply with HIPAA and EnableComp data policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data wherever possible. *EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.* EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you. ***Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying:*** *“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.”* – Revenue Specialist *“I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented an* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Endiatx** Endiatx is a medical device company developing microrobotic systems for diagnostic use inside the human body. Our flagship platform, PillBot™, is a propeller\-driven endoscopic capsule designed to enable real\-time visualization of the stomach without traditional endoscopy. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators building a new category of medical diagnostics at the intersection of robotics, imaging, and AI. **Role Summary** We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to lead development and deployment of our endoscopic image analysis systems. This role owns the full ML lifecycle—from data strategy through production deployment—and contributes directly to how our devices interpret and interact with the physical world. You will work on computer vision models for gastric imagery, image enhancement under constrained in vivo conditions, and perception systems supporting navigation and localization. You will collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and simulation teams to integrate ML into a real\-world medical device system. This is a mid\-level role with significant ownership and the opportunity to mentor junior contributors. **What You Will Do** \- Own the end\-to\-end ML pipeline: data curation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring \- Design, train, and validate computer vision models using frameworks such as PyTorch \- Develop image enhancement pipelines \- Optimize models for performance across accuracy, latency, and compute constraints \- Implement neural compression techniques \- Build and maintain dataset infrastructure \- Deploy models into production environments with CI/CD and monitoring \- Contribute to localization and pose estimation \- Support perception systems for navigation and scene understanding \- Collaborate with simulation and visualization teams \- Mentor interns and junior engineers \- Communicate technical work clearly **Required Qualifications** \- 4\+ years of ML engineering experience or equivalent \- Experience deploying production computer vision models \- Strong foundation in deep learning \- Proficiency in Python and PyTorch \- Experience with MLOps tools \- Strong software engineering fundamentals \- Strong communication skills \- Experience in image enhancement, compression, or perception systems **Nice to Have** \- Medical imaging experience (e.g., DICOM) \- C\# or Unity familiarity \- SLAM or localization experience \- Robotics or autonomous systems experience **Location** On\-site in Hayward, CA. Limited hybrid flexibility. **Compensation** $130,000 – $180,000 base salary, plus equity and benefits. **Work Authorization** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. **Equal Opportunity** Endiatx is an equal opportunity employer. **Accommodations** Reasonable accommodations provided. **Employment Status** At\-will employment. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Experience: * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch: 2 years (Required) * Deep learning: 1 year (Required) * MLOps tools: 1 year (Required) * image enhancement, compression, or perception systems: 1 year (Required) * Machine Learning engineering: 4 years (Required) * deploying production computer vision models: 3 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Devices Team is responsible for the creation and lifecycle management of IoT devices enrolled in EnergyHub programs used to balance the power grid. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a core platform that enables other internal teams to build new features and functionality quickly. This is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real\-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future. We are continuing our journey to migrate from a monolithic to a microservices architecture and deliver well defined APIs to the broader organization. The primary focus is to integrate any Distributed Energy Resource (DER) into our platform in a way that enables multiple use cases without compromising quality and scalability. As a senior engineer, you support our mission by helping drive major initiatives, providing expertise and guidance from past industry experience, and autonomously developing high\-quality solutions that balance multiple constraints while ensuring long\-term flexibility. Main Responsibilities: What you'll do * Design and implement core platform features that solve for multiple constraints and use cases. * Help drive the transition from a monolithic architecture to a microservices\-based approach, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and improved system resilience. * Lead technical initiatives and provide data modeling, contract definition, and API development. * Develop front and back end solutions, ensuring well\-structured, high\-quality code with automated testing. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product managers, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders to drive high\-impact projects. * Work within real\-world constraints to develop creative solutions that maintain platform flexibility and scalability. * Contribute to best practices for CI/CD, data modeling, and iterative development (e.g.,PoCs, rapid prototyping, milestone\-based execution). * Mentor and support other engineers, fostering a strong technical culture of respect, open communication, and collaboration. Required Skills and Experience: What you need * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong full\-stack development experience, including frontend, backend, and relational database modeling and development. * Proficiency in React and Java (preferably Java 11\+). * Experience with web services, gRPC/RESTful APIs, and contract\-driven development. * Ability to operate independently, help provide technical vision and guide the team toward scalable solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills, capable of balancing multiple use cases while enabling flexibility. * Proven expertise in building dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript. * Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools in development and testing to accelerate delivery and enhance code quality. * Strong communication skills, with an emphasis on cross\-functional collaboration and working on challenging technical problems. Preferred Skills and Experience: Nice\-to\-haves * Experience with PostgreSQL, Asynchronous messaging (SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ), MongoDB, AWS, Datadog, and Robot Framework. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices. * Proven ability to deliver high\-quality, iterative value while maintaining execution speed. * Experience or familiarity with energy industry Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time. **Why work for EnergyHub?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people:** Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other. * **Make an immediate impact:** New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team! * **Gain well rounded experience:** EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. * **Work with the latest technologies:** You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault\-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs. * **Be part of something important:** Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate. **About EnergyHub** EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power. To learn more, visit energyhub.com. **Company Benefits** EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program. **EnergyHub is an Equal Opportunity Employer** EOE, Including Disability/Vets. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact accommodations.apply@energyhub.net. In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government\-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, and demographic information. jobs.title: Senior Information Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.** Job Description : **This is a full\-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S** We are hiring a Senior Information Systems Engineer to build and support engineering and automation of our End User Computing (EUC) platform. You will manage Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, deliver virtual desktops on Amazon Workspaces, and automate the work end to end with scripting, the Microsoft Graph API and Ansible. This is a hands\-on senior role. You will resolve escalated L2/L3 issues, replace manual processes with code, and mentor L1 support staff. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ **Endpoint management (Microsoft Intune)** * Design, build and maintain Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, app deployments and update rings for Windows devices. * Automate device, app and policy management through the Microsoft Graph API, including bulk changes, reporting and audit exports. * Manage Windows Autopilot enrolment and zero\-touch provisioning for new and refreshed devices. * Integrate Intune with Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, groups and identity lifecycle processes. **Virtual desktops (Amazon Workspaces)** * Build and maintain Amazon Workspaces bundles, custom images and directory integration. * Automate Workspaces provisioning, patching, rebuilding and decommissioning through the AWS CLI, SDKs or APIs. * Monitor Workspaces performance, cost and utilization, and right\-size running modes and bundles. * Apply AWS security controls such as IAM, security groups, IP access control groups and encryption. **Automation and configuration management** * Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python and Bash to automate repeatable EUC tasks. * Develop Ansible playbooks and roles for endpoint and virtual desktop configuration, patching and compliance. * Store code in Git, follow peer review, and run automation through CI/CD pipelines where suitable. **Operations and support** * Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for complex endpoint, application and virtual desktop incidents. * Run root\-cause analysis on recurring issues and deliver permanent fixes. * Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles. * Mentor L1 engineers and service desk staff and contribute to EUC standards and roadmap. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years in IT systems engineering, with at least 3 years focused on End User Computing. * **Scripting:** strong PowerShell skills, plus working knowledge of Python and/or Bash for automation and API integration. * **Microsoft Intune with API:** hands\-on Intune administration at scale, and proven automation through the Microsoft Graph API (authentication via app registrations, REST calls, paging and throttling). * **Ansible Nice to have:** experience writing playbooks, roles and inventories to manage Windows * **Amazon Workspaces:** experience deploying and operating Workspaces, including bundles, custom images, directory services and lifecycle automation. * Solid grounding in Windows 10/11 and Entra ID / Active Directory, Group Policy and core networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN). * Experience with Git version control and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. * Exposure to other VDI/DaaS platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or Citrix. * Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines (CIS, Microsoft Security Baselines). * Packaging experience with Win32 apps, MSIX or PSAppDeployToolkit. * Relevant certifications, for example: Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or SysOps Administrator – Associate, and Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation (Nice to Have) **Skills and attributes** ------------------------- * An automation\-first mindset: you script a task the second time you do it. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical users. * Structured troubleshooting and calm ownership of high\-impact incidents. * Comfortable working independently and setting technical direction for a small team. Benefits: We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $91,000 \- $110,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education. *The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.* Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-FP1

jobs.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise Electrical is seeking a **Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer** to provide technical ownership of the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, identity and access management, endpoint management, network infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, and data protection and recovery capabilities. As Enterprise Electrical continues to expand its internal IT department, this role will be responsible for designing, administering, documenting, and continuously improving secure, reliable technology infrastructure that supports corporate offices, company facilities, and active construction job sites. Working closely with the company’s Managed Service Provider (MSP), the Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer establishes infrastructure standards, guides security and operational improvements, coordinates technical projects, and ensures that systems align with business objectives, cybersecurity requirements, and operational needs. This role serves as the organization's internal infrastructure subject matter expert, focusing on architecture, security, resilience, governance, and long\-term technology strategy while supporting escalated operational issues as needed. Key Responsibilities Microsoft 365, Identity \& Endpoint Management * Design, administer, and maintain Microsoft 365 tenant architecture and configuration standards across Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Intune. * Manage identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, role changes, offboarding, guest access, directory services, and hybrid synchronization where applicable. * Administer least\-privilege access models, privileged roles, service accounts, emergency access procedures, and MSP administrative access. * Design, test, deploy, and maintain Conditional Access policies supporting multifactor authentication (MFA), device compliance, location\-based policies, and risk\-based access controls. * Manage Microsoft Intune enrollment, Autopilot deployments, compliance policies, security baselines, application deployment, endpoint protection, encryption, and update management. * Configure and maintain Microsoft Defender for Office 365 capabilities, including anti\-phishing, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, quarantine management, and email security standards. * Implement and support Microsoft Purview capabilities, including sensitivity labels, retention policies, data loss prevention (DLP), and information governance controls. * Monitor Microsoft Secure Score, tenant health, and security recommendations while prioritizing remediation initiatives based on business risk. Security \& Operational Resilience * Develop and maintain security baselines across identities, endpoints, servers, networks, and email systems using industry best practices and security frameworks. * Translate cyber insurance requirements and customer security obligations into enforceable technical controls. * Administer endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and security monitoring processes. * Coordinate security investigations, alert triage, containment activities, and remediation efforts with the MSP. * Conduct recurring privileged access reviews and account audits for employees, vendors, guest users, service accounts, and MSP personnel. * Maintain incident response documentation, technical runbooks, and recovery procedures. * Participate in tabletop exercises, security reviews, and operational readiness assessments. * Prepare security posture reports, technical evidence, client security questionnaires, and cyber insurance documentation. Network \& Server Infrastructure * Configure and maintain firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, routers, VLANs, segmentation policies, PoE systems, and secure remote access solutions. * Support job\-site connectivity solutions, including LTE/5G deployments, failover configurations, temporary offices, and construction trailers. * Assess and optimize wireless coverage across offices, warehouses, fabrication facilities, and project locations. * Administer cloud and on\-premises server environments, virtualization platforms, directory services, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure services. * Monitor server health, availability, capacity, patch compliance, and configuration standards. * Coordinate infrastructure projects, maintenance windows, upgrades, and change management activities with internal stakeholders and the MSP. Backup, Recovery \& Business Continuity * Administer backup and recovery solutions supporting servers, business\-critical systems, and Microsoft 365 workloads within approved recovery scopes. * Monitor backup performance and proactively address failures or protection gaps. * Maintain backup security controls and recovery access protections. * Perform and document scheduled restore testing and recovery validation exercises. * Support disaster recovery planning, recovery time objectives (RTOs), recovery point objectives (RPOs), and business continuity initiatives. Servic ring, or distributed workforce environments. * Familiarity with construction software platforms such as: * + Vista + Sage 300 CRE + Foundation + Procore + Accubid Leadership \& Team Collaboration * Partner with IT leadership to develop and implement infrastructure strategies and operational standards. * Serve as the primary internal technical counterpart to the company’s Managed Service Provider (MSP). * Coordinate infrastructure projects and change management activities across business units. * Lead infrastructure planning, technical reviews, and operational improvement initiatives. * Collaborate with department leaders, business stakeholders, vendors, and project teams. * Provide technical guidance and direction to MSP personnel and project resources within delegated authority. * This position has no direct employee supervisory responsibilities. Work Environment Work Environment * Primarily based onsite in the Houston office. * Occasional travel to company locations, warehouses, fabrication facilities, and active construction job sites. * Frequent interaction with technology equipment, infrastructure systems, vendors, and business stakeholders. * Jobsite visits may involve noise, dust, uneven terrain, varying temperatures, and active construction operations. * Compliance with all company safety policies and PPE requirements is required during field visits. Physical Requirements * Prolonged periods of computer and workstation use. * Ability to inspect, configure, troubleshoot, and connect network and IT equipment. * Ability to move throughout office environments, facilities, and construction sites. * Ability to occasionally lift, move, or install computers, networking equipment, and related devices. * Ability to travel as required to support business and infrastructure operations. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Schedule \& Travel * Full\-time position. * Primarily works standard business hours onsite. * Occasional evening, weekend, and after\-hours maintenance activities may be required. * Participation in infrastructure upgrades, project deployments, and critical incident response may require schedule flexibility. * Travel may be required based on operational and project needs. * Additional hours may be necessary to support outages, projects, maintenance activities, and business priorities. Equipment \& Technology * Desktop and laptop computers. * Mobile devices and tablets. * Microsoft 365 Administration Center. * Microsoft Entra ID. * Microsoft Intune. * Microsoft Defender security platforms. * Microsoft Purview. * Server and virtualization platforms. * Managed switches, firewalls, wireless access points, routers, cellular gateways, and UPS systems. * Backup and recovery platforms. * Remote administration and monitoring tools. * Ticketing and service management platforms. * Documentation and knowledge management systems. * Secure password and credential management tools. * Standard office equipment and approved network testing tools. * Required personal protective equipment (PPE) when visiting jobsites. What We Value At **Enterprise Electrical**, we are committed to: * Safety First, Safety Always * Committed to Excellence * Plan It, Do It, Own It * Learn It, Know It, Teach It * One Team, One Goal * Positive Attitude Required **Our Core Purpose:** Building Relationships to Enrich Lives Apply Today If you are an experienced infrastructure professional passionate about cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, enterprise networking, and operational excellence, we encourage you to apply for the **Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer** position at Enterprise Electrical. This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of the company's internal IT operations, strengthen cybersecurity posture, build scalable infrastructure, and support a growing organization operating across corporate offices, facilities, and active construction projects.

jobs.title: Facilities Engineering Operations Lead, Data Center
jobs.description: **About Etched** Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** Etched is building a new category of AI hardware: frontier inference clusters. As our Facilities Engineering Operations Lead, you will own day\-to\-day operations of our AI data center: uptime, incident response, and escalation across power, cooling, and the white space. You'll be the first hire in this function and will build the operating system from scratch, including procedures, maintenance programs, on\-call, and alarming, then turn it into the playbook we copy to every site that follows. **Key Responsibilities** * Own day\-to\-day data center operations end to end: uptime, incident response, and escalation for power, cooling, and the white space. * Build the operating system from scratch: SOPs, MOPs, and EOPs; change management; preventive and predictive maintenance schedules; shift coverage and on\-call; incident and RCA process. * Define SLOs and response plans for outage events at the fleet, rack, and server level. * Run the liquid cooling plant for high\-density racks, including CDUs, secondary fluid loops, water chemistry and filtration, leak detection, and flow and inlet\-temperature monitoring. * Own electrical operations, including switchgear, busway and PDUs, power connector topology, load balancing across racks, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) and arc\-flash safety. * Manage electrical, mechanical, CDU OEM, and fire/life safety vendors and contractors: scope work, review quotes, and oversee onsite work. * Stand up monitoring and alarming with engineering across BMS/DCIM and rack and CDU telemetry, so problems reach the right person within minutes, not hours. * Run rack deployment logistics: receiving, staging, install, commissioning, and turn\-up handoff to the hardware and lab teams, plus decommissioning and RMA flows. * Track spares and critical parts inventory for facility equipment. * Report operational metrics to leadership, including uptime, PUE, incidents, open risks, and capacity headroom. * Help build the team, starting with facilities engineering technicians and a BMS specialist. * Design processes and site\-readiness checklists that can be replicated at our next sites. **You may be a good fit if you have** * 4\-8\+ years in critical facilities and data center operations, including time as a Lead or Senior Critical Facilities Engineer or a single\-site Facilities Manager * Hands\-on experience operating liquid cooling in production (CDUs, direct\-to\-chip / DLC, secondary fluid loops) * Deep working knowledge of data center electrical distribution (switchgear, UPS, busway, PDUs) and safe work practices (LOTO, arc flash, NFPA 70E) * Experience writing and drilling SOPs, MOPs, and EOPs, and running change management and maintenance programs * Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis * A track record of managing mechanical, electrical, and fire/life safety vendors * Working knowledge of BMS, DCIM, and power monitoring systems * Readiness to own the whole site, not just a shift or a system * Deeply creative and able to think from first principles **Strong candidates may also have experience with** * Running high\-density GPU / AI infrastructure at a neocloud, hyperscaler, or colocation provider * Standing up a new site or data hall, including commissioning and turn\-up * Building and staffing 24/7 operations and on\-call rotations * Familiarity with modern ML and LLM model architectures * Ability to program with Python or another scripting language * Familiarity with AI tools for programming/coding * Startup experience or comfort working in fast\-paced environments **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage * $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **How we're different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed. This role is onsite in the Bay Area at our data center and Milpitas sites, with regular time at our San Jose headquarters. **Compensation Range** **$150,000 \- $250,000, plus equity**

Process Engineer** **Compensation: $70,000** **Fibergrate Composite Structures** is a leading manufacturer of fiberglass\-reinforced plastic (FRP) products and engineered composite solutions used in industrial, commercial, and infrastructure applications worldwide. For more than 60 years, Fibergrate has provided innovative composite products that deliver superior corrosion resistance, safety, and durability compared to traditional materials. **Founded in 1966,** Fibergrate pioneered molded fiberglass grating technology and has grown into a trusted global provider of composite structures, grating, handrail systems, stair solutions, and custom\-engineered products. The engineer will help solve production challenges, improve processes, and implement solutions that support safety, environmental compliance, product quality, cost control, and on\-time delivery. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Fusion is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join us in Woodbridge, NJ, helping build and scale the infrastructure behind our healthcare platform, someone who's as comfortable automating deployments as they are hardening CI/CD pipelines and keeping our systems reliable under real\-world load. You'll work closely with our engineering team to keep things running smoothly and securely, while helping us raise the bar on how we ship software. If you like owning infrastructure end to end and care about doing it right in a space where reliability actually matters, we'd love to talk. **About Fusion Health** Most healthcare software is built for the easy cases. Fusion Health builds for the rest. We support clinicians working in movement restricted communities, where care delivery is more complex and software reliability is critical. In these environments, systems need to work consistently because there is no room for failure. This has been our focus since 2006\. That is not an accident. It is who we hire. Bryan Jakovcic(EY Entrepreneur of the Year) built this company and still personally interviews every single person who joins it. Because the people here are not a department or a headcount. They are the company. Fusion has been recognized by INC as one of the fastest\-growing private companies in the United States for four consecutive years, including \#8 in New Jersey and \#38 in the NY Tri\-State area, and by Deloitte on its Fast 500 list of fastest\-growing technology companies in the United States. We are also proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work by Fortune!. That growth and recognition happened because the right people showed up and did something with it. We are driven, self aware, and we own what we do. That is the culture. No more, no less. If this is the kind of work you've been looking for, this is where you do the best work of your career. **What we offer:** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401K * Generous PTO **What You'll Do:** This role is vital to our organization's mission and growth, and if selected, you'll work on the following challenging and interesting projects: * Maintain our current GitLab CI pipelines while leading their migration to GitHub Actions, integrated with Octopus Deploy for releases, covering build, test, artifact publishing, and database deployments. * Plan, analyze, and migrate repositories, metadata, and version history from legacy platforms (GitLab, Octopus, etc) into GitHub Enterprise. * Develop and maintain Terraform for per\-client environments and reusable modules, with every change reviewed through merge requests and applied through the pipeline * Deploy and operate applications on Azure App Services and Azure Container Apps, and automate the build and deployment paths that move legacy VM\-hosted workloads onto them * Build and maintain container workflows, including tagging, package registry management, and promotion across environments * Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting in Datadog and Azure so deployment failures and performance regressions surface quickly * Participate in incident response and the on\-call rotation, run blameless post\-incident reviews, and automate fixes for recurring issues * Build security in the delivery pipeline (secrets handling, SAST, SCA, Managed Identity and Service Principal configuration, least privilege access, dependency scanning, etc) in partnership with security and compliance teams * Improve developer experience and delivery performance by standardizing pipeline templates, shortening build times, and tracking deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore service **Who You Are:** We believe in harnessing diverse talents and perspectives, and if you believe you have what it takes to excel in this role, we want to hear from you. We look forward to reviewing your application if you have the following qualifications and experience: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3 to 5 years of hands\-on DevOps, build and release, or site reliability experience, including at least 2 years in Azure * Experience building CI/CD pipelines with tools such as GitLab CI, Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions, including Git branching and merge request workflows * Strong Terraform skills and scripting ability in PowerShell, Bash, or Python * Working knowledge of the Azure services used in application delivery: App Services, Container Apps, Azure SQL, Managed Identity, and Azure Front Door * Hands\-on experience with building and deploying .NET applications through automated pipelines * Experience supporting production systems, including observability tooling, incident response, and on call * Understanding of DevSecOps practices: secrets management, least\-privilege access, identity configuration, and securing CI/CD pipelines * Ideal Fusionites are strong problem solvers who work independently, write clear documentation for pipelines and runbooks, share knowledge across teams, and bring a fun, energetic personality **Nice to Have:** * Hands\-on experience migrating .NET workloads from IIS on Windows VMs to Azure PaaS services such as App Services or Container Apps * Experience working with Azure networking, including VNETs, subnets, Network Security Groups, Application Gateway, and traffic routing and failover patterns * Exposure to Azure integration services such as Service Bus, Data Factory, or Logic Apps * Experience delivering in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST), including change control, audit trails, and access reviews * Microsoft Azure certification, ideally AZ\-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert) or AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator) **Additional Details:** * This is a Hybrid full time, salaried role based in our Woodbridge, NJ office. * Our normal hours of operation are Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM. * This position description is not intended to be exhaustive, and other duties may be assigned as they arise. * It is not expected that applicants have any familiarity with Fusion’s proprietary applications, Healthcare software, or Corrections/Public Health business processes. Qualified candidates will be able to demonstrate related experience and transferable skills that will work well with the Fusion team. * At this time, this position is not eligible for employment sponsorship. * Fusion is an equal employment opportunity employer. **Compensation:** * Salary Range: 120,000\-140,000 * At Fusion, our salary ranges are designed to be competitive within our size and industry. Compensation is just one component of a comprehensive total rewards package that also includes benefits, flexibility, and growth opportunities. * Individual pay decisions are informed by several factors, including location, experience, qualifications, skillset, and internal equity across the organization. While we expect most offers to fall within the stated range, each compensation decision is made thoughtfully, with consideration for both the candidate’s unique profile and our commitment to pay parity. *For Internal Use only: In reference to our Employee Referral Program,* ***this opening is: Level 4***

data\-intensive product, including model account and API tenancy management. **Why Join Us?** * A high\-performance culture * State\-of\-the\-art technology * Experience world\-class leadership * As a member of this team, you will work to execute thoughtful, data\-driven marketing campaigns that drive meaningful growth for the company. **Role Overview** GOAT Group is seeking a Marketing Engineer I to build the AI systems that run our marketing. This is an AI\-first role: we are hiring primarily for demonstrated ability to build with LLMs and agent tooling. Marketing knowledge and experience are preferred, but not required. Reporting to the AVP of Growth, you will work inside the Marketing team to replace manual, repetitive workflows with agents, pipelines, and internal tools. Your first focus is CRM and lifecycle automation, expanding into performance marketing and organic marketing over time. We expect strong candidates to arrive with more AI experience than marketing or engineering experience. If you have been shipping agents and can show us what they do, we will help you close the rest. **In this role, you will:** * Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that marketing teams use daily, taking them from prototype to production rather than stopping at a demo. * Automate campaign development in Braze, including template\-driven generation, reusable segmentation logic, product\-level personalization, and pre\-send QA. * Write evaluation suites that measure agent output for brand voice, factual grounding, and tone, and that catch regressions before they reach customers. * Maintain a version\-controlled library of prompts, skills, and agent definitions as shared team infrastructure. * Integrate marketing and product systems through APIs and MCP servers so agents can act on real GOAT data. * Train marketing partners on what you build, and track adoption and outcomes for everything you ship. **How Success Is Measured** Agents shipped into recurring use, hours of manual work returned to the marketing team, and measurable movement in the KPIs your systems touch. **We are looking for:** *Required Qualifications* * A demonstrated portfolio of AI builds: agents, LLM workflows, or internal tools you shipped that real people used. Personal projects, internships, and open\-source work count. Be prepared to walk us through one. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic or OpenAI, including prompt design, structured outputs, and tool use. * Practical experience with agent orchestration platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or Gumloop, and with AI development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. * Evaluation literacy: you can explain how you would know whether an AI system is working, and you have built or used evals to find out. * Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose programming language, Python preferred. You can read, debug, and modify code you did not write, and explain why your own code works. * Working knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, and JSON, plus comfort with Git and version control. * 1\-2 years of professional experience in any field. We are evaluating what you can build, not where you have worked. *Preferred Qualifications* * Exposure to a CRM or marketing automation platform. Braze (Liquid, Canvas, REST API) is most directly relevant. * Experience building simple internal interfaces with React, Streamlit, Retool, or similar. * SQL or experience querying a data warehouse. * Familiarity with RAG, context engineering, or building on structured product catalogs. * Interest in or knowledge of sneakers, streetwear, collectibles, and resale marketplaces **Growth and Development** You will receive direct mentorship from our AVP of Growth, and work alongside partners in Engineering and Marketing. GOAT Group uses geographic pay tiers based on the employee's home state to align compensation with market differences across the U.S. Hiring Range: Tier 1 (Includes states such as California, New York (including New York City), Washington, Illinois and other higher\-cost markets) $113,210 \- $130,000 USD Tier 2 \- (Includes mid\-cost markets across the U.S.) $90,300 \- $101,000 USD Tier 3 \- (All other U.S. locations) $80,000 \- $89,085 USD GOAT Group represents the leading platforms for authentic sneakers, apparel and accessories. Operating four distinct brands–GOAT, Flight Club, Grailed and alias–GOAT Group has a global community of more than 60 million members across 170 countries. GOAT is the global platform for the greatest products from the past, present and future. Since its founding in 2015, GOAT has become one of the leading and most trusted sneaker platforms in the world, and has expanded to offer apparel and accessories from select emerging, contemporary and iconic brands. Through its unique positioning between the primary and resale markets, the company offers styles across various time periods on its digital platforms and in its retail locations, while delivering products to over 60 million members across 170 countries. Established in New York City over 15 years ago, Flight Club revolutionized sneaker retail as the original consignment store for rare shoes. Carrying the rarest exclusives and collectible sneakers, Flight Club has evolved from a one\-stop sneaker destination, to a cultural hub for sneaker enthusiasts and novices alike. With three brick\-and\-mortar locations in New York City, Los Angeles and Miami, Flight Club remains the premier source for authentic, rare sneakers. Founded in 2013, Grailed is the leading community\-driven marketplace for rare luxury, streetwear and vintage fashion. The marketplace was built for enthusiasts, by enthusiasts, and features products from brands including Supreme, Raf Simons, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Prada and more. With a highly curated selection of resale pieces including inventory exclusive to the platform, Grailed makes fashion accessible. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., Franklin Templeton, Adage Capital Management, Ulysses Management, D1 Capital Partners, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Matrix Partners, Upfront Ventures, Webb Investment Network and Y Combinator. *GOAT Group will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, if applicable. jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT GLIMPSE** Glimpse is the leading AI platform for CPG brands \- automating critical back\-office workflows like deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application. Since launching in April 2024, we've grown from 0 to 200\+ customers, raised $52M from investors including a16z, 8VC and Y Combinator. Our AI agents retrieve deduction data, validate charges, automate cash application, and dispute invalid claims \- work that would take a full\-time employee years to complete. For a $1B CPG brand, a single Glimpse agent reviewed 17,000 deductions in under 24 hours, identifying over $10M in recoverable revenue. We're building the next\-generation suite of services for consumer brands and are looking for exceptional people to help us scale. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Glimpse is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The core of this role is ownership and execution. The Head of Information Security and IT sets the architecture and strategy and is building these systems out now. Your job is to operate and maintain them as they mature, with a hand in the build\-out alongside the Head of Information Security and IT. You'll partner on change management and on the projects that move IT forward, and you'll work alongside the Security team where the work overlaps. This is less about closing tickets and more about making sure the machinery IT runs on is accurate, governed, and improving. This is a good fit if you like owning things outright, you care about getting the details right when the details are what an auditor checks, and you'd rather build a durable process than fight the same problem twice. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Own MDM**. Run our Mac fleet in Iru, including configuration profiles, zero\-touch enrollment, custom scripts, and remediation. Manage the smaller Windows footprint we continue to support. MDM is yours to operate and improve, not just maintain. **Own the CMDB, asset data, and the Inventory**. Maintain Glimpse's source of truth for assets and systems: laptops, network hardware, office ISP details, and a working map of the systems we run. That includes owning the laptop inventory and peripherals stored in the IT room. You’ll own keeping the data accurate and reconciled against our IdP and HR systems, catching and resolving drift before it becomes an audit finding. **Own vendor management and renewals**. Track contracts, manage renewals before they lapse, handle license true\-ups, and keep our SaaS and hardware agreements current and accounted for. **Help maintain the compliance benchmarks**. Work with the Security team and the rest of IT to keep the IT side of our SOC 2 benchmarks in good shape: onboarding / offboarding rigor, access review cycles, and the evidence trail that makes those reviews defensible. **Administer and govern the SaaS stack**. Handle day\-to\-day administration and governance across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and our core tools: provisioning, settings, group and access hygiene, and keeping things clean enough to pass a review. **Keep documentation current**. You'll own or maintain a lot of systems and process, and the team keeps its documentation up to date as it goes. Runbooks, configuration records, and process docs are a real part of the job, not an afterthought. **Partner on change and projects**. Work with the Head of Information Security and IT on a lightweight change management and approval process for IT changes, and contribute to the IT projects and deployments that shape how the function grows. You'll take escalations from the Support team on the systems and tooling you own. **MUST HAVES** * 5\+ years in IT, including meaningful time in a senior operations, systems, or infrastructure role, with a track record of running IT systems at scale and the range to grow into broader ownership over time * Deep, hands\-on MDM ownership in Iru, Jamf Pro, or a similar cloud MDM, including configuration profiles, zero\-touch enrollment, and Bash scripting for macOS, plus enough Windows MDM familiarity to manage a small footprint * Strong identity and SaaS administration: day\-to\-day Okta ownership (application integrations, group and access management, real troubleshooting) and broad admin experience across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and a modern stack * Experience owning ITAM or a CMDB and the vendors behind it: asset tracking, inventory, contracts, renewals, and license management, keeping records honest across systems and vendors accountable to deliver * AI\-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster and handle volume more intelligently * Clear communicator who can hold a process line without making IT feel like a blocker **NICE TO HAVES** * Have worked with Iru specifically, or launched an MDM from scratch * Have a Jamf certification * Hold a security or ITIL\-related certification ITIL Foundation, or anything on the security and compliance side) * Have built automations in Okta Workflows or a similar low\-code tool * Have exposure to broader automation tooling and AI\-assisted workflows * Have worked at a fast\-scaling startup where IT process was being built out ### **Traits that do well here** * High ownership: you don’t just advise \- you drive the work to completion. * Systems thinking: you can reason about messy workflows and design something scalable, not one\-off. * Customer empathy \+ backbone: you listen deeply, then confidently set boundaries and callout tradeoffs. * Fast learner: you ramp into new domains and tools quickly. **WHY JOIN GLIMPSE** You'll join a company that has found genuine product\-market fit and is scaling fast \- with the infrastructure, capital, and team to match. Your work will directly shape how hundreds of CPG brands run their back office. And you'll have real ownership! * Competitive salary with meaningful equity * In\-person team in NYC – high ownership, fast feedback loops * Direct impact on a company growing at an exceptional pace * A front\-row seat to building the operating system for CPG brands ### **Location:** Prime Midtown location \- Penn Station, Madison Square Garden, and the city's best transit connections right at your door. \*Moving to a new location in November *GLIMPSE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. GLIMPSE will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.* Compensation Range: $135K \- $175K

jobs.description: **About GlobalFoundries:** GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. **Summary of Role:** GlobalFoundries is scaling the next generation of enterprise AI and agentic workflows through the CIO FDE Office. The Director leads a blended team of internal engineers, NCG resources, and contractor FDEs (partners) to incubate, industrialize, and operationalize AI\-powered solutions across HR, IT, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other business domains. This is a supervisory role that combines people leadership, portfolio and demand management, architecture direction, executive engagement, and financial stewardship of the AI platform. The Director sets the operating model and standards for a small, high\-impact organization, ensures solutions ship with the right security, observability, governance, and cost controls, and serves as the CIO's trusted partner for translating enterprise AI strategy into delivered, measurable value. Roughly 70% of the role is strategy, leadership, and stakeholder engagement \& management; \~30% is retained technical fluency and architecture judgment. **Essential Responsibilities** : **1\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development** * Lead, coach, and develop the team 5 direct reports plus 5 NCG resources; build a durable talent pipeline and career paths within the pod. * Manage a blended workforce of internal GF FDE engineers and contractor resources; scale capacity up and down as demand requires. * Set the CIO FDE Office operating model, engineering standards, roles/responsibilities, and delivery methodology. * Own staffing plans, investment proposals, and capability\-building; foster a culture of ownership, safety, and measurable outcomes. **2\. Portfolio, Intake Governance \& Delivery** * Own the CIO FDE portfolio — prioritize use cases, sequence delivery, and align capacity to the highest\-value opportunities. * Run intake governance for new technology requests: apply formal intake templates and screening questions to ensure strategic alignment and reusable patterns. * Drive use cases from incubation to production without surprises in risk, security, or cost; hold go/no\-go and production\-readiness gates. * Represent solutions at Design Review Board (DRB) and enterprise architecture reviews. **3\. Enterprise AI \& Agentic Platform Strategy** * Set technical direction for enterprise AI agents built across various enterprise applications such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Supply Chain, HR, and IT Operations. * Guide architecture for MCP integrations, APIs, multi\-agent orchestration, cloud (AWS / ADP BYOC), identity (Entra ID, OBO, token brokering), and observability. * Champion reusable components, reference implementations, and standards that reduce delivery time for future use cases. * Retain enough hands\-on depth to pressure\-test designs, make credible build\-vs\-buy decisions, and unblock the team on hard technical calls. **4\.
