jobs.title: Construction Account Manager
jobs.description: **Why join us?****Handoff is the AI agent that runs a construction company.** We help remodelers automate estimating, streamline operations, and win more work \- backed by real\-time cost data, intuitive design, and workflows that “speak contractor.” With over 10,000 monthly active users and $6B in annualized project volume already flowing through our platform, we’re becoming the trusted partner for the people who build our homes. We are backed by $25M\+ raised from Y Combinator, Initialized, and Greycroft. Our team is distributed across hubs in Austin, São Paulo, and Buenos Aires, and we are deeply focused on building intuitive, high\-impact solutions that make a real difference for our users. **Construction Account Manager at Handoff** ------------------------------------------- We're hiring a **Construction Account Manager** to get our enterprise customers successfully using Handoff. In this role you'll lead implementation for building material suppliers, dealers, and construction companies — configuring their accounts, training their teams, supporting their rollout, and translating their feedback into improvements our engineers and researchers can act on. This role is ideal for someone who has real construction estimating experience and knows how the work actually gets built — and who can take that credibility into a room of estimators, purchasing staff, or operations leads and help them get more out of our technology. If you've spent time in the field or at a supplier desk and you're ready to bring that expertise into a fast\-moving AI company, this is the role for you. ### **What you'll do** * Serve as the primary point of contact for estimating, purchasing, and construction staff at our enterprise accounts * Build and own the implementation plan per account, with 30/60/90 milestones the customer has agreed to * Configure and maintain customer accounts: cost data, product preferences, catalogs, estimate formats, and presets — validated against real estimates * Train customer users and build the training materials that scale that process * Own first\-line support: answer customer questions same day and escalate bugs with reproducible steps and customer impact * Translate customer requirements and feedback into structured, prioritized specs for our forward\-deployed engineers, researchers, and product team * Review customer usage weekly per account and work adoption blockers with the team * Prepare and run customer check\-ins and business reviews * Build the repeatable playbook: onboarding checklist, configuration standards, support process ### **About you** * You've personally done takeoffs from drawings and built estimates and material lists — residential or commercial. This is a requirement, and we'll verify it in the take\-home. * You have end\-to\-end knowledge of the construction process, including field and installation work. You know what a quantity means on site, can catch a missing scope, and can explain it in a customer's language. * You've trained people, supported accounts, or managed customer relationships. You're comfortable in front of a room of estimators, purchasing staff, or sales reps. * You're a clear writer who gets the details right. You can turn a customer conversation into a precise requirement or a reproducible bug report someone else can act on. * You use AI tools every day and can teach them to someone who doesn't. * Bonus: experience with takeoff software (PlanSwift, Bluebeam, OST), estimating or construction management platforms (Buildertrend, JobTread, Procore), software implementation or onboarding, procurement/purchasing at a material supplier, or working alongside product or engineering teams. ### **What we offer** * Competitive Salary \+ Equity * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Life \& Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA) * Relocation Allowance * Top\-Notch Equipment * Team offsites around the world! Construction is one of the largest industries in the world, and it's still running on spreadsheets and gut feel. We're changing that. This role puts you at the center of it — working directly with the customers building our product's future, and bringing your construction expertise into a company that will actually use it. If that sounds like your kind of work, we'd love to hear from you. ***Handoff is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *Handoff is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Handoff will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Handoff encourages applicants of all ages. Handoff also participates in E\-Verify.*

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description: **About Harper** ---------------- Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real\-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai. www.harper.fast (http://www.harper.fast) **The role** ============ You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper's most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you're the first to know when something isn't going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track. This is not a technical support role. Harper's engineers, forward\-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You'll need enough product fluency to match Harper's capabilities to a customer's business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering. The best person for this seat has grown large, multi\-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You're a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer's team does. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Own the account** * Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day\-to\-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals. * Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities. * Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware. * Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what's right for their architecture. **Run the work like a project manager** * Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow\-up is owed, it goes out within one business day. * Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves. * Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap\-up to the team each week. **Manage relationships across three sides** * Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor. * Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co\-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it. * Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper. **Orchestrate Harper's internal team** * Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow\-up afterward. * Write customer\-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out. * Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing. **What you'll bring** --------------------- **Must\-haves** * 6\+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota. * Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting. * Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts. * Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send. * You can connect a customer's goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap. * Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana). * Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one. **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms. * Accounts in retail, e\-commerce, media or telecom. * Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs. * A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential. * Experience with Harper **This role is not for you if** ------------------------------- * You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers. * You need a manager to remind you about follow\-ups or deadlines. * You would rather escalate a problem than own it. * You prefer a slower\-paced environment where the day\-to\-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you'll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience On\-target earnings: $250,000 at 100% of plan Commission: uncapped, with accelerators above quota * Equity, health benefits and a 401(k). * Fully remote, with occasional travel to customer sites and team meetups. **Interview process** * 30\-minute screen with People Operations. * 45\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. * 60\-minute working session: you get a mock account brief and present a 30\-day plan, a risk log and a customer follow\-up email. * 45\-minute panel with an engineer and a partner\-facing teammate. * 30\-minute conversation with Harper leadership. **What success looks like** --------------------------- By 90 days, every account you own has a current written plan, a known renewal path and no surprises. **Timeframe** **Outcome** 30 days Met every key stakeholder at each account and partner. Written history and stakeholder map for each account. Weekly Monday/Friday updates running. 60 days Account plan and open\-items tracker live for every account. Running the recurring customer syncs yourself. Every in\-flight services engagement has signed paper or a dated path to it. 90 days Leading at least one active customer initiative to its milestones. Partner account teams engaged on every shared account. One expansion opportunity qualified and in the pipeline. 12 months Renewals closed on time. Expansion bookings against the agreed target. At least one customer reference or case study delivered to Marketing. **How we'll measure it** * Gross and net revenue retention on your book * Expansion bookings against target * Follow\-ups and weekly updates sent on time * Risks flagged before they slip a date, not after * Feedback from the customer, partner reps and Harper engineering on how easy you are to work with

jobs.title: OT Technical Security Architect

This role serves as the technical authority for OT cybersecurity strategy, ensuring secure operations while maintaining the availability, integrity, and safety of critical industrial processes. The OT Security Architect collaborates with engineering, manufacturing, infrastructure, cybersecurity risk, and compliance teams to develop secure OT environments aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISA/IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and CISA guidance. OT Security Architecture \& Strategy * Develop and maintain the enterprise OT security architecture roadmap. * Design secure architectures for industrial control systems, SCADA networks, distributed control systems (DCS), and manufacturing environments. * Support development and ongoing updates of OT cybersecurity standards, patterns, and technical requirements. * Partner with (and in some instances lead) technical lead/teams to ensure the integration of security\-by\-design principles into OT projects and modernization initiatives. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend security controls for industrial environments. Risk Management \& Governance * Conduct OT security risk assessments and threat modeling exercises. * Identify vulnerabilities within industrial environments and recommend mitigation strategies. * Support development and ongoing updates of OT security policies, standards, and control frameworks. * Ensure alignment with corporate risk management, cybersecurity, and compliance programs. * Support audit activities and regulatory compliance efforts. Network \& Infrastructure Security * Design OT network segmentation, Purdue Model architectures, and secure remote access solutions. * Define requirements for firewalls, industrial DMZs, jump hosts, and network monitoring capabilities. * Review configurations and security controls across OT environments. * Partner with infrastructure and plant operations teams to secure industrial networks and connected assets. Security Operations \& Incident Response * Support development of OT security monitoring and detection capabilities. * Design logging and telemetry requirements for industrial systems. * Participate in incident response planning and exercises involving OT environments. * Provide subject matter expertise during cybersecurity incidents affecting manufacturing or operational systems. * Recommend containment and recovery strategies while minimizing operational disruption. * Vendor \& Technology Management Evaluate OT security products and technologies, including: Industrial firewalls * Network detection and response (NDR) * OT asset discovery platforms * Secure remote access solutions * Vulnerability management tools * Review vendor security architectures and third\-party connectivity requirements. * Support procurement and implementation of OT cybersecurity solutions. Stakeholder Collaboration * Partner with plant operations, engineering, reliability, automation, and cybersecurity teams. * Communicate risks, design decisions, and security requirements to technical and business stakeholders. * Provide guidance and mentorship to OT engineers, security analysts, and project teams. * Lead cross\-functional initiatives to improve OT cybersecurity maturity. Unsure how to write a new resume? Visit the Hays Career Advice section to learn top tips to help you stand out from the crowd when job hunting. iterative approach to building products, and estimate technical scope and timelines for large, cross\-team initiatives * Produce technical solutions that satisfy business requirements with a focus on scalability, stability, efficiency, maintainability and extensibility, using modern \& stable technologies * Shape the organization's learning culture and long\-term engineering process strategy, and demonstrate executive\-level composure in high\-stakes, ambiguous situations **About You** * A visionary technologist with deep experience in systems, architecture, and design; a systems thinker who specializes in solving highly technical and complex problems * A track record of setting technical strategy and driving alignment across multiple engineering teams * Experience defining architectural standards and mentoring engineers * Deep understanding and experience with front end applications, APIs, and back\-end services * Strong hands\-on experience with React * Experience delivering mobile, digital products to the Apple and Google Play app store; experience developing in React Native is a plus * Strong understanding of all layers of a Web and Mobile solution * Experience using AI as a transformative technology * Experience hosting application services on AWS * Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry * Strong collaboration and coaching skills, with demonstrated success developing other engineers * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical ideas for non\-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders * Comfort operating in ambiguity, exploring early\-stage ideas without well\-defined requirements * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation * Experience working in a fast\-paced, hypergrowth, collaborative environment **What We Offer (Benefits \+ Perks)** The role offers a base salary range of $200,000 \- $220,000 in addition to an annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package, and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job\-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary. We provide these additional benefits and perks: * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company\-funded HSA * 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one * Employer\-paid short and long\-term disability * Life insurance at 1x annual salary * 20 days PTO \+ 10 Company Holidays \& 2 Floating Holidays * Paid new parent leave * Additional benefits to be detailed in offer **What We Live By** We're guided by our five core values: **Our Values:** * **Children First.** We put the best interests of children above all. jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Agentic AI & Autonomous CMC Development
jobs.description: Posted Date 10/12/2026 Description At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. **Organization Overview:** At Eli Lilly and Company, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Lilly has led global healthcare for more than 140 years, and today we're growing faster than ever, expanding our portfolio, modalities and manufacturing footprint. To keep delivering medicines faster, with greater quality and efficiency, we're investing in the next generation of digital and AI capability that will change how we research, develop and make decisions. **Position Overview:** We're looking for a visionary executive to lead the next paradigm shift in pharmaceutical development: agentic AI. This is the shift from human\-executed workflows supported by software to autonomous, AI\-enabled development ecosystems, where scientists and engineers spend their time on creativity, judgment and strategy while intelligent agents handle routine knowledge work, analysis, documentation, planning and execution. This Associate Vice President will define and execute Lilly's vision for Agentic CMC Development: building a pan\-DDCS/PRD AI capability platform and deploying agentic solutions that transform how development work gets done across drug delivery, devices, combination products, synthetic molecule development, biologics, formulation sciences, process development, analytical sciences, quality, regulatory and the manufacturing interface. The long\-term goal is an Autonomous Development Platform: one that continuously learns from enterprise knowledge, experimental outcomes, development history, manufacturing performance, regulatory interactions and scientific literature, and increasingly executes development work on its own. This platform will enable: * Agent\-driven knowledge discovery and technical intelligence * Autonomous technical workflow orchestration * AI\-generated development strategies and experiment plans * Automated documentation and regulatory content generation * AI\-assisted design, optimization, change control planning and risk assessment * Digital experts and copilots embedded across development functions * Enterprise\-scale scientific knowledge management Agentic coordination between development, manufacturing, quality and regulatory functions * **Key Responsibilities:** This is a leadership role that builds and grows a dedicated agentic AI team, establishes the DDCS/PRD wide capability platform, and integrates it seamlessly into all processes of CMC development. As the functional technical leader, you partner with scientists, engineers and senior leaders across DDCS/PRD, Manufacturing, Discovery, Business Units, and corporate AI leadership to turn this vision into production reality. You'll serve as a CMC champion for agentic AI in development sciences, setting direction, building durable platform assets, and proving measurable gains in speed, quality and productivity across the CMC development lifecycle. ***1\. Set the Agentic AI Strategy and Roadmap*** * Serve as the single point of accountability for DDCS and pan PRD agentic AI strategy, setting a multi\-year vision, roadmap and technology strategy for autonomous development systems. * Define the future\-state operating model for an AI\-enabled development organization and prioritize the highest\-value opportunities for transformation. * Build the business case and champion narrative that win support from scientists, engineers and senior leaders, addressing both the opportunity and the risks of agentic AI openly and directly. * Track Lilly's growing portfolio of agentic AI initiatives and external pharma agentic AI moves, translating industry and competitive trends into roadmap decisions. ***2\. Own the Agentic AI Platform Architecture*** * Lead development of an enterprise\-scale platform spanning multi\-agent orchestration frameworks, large language model ecosystems, agent memory architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation and knowledge graph systems, digital twin and simulation integration, and autonomous workflow engines. * Establish standards for agent\-to\-agent and tool communication (for example, Model Context Protocol and Agent\-to\-Agent standards) so agents work together across the pan PRD data and knowledge landscape. * Build reusable enterprise capabilities that DDCS, BRD, SMDD and Manufacturing can all adopt. * Build in re luencing senior corporate stakeholders, with the ability to translate complex technical visions into business terms and organizational outcomes. Expertise in full\-stack AI application design from prototype to production, agent\-based systems, autonomous workflows, multi\-agent architectures and AI\-driven process transformation, including standards such as Model Context Protocol and Agent\-to\-Agent. * **Additional Preferences:** * Experience building AI platforms that serve large, matrixed organizations. * Familiarity with regulated environments, GxP systems, quality systems and regulatory expectations, including 21 CFR Part 11\. * Knowledge of CMC development, pharmaceutical development, manufacturing sciences or medical device development. * Experience integrating AI with modeling and simulation, digital twins, laboratory systems and enterprise data platforms. * Strong external reputation within AI, digital transformation, scientific computing or pharmaceutical innovation communities. * Enterprise platform thinking: reusable architectures, standards and durable capability over one\-off pilots * People leadership: recruiting, building and growing a high\-performing, multidisciplinary technical team * Responsible AI: governance, compliance and model risk management in regulated environments * Clear, confident communication of AI capability and business value to diverse audiences Systems thinking across data, models, applications, workflows and people * **Other Information:** * Travel: 10–20% * Location: Indianapolis, IN; Lilly Technology Center – North (LTC\-N) Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $219,000 \- $352,000 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly Salary219,000\.00 \- 352,000\.00 Annual Type Full\-time

jobs.description: Posted Date 10/09/2026 Description Director, AI Engineering (Remote \- eligible) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands\-on when necessary and lead by example * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plu  and leading multi\-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise products or capabilities concurrently * Proven ability to expand and execute long\-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks * Experience establishing cross\-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews) * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. As a Senior Software Developer focused on the data layer of our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll modernize the SQL Server\-backed platform that streamlines radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll write the code that changes the database: refactoring schemas and queries, untangling legacy data\-access code, and moving it to type\-safe, well\-tested patterns while the system stays live for clinicians. This is a hands\-on software development role, not a database administration role; your time will be spent in code, query plans, and pull requests rather than in backups, patching, or server operations. incremental, version\-controlled migrations (e.g., Liquibase) with no disruption to clinical users. * Diagnose and resolve performance problems at the source by reading execution plans, rewriting queries to be sargable and set\-based, replacing row\-by\-row processing with batched writes and properly indexed temp tables, and designing covering and filtered indexes based on real workload evidence. * Modernize the data\-access layer by migrating legacy and inline SQL in PHP and C\# code into type\-safe Kotlin and jOOQ repositories, preserving behavior through characterization, regression, and scale testing. * Harden data access for security and reliability by eliminating SQL injection through parameterization and automated checks, establishing consistent locking, isolation, and query\-timeout conventions, and building query attribution and diagnostics that trace database load back to the code responsible for it. * Build the tooling that makes database change routine, including migration and upgrade pipelines in Gradle and CI/CD, containerized SQL Server test environments, and automated checks that catch regressions before release. * Shape technical direction by defining SQL and data\-access standards, documenting conventions, and contributing to architecture decisions and the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap. * Partner with and mentor fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, helping application teams write efficient, safe database code and fostering a culture of continuous learning. **Qualifications** Server, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, temp tables, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and set\-based design; PostgreSQL experience is also valued. * Proven track record of incrementally refactoring a large, legacy relational schema and the application code that depends on it while in production, not only greenfield database design. * Proficiency in Kotlin or Java, or an equivalent language, building backend services with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework. * Hands\-on experience with database migration and version\-control tools such as Liquibase or Flyway, treating schema as code within Git\-based CI/CD pipelines. * Strong understanding of concurrency, locking, isolation levels, and transactional integrity, and how they affect libraries and code generation from database schemas. * Experience reading, maintaining, and porting legacy application code in PHP and/or C\# (.NET). * Experience with database testing approaches such standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA\- or FAA\-regulated environments). * Location: This role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada. *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI** ========================================= **REMOTE \- US** ---------------- **JOB OVERVIEW** Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands\-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** **Agent definition.** Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre\-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. **Problem selection.** The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. **The human\-in\-the\-loop contract.** Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first\-class design problem. **Build quality.** You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well\-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way. **Evaluation.** Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not. **Specifications.** Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground\-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends. **Commercialization.** Partner with go\-to\-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them. **Design\-partner delivery.** Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke. **TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS** Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves: * Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior * Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything * Using agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) daily: prototyping, data analysis, specification work, and reading the codebase behind your specifications * Reviewing an execution trace and diagnosing whether a failure originates in a tool description, a retrieval gap, a context\-window constraint, an under\-specified output schema, or a genuine model limitation * Building and running evaluation sets, and interpreting the results without a data scientist to translate them * Holding an informed position on retrieval design, tool\-use patterns, structured output, model routing, latency and w Legion Technologies, Inc. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. * **Types of Personal Information We Handle** We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. jobs.description: Responsible AI Senior Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00363318 \| Multiple Locations **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, and we believe that scaling AI responsibly is what makes it durable. Technology is at the core of change today, and we combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data, and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capability. Our Responsible AI capability, within our broader AI \& Data practice, sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge, applied AI engineering, and trusted AI governance. We help the world's leading organizations build and run production\-grade AI and agentic systems that are safe, fair, transparent, and compliant by design, not by afterthought. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI risk in the abstract. We need a practitioner who has built, shipped, and run AI systems at scale, who understands exactly where the technical, ethical, and operational risks live, and who can engineer the guardrails directly into the architecture and the delivery model, across both onshore and offshore teams. **You Are:** You are a Responsible AI Senior Manager who makes trustworthy AI real by building it, not just reviewing it. You bring that credibility because you are, at your core, a deeply technical AI and Data delivery leader: you have designed and shipped production AI, agentic AI, and data science solutions yourself, and you have led large, distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations to do the same at scale. You are equally comfortable in a model architecture review, an agentic workflow design session, and a governance committee, and you use that technical fluency to embed fairness, transparency, safety, and compliance directly into how systems are designed, built, tested, and operated. You set the technical and ethical standard for how generative and agentic AI gets built, secured, and run, and you lead the engineering, data science, and delivery teams who build it. **The Work:** * **Embed Responsible AI across the lifecycle —** define and operationalize Responsible AI standards, including fairness and bias testing, explainability, model and data governance, privacy, safety evaluations, and human oversight, and build these controls directly into engineering and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines rather than bolting them on after the fact. * **Own AI risk and governance —** serve as the senior technical authority on responsible use of generative and agentic AI, running model risk assessments, red\-teaming and safety evaluations, and advising clients and internal leadership on regulatory, ethical, and reputational AI risk. * **Lead large\-scale, global delivery teams responsibly —** manage and mentor large onshore and offshore AI, data science, and engineering teams delivering production\-grade AI and agentic AI solutions, owning staffing, technical direction, quality, and delivery outcomes across geographies and time zones, with Responsible AI checkpoints built into every stage of delivery. * **Architect and build production AI and agentic systems with guardrails in place —** personally guide the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise AI, agentic AI, and data science platforms spanning multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others) and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, Google), ensuring solutions are production\-grade, scalable, maintainable, and governed. * **Set technical standards and reference architectures grounded in Responsible AI —** define reference architectures and technical standards for LLMOps, agentic AI orchestration, data science workflows, security, reliability, and cost governance across the AI estate, and hold engineering teams accountable to them. * **Drive cost and security governance —** establish FinOps\-for\-AI cost optimization practices and embed AI security and governance controls into platform design and delivery. * **Shape responsible AI solutions and grow the business —** partner with clients and pursuit teams to shape solutions, architectures, and delivery models for major AI and Responsible AI programs, and contribute to Accenture sales and proposal efforts when needed. * **Build organizational capability in Responsible AI —** develop playbooks, training, and governance frameworks that raise the Responsible AI and technical delivery maturity of teams across the practice, and continue to deepen your own expertise in AI engineering, agentic AI, data science, and Responsible AI. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Manufacturing Engineer, Systems \& Automation **Company:** Lowell Corporation **Location:** West Boylston, Massachusetts **Position Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM **Compensation:** Salary paid weekly, exempt status About the Role Lowell Corporation is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer, Systems \& Automation to strengthen our shop\-floor engineering capability and help modernize how we manufacture and support our products. This is not an entry\-level or purely software\-focused position. We are looking for an engineer who already understands how a manufacturing shop operates, is comfortable working directly with machinists and production equipment, and can apply sound engineering judgment to real production problems. The role is highly project\-focused. You will work closely with ownership, engineering, and production on CNC process improvement, tooling and workholding, new product setup, troubleshooting, automation, lights\-out manufacturing, and the development of more structured engineering systems. Technology and software are important tools in the role, but practical manufacturing knowledge comes first. Key Responsibilities · Own manufacturing engineering support for new and existing products, including process planning, BOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling requirements, and first\-run support. · Work directly with machinists and production personnel to solve shop\-floor problems involving machining, setups, tooling, fixtures, workholding, quality, cycle time, and repeatability. · Improve CNC machining processes and support CAM/programming optimization in coordination with shop programmers and operators. · Evaluate manufacturability of new parts and jobs, determine practical production methods, and support transition from quote or design into repeatable production. · Lead root\-cause analysis and continuous\-improvement projects involving scrap, rework, downtime, process capability, and production bottlenecks. · Support and expand lights\-out and unattended machining through better processes, probing, inspection, monitoring, tooling, and machine reliability. · Evaluate and implement practical shop\-floor automation and equipment improvements where they can improve capacity, quality, safety, or labor efficiency. · Lead manufacturing and engineering special projects from problem definition through design, implementation, follow\-up, and measurable results. · Document and standardize successful processes so improvements are repeatable and scalable across the organization. · Use modern engineering tools, including AI\-assisted CAM, automation, data analysis, and software, where they provide a practical advantage to manufacturing. Required Experience and Capabilities We are looking for someone with proven engineering judgment developed through real shop\-floor experience. Strong academic credentials are valuable, but they are not a substitute for having worked in a manufacturing environment and solved production problems firsthand. · At least 3 years of hands\-on manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or comparable shop\-floor engineering experience in a machine shop, precision manufacturing, or similar production environment. · Direct familiarity with CNC machining and production equipment, with the ability to work credibly and effectively alongside machinists and operators. · Strong mechanical and manufacturing engineering fundamentals, including tolerances, materials, GD\&T, inspection, and process capability. · Practical experience with tooling, fixtures, workholding, setups, process planning, and manufacturing problem solving. · Experience developing or maintaining BOMs, routings, process plans, work instructions, or other manufacturing engineering documentation. · Demonstrated ability to take a manufacturing problem or improvement opportunity from analysis through implementation rather than stopping at recommendation. · Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred; equivalent hands\-on engineering experience will be considered. Preferred Experience · CAM programming or process optimization using SolidWorks, Autodesk Fusion, or similar CAD/CAM software. · Fanuc controller programming with G and M coding for CNC milling and lathe operations · Lights\-out or unattended machining, probing, in\-process inspection, or machine monitoring. · Manufacturing automation, robotics, controls, sensors, or machine integration. · ERP/MRP engineering data, including BOMs, routings, item setup, or engineering changes. · Python, SQL, data analysis, AI\-assisted engineering tools, or other software skills that can be applied to manufacturing problems. · New product introduction, first\-article support, fixture design, or production launch experience. Why Lowell This is an opportunity to play a visible, hands\-on role in how an established precision manufacturing company improves its engineering and production capabilities. You will not be limited to maintaining existing processes. We want someone who can identify better ways to manufacture, solve problems, and implement improvements that have a measurable effect on the shop. Lowell is investing in advanced CNC manufacturing, automation, lights\-out production, improved engineering systems, and new technology. The right engineer will have the opportunity to combine strong manufacturing fundamentals with these tools to help shape how the company operates going forward. Position Details · Full\-time, salaried, exempt position. · On site in West Boylston, Massachusetts, with regular shop\-floor presence. · Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. · No regular travel required. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Do you have a Bachelors degree in Engineering, and what kind? * What other important qualifications do you have for this position that should be considered * How much shop floor experience do you have with various CNC and other shop equipment? Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are reimagining how people buy and navigate healthcare. More than 80% of Americans receive health insurance through an employer or purchase coverage through individual and Medicare exchanges. Yet the experience remains overpriced, opaque, and inefficient. We replace the traditional brokerage with an AI\-native platform built to streamline this process while helping people choose plans, find care, schedule appointments, call insurance, and fight bills. Our goal is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how healthcare is bought and managed across America. **Why Join Us** =============== * **Scaling quickly:** We are growing quickly and looking for zero\-to\-one builders who want an outsized opportunity to learn and shape the company’s future. * **High impact:** Healthcare costs are rising at record rates, while the user journey has never been worse. Join us as we rebuild an industry. * **Best\-in\-class talent:** Work alongside teammates from leading tech companies including Uber, Faire, Airbnb, Rippling, Google, Forward, and Collective Health, as well as brokerage industry leaders including Newfront, WTW, Marsh, and Sequoia. Our team works together in person in San Francisco. * **Well funded:** Seed\-stage startup well funded by top VC's **About the Role** ================== Our product depends on bringing together data that has never previously lived in one system: insurance plans and networks, provider and pricing data, employer and member information, claims and medical records, and the activity generated across our own products and operations. We are looking for our first Data Engineer to build the foundation that makes this information reliable and usable across the company. This person will own the systems that ingest data from APIs, files, vendors, customer systems, public sources, and legacy portals; model it into durable representations; and make it available to our products, AI agents, operators, and business systems. This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership across the data stack. You will make early architectural decisions, build the first versions yourself, and determine where rigor matters immediately and where simple systems can evolve. You will also help define how we use AI in data engineering to acquire, interpret, reconcile, and operate data more effectively. The right candidate has strong data engineering judgment, enjoys building from zero, and is excited to work with messy healthcare data where accuracy matters. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build our data foundation:** Own the systems that move, transform, organize, and serve data across the company, including the data warehouse (e.g. Databricks), ingestion and export infrastructure, orchestration and scheduling (e.g. Airflow or Dagster), transformation and modeling tools (e.g. dbt), semantic layers, data catalogs, quality, and observability. * **Unify fragmented healthcare data:** Ingest and connect data from paid vendors, carriers, providers, government sources such as CMS, customer and benefits administration systems, public files, APIs, legacy portals, and our own applications. Build durable workflows for large files, changing schemas, incomplete records, and sources that were never designed to work together. * **Make the data trustworthy:** Design canonical models for plans, networks, providers, employers, members, claims, and other core concepts. Preserve historical state, lineage, provenance, and source\-specific nuance so our products, agents, operators, and customers can rely on the results. * **Put data into production:** Make curated data available wherever it creates value, including our backend, member and employer experiences, AI agents, brokerage workflows, CRM, reporting, and other operational tools. Build reliable systems for moving data both into and out of the warehouse. * **Use AI to improve data engineering:** Apply models and agents to acquire information from portals and older websites, interpret unfamiliar files, map changing schemas, reconcile conflicting sources, investigate quality issues, and automate work that has traditionally been manual. * **Set the roadmap and standards:** Work across product, engineering, brokerage, and operations to identify the highest\-leverage data capabilities, prioritize the roadmap, and decide where we need durable infrastructure now and where a simpler solution can evolve. **Who You Are** =============== * **AI\-native:** You think from first principles about how models and agents can change data engineering, from acquiring data in legacy systems to interpreting files, mapping schemas, and investigating failures. You know when to use AI, when deterministic systems are safer, and how to build the evaluations and review loops needed for trustworthy results. * **End\-to\-end data engineer:** You have built and operated production data systems across ingestion, warehousing, orchestration, modeling, quality, and serving. You are hands\-on in SQL and Python and comfortable choosing and owning the surrounding tools. * **Comfortable starting from zero:** You can turn broad goals into a clear sequence of work and take responsibility from initial design through reliable production operation. * **Comfortable with messy data:** You have worked with data from external organizations, not only clean application events. You understand temporal modeling, idempotency, schema evolution, lineage, provenance, and how to establish trust when sources are incomplete or contradictory. * **Practical architect:** You can make important technical decisions without overbuilding. You know which choices will be difficult to reverse, where correctness is essential from the beginning, and where a simple first version is appropriate. * **Operationally minded:** You think beyond dashboards and analytical queries. You are comfortable designing data systems that directly support applications, automated workflows, customer\-facing experiences, and business operations. * **Able to work across disciplines:** You enjoy working with engineers, operators, and industry experts to turn complicated real\-world concepts into clear models, interfaces, and systems.

jobs.title: Lead Application Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview: At McAfee, you'll architect and lead platform solutions in a fast\-paced environment where innovation shapes enterprise infrastructure. As a Lead Application Platform Engineer, you'll set technical direction, establish patterns and standards for platform teams, and drive architectural decisions that impact multiple product engineering groups. This technical leadership role elevates developer productivity and operational excellence across the organization. The Lead Application Platform Engineer operates as a technical leader — not a manager — bringing depth, influence, and mentorship. This engineer sets the patterns and standards the platform team builds on, serves as the escalation point for production issues, and is the technical voice engineering leaders consult before major commitments. The role combines deep expertise in application architecture, platform engineering, and distributed systems with the ability to mentor and influence other engineers. Position Details: **About The Role** * Embed with two to three assigned product engineering groups, participating as a functional team member while maintaining a broader platform perspective. * Own and evolve reference architectures—a curated set of blessed patterns (synchronous services, asynchronous workers, data pipelines) with Infrastructure\-as\-Code starters, monitoring checklists, runbook templates, and cost models. * Act as the escalation point for production and architecture problems across multiple engineering groups; lead technical response to major incidents alongside SRE. * Set the technical standard for the platform team: define the bar for review approach, testing depth, instrumentation baseline, and what 'operationally ready' means in practice. * Mentor two to four Application Platform Engineers, including onboarding new hires into unfamiliar product domains and codebases; grow the technical capabilities of the team. * Represent platform constraints and capabilities in architecture discussions with engineering leadership; carry group constraints back into Release Engineering and SRE roadmaps. * Drive structural fixes after major incidents; lead the analysis of root causes and oversee implementation of preventive measures. * Evaluate and introduce tooling (AI\-assisted development, test generation, performance and security tools); prove value before team standardization. * Design multi\-service architectures and reason about failure modes, blast radius, data consistency, and cost before code is written. * Contribute meaningfully in at least two of Go, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, or .NET; comfortable in a third at short notice. * Lead capacity and scalability analysis; interpret profiling and tracing data to locate bottlenecks across service boundaries. * Build internal tooling and automation frameworks that the rest of the platform team depends on, including AI\-assisted migration and review workflows. * Drive security remediation strategy across the software supply chain; manage and prioritize remediation across multiple teams. **About You** * 9\+ years in software, platform, or reliability engineering with deep hands\-on coding experience that is still current. * Demonstrated ownership of architecture patterns adopted by teams outside your own. * Experience operating high\-traffic distributed systems in production; leadership inincident response and post\-incident structural work. * Track record of raising the technical bar of a team through mentoring and standard\- setting. * Expert\-level proficiency in Go (Golang), Python, and Node.js/TypeScript; strong * competency in Dart/Flutter; able to read and architect in Java, Kotlin, Swift, Objective\-C, C\+\+, C, Rust, and C\#/.NET. * Deep expertise in AWS (EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC) and production\-grade Kubernetes across multiple deployments. * Working knowledge of GCP/GKE and multi\-cloud architecture patterns. * Advanced expertise in Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Infrastructure\-as\- Code at scale. * Mastery of CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions and Harness; expertise in build optimization, artifact management, and security scanning. * Advanced knowledge of observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing (Tempo), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and alerting (CloudWatch, Datadog, Instana). * Deep expertise in performance testing, capacity planning, and scalability analysis using K6, Locust, or JMeter. * Advanced knowledge of databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, SQL Server) and query optimization. * Expertise with event\-driven architectures and message streaming (Confluent Kafka, Redis). * Security supply chain mastery: SonarQube, BlackDuck/Coverity, Dependabot, JFrog; ability to architect and drive remediation strategies. * Expert use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and ability to evaluate new AI tooling for team adoption. * Desired Skills include: + Mobile DevOps mastery (Fastlane with Flutter/Dart, Swift, Kotlin builds; mobile testing automation). + Advanced experience with Kong API gateway, Okta RBAC, and Backstage\-based developer platforms. + Deep familiarity with internal service frameworks (Gofr, NodeFr/Zode). + LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic AI orchestration experience. + Published technical writing or speaking about platform engineering, architecture, or DevOps at conferences. + Cloud Solutions Architect certifications (AWS, GCP). + Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS). jobs.title: Process Engineers - 4 years +
jobs.description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== A career at Medtronic is like no other. We’re purposeful. We’re committed. And we’re driven by our Mission to alleviate pain, restore health and extend life for millions of people worldwide. Join a high\-impact manufacturing engineering team responsible for advancing production performance, product quality, and operational excellence. This role partners closely with Operations, Quality, R\&D, and Supply Chain to develop, optimize, and scale manufacturing processes that support innovative medical technologies. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You own the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer. This is a senior, hands\-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements. **What makes this role different** * Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal * Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human * Per\-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti\-leakage discipline * Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in\-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment **Requirements** * **Staff\-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes. * **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands\-on depth in time\-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient\-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit\-learn and pandas or Polars. * **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool\-using agents, and structured (schema\-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework. * **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users. * **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use. * **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non\-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials. * **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production\-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software. * **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements. Nice\-to\-haves* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP\&A data and the audit expectations around it. * **Feature\-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models. * **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment. * **Sparse and zero\-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros. * **Multi\-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi\-tenant SaaS, single\-tenant SaaS and on\-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Meeru AI Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders.
