Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. The Role We are looking for a **Staff Data Engineer** to build and own the major subsystems of the data foundation — the pipelines, connectors, and curated models that feed the platform's analytics and AI layers. You take the data architecture and standards set by the data lead and turn them into robust, production\-grade systems that don't break and don't lie about the numbers. You own significant pieces of the platform end to end complex transformations over the warehouse, source integrations for new customer systems, and the reconciliation and lineage that prove the curated model ties back to source. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership engineering role with a clear path toward Senior Staff. **Requirements** * **7\+ years in data engineering.** You've owned complex, production pipelines end to end, including how they perform, how reliable they are and what they cost to run. * **Expert SQL and data modeling.** You write complex, set\-based transformations over a cloud warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL or similar) and design models other teams build on. * **dbt in production.** You've built and maintained real dbt projects, including incremental models that refresh efficiently instead of rebuilding everything. * **Production orchestration with Airflow or Dagster.** You design DAGs that are safe to rerun and backfill. * **Warehouse internals and performance tuning.** You know why a query is slow or expensive on large datasets and how to fix it. * **A bias toward correctness.** You treat data tests, reconciliation against source and lineage as core to the job, and you build pipelines that are idempotent and reproducible. * **Solid Python.** Enough to write pipeline code, tests and tooling that others can maintain. * **Comfort with messy source systems.** You've integrated real\-world sources with inconsistent data and changing schemas, and kept downstream models stable. * **Collaboration and mentorship.** You agree data contracts with backend and AI teams, review peers' work and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers. **Nice to have** * **ERP and financial data.** Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or Workday, or with finance data such as general ledger, accounts payable, payroll and HRIS. * **CDC and managed ingestion.** Change\-data\-capture pipelines or tools like Fivetran. * **Multi\-cloud and customer\-hosted deployments.** Work across AWS, Azure and GCP, ideally where pipelines run inside customer environments with strict tenant isolation and no data leaving. * **A wider warehouse range.** Oracle ADW, Apache Pinot or MySQL alongside the main warehouses. * **FinTech or financial\-services exposure.** You understand why finance teams need numbers that tie out to the cent. * **Reusable integration frameworks.** You've built connectors or mappings as configuration on a shared framework, so the next source is faster to onboard. * **Test and synthetic data.** You've built golden or synthetic datasets for regression testing. * **Interest in architectural ownership.** This role has a clear path toward Senior Staff.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Developer Introduction: Join our growing team as an AI Solutions Developer, where you will harness your technical expertise and knowledge of AI technologies to drive operational efficiency across our organization. This role is tailored for a professional who is passionate about applying AI agent development, low\-code/no\-code solutions, and helping users leverage AI in common applications to streamline processes and enhance productivity. The focus is on key business workflows and targeted automation needs. You will collaborate closely with the Business Systems Analyst, the Senior Software Architect, and various teams to augment operational workflows, building solutions that are fast to deploy, well\-documented, and aligned with the firm's architectural standards. The position will report to the Software Development Team supervisor and be based out of the Westwood office. Job Responsibilities: * Collaborate with the Business Systems Analyst and cross\-functional teams to identify operational bottlenecks and areas for automation. * Develop and implement low\-code/no\-code solutions to automate processes, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in data handling and reporting. * Leverage AI tools and platforms to create agent workflows that optimize operational tasks and enhance team productivity. * Partner with teams across the firm to help them better leverage AI capabilities built into existing applications, identifying opportunities where built\-in features can address needs without custom development. * Design and deploy AI agent workflows within the firm's established architectural standards, collaborating with the senior software architect and participating in solution reviews. * Maintain clear documentation for automation solutions and agent configurations to ensure long\-term supportability. * Apply development best practices to low\-code/no\-code solutions, including peer review where appropriate. * Develop metrics to measure the impact of automation solutions on operational efficiency and report findings to stakeholders. * Stay current with emerging AI technologies and methodologies, integrating them into operational practices to drive continuous improvement. * Connect AI tools and automation solutions to existing business systems through integrations. * Contribute to the development team's growing expertise in AI coding practices and tools through collaboration and knowledge sharing. * Ensure compliance with the AI Acceptable Use Policy, promoting responsible and ethical use of AI technologies in all solutions developed. Job Requirements: * 2\-4 years of relevant experience in software development, with proficiency in AI coding and automation. * Working proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building scripts and workflows for AI agent development. * Demonstrated experience with low\-code/no\-code platforms and AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, Pega, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). * Ability to assess business needs and recommend the right\-sized solution, whether that's leveraging built\-in AI features, configuring a low\-code workflow, or developing a custom script. * Experience with API integrations and connecting tools to existing business systems. * Working knowledge of data management practices, including data extraction, validation, and transformation. * Familiarity with software development lifecycle principles, including basic architectural patterns, code review, and change management. * Ability to articulate how automation solutions fit within a broader systems architecture. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve complex problems and develop practical solutions. * Ability to translate business needs into practical automation solutions. * Ability to evaluate AI output quality and reliability * Excellent collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional teams. * A proactive mindset with a passion for experimenting with new technologies and approaches. About Meketa Investment Group Meketa Investment Group is an employee\-owned full\-service investment consulting and advisory firm. We work with some of the nation’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors including public and private plan sponsors. We have a staff of over 250 employees among our six US office locations and London. Meketa recognizes that our workforce is a reflection of our company, and we operate in an inclusive environment that accepts and promotes diversity. We believe our employees can best serve our clients in an atmosphere where individuals are treated fairly, where professional growth is developed and encouraged, and where a healthy balance between work and home life is respected and preserved. To support employees, Meketa offers a competitive compensation structure, a wide range of benefits from core insurance benefits to time\-based benefits, as well as flexible schedules and support for continuing education. Meketa is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us.

jobs.title: Network and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Job Purpose/Summary: ==================== The Senior Network and Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, security, and reliability of Mitchell Hamline School of Law’s network and technology infrastructure. This role leads complex infrastructure projects, serves as the senior technical resource for network and systems issues, and supports cybersecurity, business continuity, and disaster recovery. The position works closely with the Director of Academic Technology and Infrastructure and other IT staff to ensure reliable and secure technology services across the School.  Essential Duties and Responsibilities: ====================================== Network and Infrastructure Engineering -------------------------------------- * Design, configure, maintain, and improve the School’s local and wide area network infrastructure, including switches, routers, wireless networks, gateways, VPNs, and related technologies. * Architect, administer, and maintain server, virtualization, storage, and related infrastructure systems. * Architect, configure, and maintain firewall hardware and software and other infrastructure security controls. * Monitor network and infrastructure performance, capacity, reliability, and availability and implement improvements as needed. * Lead major infrastructure upgrades, replacements, migrations, and implementation projects. * Establish and maintain technical standards, configurations, diagrams, and procedures for network and infrastructure systems. * Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex network, server, and infrastructure issues. Cybersecurity ------------- * Serve as a senior technical resource for infrastructure cybersecurity and support the School’s security program. * Design, implement, monitor, and improve security controls for network, server, firewall, authentication, endpoint, and related infrastructure. * Conduct or coordinate technical risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, security testing, and remediation activities. * Monitor emerging threats and recommend changes needed to protect institutional systems and data. * Support response to cybersecurity incidents, including investigation, containment, recovery, and documentation. * Partner with IT leadership to support security standards, awareness, training, and technology practices. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery ----------------------------------------- * Develop, maintain, and test infrastructure\-related business continuity and disaster recovery plans. * Serve as a lead technical resource during major outages, emergencies, and recovery efforts. * Coordinate backup, recovery, redundancy, and continuity solutions for critical infrastructure systems. * Cross\-train IT staff and document recovery procedures to support continuity of operations. Technology Planning and Vendor Management ----------------------------------------- * Research and evaluate infrastructure technologies, services, and emerging solutions. * Recommend hardware, software, services, and infrastructure investments based on institutional needs, security, reliability, and lifecycle considerations. * Review vendor specifications, proposals, and technical designs for suitability. * Serve as a technical liaison with internet, telecommunications, network, security, and infrastructure vendors and service providers. * Coordinate technical implementation and troubleshooting with vendors and external partners. Team and Operational Support ---------------------------- * Provide advanced technical guidance, mentoring, and support to IT team members. * Assist with troubleshooting and operational work when issues require senior\-level infrastructure expertise. * Maintain clear technical documentation, policies, processes, procedures, and system records. * Participate in after\-hours support for critical infrastructure issues as needed. * Perform other duties as assigned. *An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: ================================ * Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, wireless networking, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and firewalls. * Strong knowledge of server, virtualization, storage, backup, and related infrastructure technologies. * Strong knowledge of infrastructure cybersecurity principles, controls, and practices, including familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework or comparable standards. * Knowledge of identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, logging, and monitoring concepts. * Strong knowledge of business continuity and disaster recovery practices. * Ability to design, document, and implement complex technical solutions and exercise independent technical judgment. * Advanced troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects. * Ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Strong customer service, collaboration, documentation, and vendor\-management skills. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi\-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP). InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction. This role can be based out of our New York City office or remotely in the eastern or central timezone. ### **What You'll Do** * Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF\-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon) * Secure containerized infrastructure across multi\-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection. * Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP * Write production\-quality code and leverage Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code * Build real\-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale * Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long\-term production reliability ### **What We're Looking For** **Minimum Qualifications:** * 5\+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering * Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C\+\+, or Rust. * Proven track record of building and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning. * Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Practical experience with eBPF\-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon) * Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms * Multi\-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP * Production exposure to low\-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups) ### **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We partner directly with early\-adopter teams to translate complex requirements into durable, scalable infrastructure that other teams can adopt. The work sits at a genuinely rare intersection: modern AI applied to the craft of engineering itself, inside a company whose hardware powers the AI revolution. **What you'll be doing:** Our initial customers are NVIDIA's early\-adopter engineering teams. You will develop a deep, shared understanding with them, identifying the friction points where agentic workflows would have the highest impact. Requirements will evolve as these teams integrate agents into production, so you will iterate with them on proof points to validate or revise your plans together. As an applied ML expert, you will use technical judgment to distinguish durable architectural opportunities from "tech du jour" hype. The work spans several areas. You might agent\-ify compiler infrastructure to enable autonomous agents to make high\-dimensional optimizations, with closed\-loop validation on real hardware. Multi\-agent orchestration is core, anything from LLM\-native tooling to custom work with frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph, driving autonomous loops that apply changes, measure results, ratchet forward and repeat. We closed our Series A, backed by investors including Max Levchin, co\-founder of PayPal, and veterans of the home care industry. **What you'll do** * Build the operating system itself: the core data model and workflows that every part of an agency runs on, including patients, visits, orders, coding, QA, and billing. * Build AI agents that do real clinical and operational work end to end, with clinicians kept in control. * Build AI\-powered product that clinicians rely on in the middle of patient care, where accuracy and speed both matter. For example, turning visit audio into structured clinical data that drives everything downstream. * Own features from start to finish. You'll talk to clinicians and agency leaders, decide what to build, ship it, and watch it run across hundreds of thousands of visits a day. * Connect to the medical record systems our customers depend on, and build the enterprise basics large health systems require: single sign\-on, account provisioning, and audit trails. * Work wherever the problem is: the Django and Postgres backend, the web app, or the native iOS and Android apps. **What we're looking for** * 3\+ years building and shipping product, with solid full\-stack fundamentals. * You use AI heavily in how you write software. * You've worked at a startup and can decide what to do without a spec. * Product sense: you listen closely to users, go deep on their problems, and translate what they need into the right technical decisions. * You've built something people depended on, where getting it wrong had real consequences. **Bonus** * Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HL7/FHIR). * LLM products in production: evaluations, multi\-step model workflows, agents. * Our stack: Python/Django, Postgres, TypeScript/React, Swift or Kotlin, AWS. * Audio, real\-time systems, or mobile apps that work offline. If you want to build the system an entire healthcare industry runs on, we'd love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $150K \- $280K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Software Engineer is a hands\-on, full\-stack engineer who owns the delivery of product features from acceptance criteria to production. Working primarily on Traverse and Grove, this role takes a feature or epic, designs it, builds it, tests it, ships it, and stays accountable for how it behaves in production, without needing task\-level direction. This role is the team's dependable owner of scoped, multi\-card work and a day\-to\-day technical resource for less experienced engineers. The Senior Software Engineer makes and documents local architectural tradeoffs within established patterns, uses AI\-assisted development as a fluent daily practice, and helps engineers on the team grow through pairing and code review. Team\-wide technical direction and code quality standards are owned by the Principal Engineer role, and the Senior Software Engineer co\-builds the agentic engineering framework alongside the Principal Engineer. **This is a hybrid role working 3 days out of our Dublin, OH office.** **Experience** **Required:** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience in a SaaS or web product environment, including production ownership of features you designed and delivered. * Professional experience with Ruby on Rails and a modern JavaScript/TypeScript front end (React preferred), and with relational database design and query performance in PostgreSQL. * Working knowledge of AWS at the application layer (for example S3, queues, and managed database or serverless services), sufficient to deploy, debug, and operate your own features. * Experience reviewing others' code and mentoring less experienced engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have:** * Experience in Health and Human Services, government technology, or another regulated vertical SaaS domain. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture or Domain\-Driven Design. * Experience contributing to agentic SDLC practices such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation, or prompt and runbook standards. * Experience with serverless architectures or mobile application development. * Familiarity with SOC 2 or HIPAA\-aligned engineering practices. **What you’ll be doing** Feature Ownership, Design, and Quality * Own features and epics end to end, from refinement and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and production follow\-up, with minimal direction and a clear record of delivering on commitments. * Design the feature before building it: data model and PostgreSQL schema changes, Rails models and services, API contracts, and React/TypeScript component structure. Make local architectural tradeoffs and document the reasoning in the merge request or design notes. * Participate actively in Amigos and refinement: challenge unclear acceptance criteria, surface risks and dependencies early, and split oversized work into small, end\-to\-end slices. * Write and own automated tests across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels for the work you ship, and treat passing tests and a clean pipeline as part of the definition of done. * Follow the team's established architecture patterns, code quality standards, and security\-by\-default practices, and raise proposed changes to them for team decision rather than diverging on your own. * Handle sensitive case, family, and agency data with care, applying least\-privilege access, input validation, and data protection practices expected of software used by HHS agencies. Production Operations and AI\-Assisted Delivery * Deploy your own changes through the GitLab pipeline, verify them in production, and follow through on regressions using logs, error tracking, and metrics. * Participate in the on\-call rotation: triage and resolve production issues, communicate status clearly, escalate early when needed, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems and their follow\-up actions. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code as the primary tool, with GitHub Copilot or Codex as secondary) as a daily working practice: frame prompts with context and constraints, decompose work into verifiable steps, review and correct AI output, and never ship code you cannot explain. * Co\-build the team's agentic engineering framework with the Principal Engineer: contribute improvements to runbooks, prompts, and workflows, and bring what you learn in daily AI\-assisted work back into how the team builds software. Mentoring and Team Collaboration * Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, thorough code review, and direct, actionable feedback, and serve as an escalation point for engineers working through technical problems. * Keep growing too: pair with the Principal Engineer on hard problems, welcome direct feedback on your own code and designs, and take on work that stretches you. * Review merge requests for correctness, test coverage, security, and maintainability, explaining the reasoning behind your fee lps you earn lower premiums * Robust EAP program that includes free therapy sessions, lifestyle coaching, legal/ID theft services, and more * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave * Up to $5,000 adoption fee reimbursement * $500 wellness reimbursement after 60 days of employment * Generous PTO policy and 10 company paid holidays * Company paid cell phone plan Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Northwoods, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Northwoods is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are excited to work with talented people, period. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or ethnic origin, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital or civil status, political affiliation, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate. **Who is Northwoods?** Northwoods makes software solutions that improve the quality of the life of case managers and social workers in the Health and Human Services (HHS) field. Recognized as one of Columbus’ top places to work, working at Northwoods means being part of a team that’s passionate about making an impact on the lives of HHS professionals and the families they serve. We believe in creating a culture of inclusivity and accountability seeking to hire professional, passionate and driven individuals that believe in the values that we believe in: * Curiosity – Willing to test assumptions, courage to ask questions, and active listening. * Community – Helping and mentoring each other, celebrating diversity and acknowledging our team members’ contributions. * Resourcefulness – Willing to try and fail. Asking for help and trusting the expertise of our team. * Stewardship – Safeguarding Northwoods’ values, culture, mission, and resources. We believe that our team members are all accountable adults, not only to themselves but to each other, and we treat them that way. Our team works incredibly hard and is proven through dedication to their craft and our mission. **Our Solutions** Our products are designed for state and county social care program areas, including child welfare, childcare, child support, economic assistance and adult \& aging agencies. These solutions leverage technology to allow case workers and social workers to easily collect, store, manage, and share case content and data more efficiently. By simplifying processes, our customers can spend more time engaging with the families they serve, make better informed decisions and achieve better outcomes. **Traverse** – A SaaS solution that allows for easy, on\-the\-go access to case files, case work and interview forms and intelligent insights on case content and materials, which lead to better engagement and better outcomes. **Compass** – Compass solution is some of our longer standing software that supports multiple markets for both state and county customers. Our focus on reducing time wasted on paperwork and administrative burdens allows case workers to better serve families in need. **Grove \-** Our trusted team of experienced child welfare professionals becomes an extension of agency staff supporting them with administrative tasks such as referral and records requests, compiling documents for court, and document organization. Workers can focus on fostering healthier families without sacrificing their own well\-being.

You'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. When something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. You are the builder, and the result is yours. And here's the line I care about most: I don't want someone who waits to be told what to do. See a problem? Fix it. See a better way? Build it and show us. Initiative is the job. If you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading. Who we are \- Nu Image® is a US telehealth company. Founded in 2004, online since 2008\. \- LegitScript certified, serving all 50 states. \- We're opening a new office in the Mahwah / Wyckoff area of New Jersey. This role is based there, in person. \- Home page: https://nuimage.com What you'll build (with our CTO) \- A modern web platform and internal tools that people actually enjoy using. \- Integrations and automation that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates. \- AI\-powered workflows, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one. \- Secure, reliable, well\-tested systems with healthcare\-grade privacy and security baked in from day one. What a week roughly looks like No two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of: \- Agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself. \- Working through architecture and priorities with our CTO, then turning them into shipped code. \- Whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes. \- Digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness. \- Spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it. \- Showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next. Perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits) \- Founding member of the NJ office. You'll help shape how it works. \- First dibs on the whiteboard. \- You pick the office coffee machine. Choose wisely. \- You get to name the agents. \- The CEO is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no. \- Your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months. Must\-haves AI (front and center) \- You ship with AI coding agents daily: Cursor, the Grok ecosystem (including Grok Bot), and similar tools. You have a setup, opinions, and receipts. \- You're current with today's AI tools and how they're changing month to month. \- You've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships. \- You verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right." \- You keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it. Fundamentals (you own the result) \- You can build and debug it yourself, without AI, when needed. Reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you. \- Solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later. \- Strong PHP and Laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and Eloquent without the N\+1 drama. \- Real SQL skills (MySQL): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself. \- Debugging: logs, stack traces, Xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms. \- Security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, OWASP top risks, secrets handling. The rest of the stack \- Vue and Tailwind on the front end. \- REST APIs: designing them and integrating with third\-party ones. \- Redis for queues, caching, and locks. \- Cloud experience (AWS a plus). \- Testing with Pest or PHPUnit. \- CI/CD with GitHub Actions or similar. \- Admin panel tools like Laravel Nova or Filament. How you work \- Initiative. You find the work instead of waiting for it. \- Ownership. If you shipped it (or your agents did), it's yours to understand, fix, and improve. \- You work well in a small core: direct with our CTO, clear about your reasoning, and happy to explain it to an agent or to a person. \- You can show real, shipped work. We care about what you can do, not a years\-of\-experience number. \- You can commute to the Mahwah / Wyckoff area and want to be in the office. Nice\-to\-haves \- Infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, Pulumi, or similar). \- Observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts. \- You've built your own MCP servers, agent tools, or custom agent integrations. \- Evals for prompts and agents. \- Laravel Horizon, Octane, Pulse, or Reverb. \- Threat modeling and secrets management beyond the basics. \- Open\-source work, side projects, or talks at meetups. How to apply Email jobs@nuimagemedical.com with the subject line "AI Engineer – NJ" and include: 1\. Your GitHub, portfolio, or anything you've shipped that we can look at. 2\. A short note (a few paragraphs is perfect) on the coolest thing you've built with AI agents. What it did, how you set up the agents, what went wrong, and how you fixed it. This is the part I'll read first. 3\. Where you're based. No cover\-letter templates, please. Write it the way you'd explain it to a friend. Nu Image Medical, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543\) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions. **Position Summary** OrganOx is in the process of expanding its engineering capability and is seeking an enthusiastic Product Engineer to join the Product Engineering team. As part of a small multi\-disciplinary Product Engineering team, the successful candidate will have responsibility for activities focused on the existing product range in the following areas; * Support the implementation and verification of design changes on the existing product range, to introduce new features and functionality and drive continuous improvement. * Work closely with the operations team in resolving component obsolescence, manufacturing issues, or complaints on the existing OrganOx product.This will require close partnership with field\-based Customer service, Operations, and Quality teams. * Supporting the creation of assembly and test instructions required by the Operations team and suppliers, to ensure the transfer of designs to production are delivered in accordance with design change and operational SOPs. * Working closely with Product Development and Innovations teams throughout development projects with a focus on supporting design reviews and design transfer activities. The ideal candidate will have a background in relevant science or engineering discipline. The successful candidate will work within a small, multi\-disciplinary team of engineers, including electronics, mechanical and software development. The post holder will support activities relating to design changes and develop test strategies to ensure all changes are effectively implemented. The candidate requires excellent written and verbal communication skills to document their activities in line with the ISO13485 Quality Management System, planning and reporting on their work to a standard suitable for review by regulatory authorities. Listed below are the key responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. **Major Responsibilities** The Product Engineer will be responsible for: * Contributing to design changes to support product, production and quality improvements. This includes conducting problem\-solving efforts and root cause analysis. * Investigating device performance issues, determining, and reporting the root cause (in collaboration with the quality, service and operations departments), and recommending corrective actions. * Interpreting and understanding the product’s intended use, clinical procedures, customer needs and design inputs. * Creating and/or refining engineering documentation, such as the Design History File and the Device Master Record. * Following, learning, and contributing to R\&D procedures, such as failure analysis, design controls and risk management, per the Quality Management System. * Assisting prototyping efforts and bench testing. * Prepare reports and conclusions for presentation. * Ensuring compliance with design and development procedures and ensuring all associated documentation is complete in accordance with ISO 13485 and local procedures. **Requirements** **Skills and Experience** The Product Engineer will have: * Demonstrable experience within Product Engineering/Product Development, preferably within medical devices or another highly regulated industry. * Experience with electro\-mechanical devices, with understanding of how to drive, interface with and troubleshoot devices. * Ability to design, implement and carry out experimental test plans for electro\-mechanical, fluid components, sub\-systems, and complete safety\-critical systems. * Ability to produce technical reports to a high standard both in terms of technical content, presentation, and written English. * Enthusiasm, good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multi\-disciplinary team. * Ability to work effectively with outside suppliers and manufacturers. * Ability to work across and manage a range of projects or tasks simultaneously. **Qualifications** The Product Engineer will have: Essential: * Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification/experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or other relevant disciplines. * 5\-7 years of experience of working in a similar role. *A job description does not imply that the duties stated are the only ones to be performed by the job holder. Postholders will be required to follow any other job\-related instruction as reasonably requested by their line manager or their designate.* **Benefits** **We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits available from day one, including health, dental, vision, disability coverage, and flexible spending accounts. Additionally, we offer a 401(k)\-retirement plan with company matching after 90 days, paid time off, holidays, and additional leave benefits, as well as employee discounts and access to our onsite wellness facility. OrganOx supports work\-life balance and provides opportunities for ongoing professional development.**

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Overview: A great platform team is defined not by how many tickets it closes, but by how little friction stands between an engineer's idea and a running service. This engineer is a hands\-on member of the DevOps Platform team who onboards new services, builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines, authors infrastructure as code, deploys and operates containerized and serverless workloads, and keeps the path from lower environments to production reliable. On this team, manual work is a problem to be solved, automation is the default, and every Engineer is expected to use AI to work faster and diagnose more accurately, while understanding and owning every change they ship. Starting base pay for this role is between $100,000 and $122,000\. team's shared pipeline templates. * Contributes changes to shared pipeline templates in a backward\-compatible way, so new options carry safe defaults and existing consumers never break. * Maintains container image discipline, including immutable versioning, registry management, and retention policies, so a redeploy always runs exactly the image that was tested. * Executes promotions from lower environments to production through gated, repeatable pipelines, with roll\-forward as the default recovery path. * Supports the Release team in operating the pipelines DevOps builds, helping them read a failure, retry or approve a stage, and know when to escalate back to DevOps versus the service owner. * Investigates flaky and intermittent pipel nt, environment promotion, and release automation * Experience supporting both Windows and Linux workloads * Regular use of AI development tools and coding assistants, with the judgment to verify and explain what the AI produces * Familiarity with software engineering practices such as test\-driven design, dependency injection, DRY principles, rapid prototyping, and service\-oriented architecture * Strong problem\-solving skills, troubleshooting ability, and attention to detail, with clear written and verbal communication Preferred Qualifications:* AWS certification at the associate level * Kubernetes experience with Helm and workload identity patterns * Experience with GitOps deployment tooling * Experience with database schema\-migration tooling and relational databases * Experience with log search and analytics platforms * Experience with web servers and reverse proxies * Prior experience supporting client product implementations and production rollouts * Familiarity with SOC 2, NIST 800\-53, or ISO/IEC jobs.title: Knowledge Graph / Data Integration Engineer

objects, properties, and relationships. * Implement entity resolution, deduplication, and master\-record matching across source systems. * Develop and maintain data\-quality validation, monitoring, error handling, and recovery processes. * Build services and query interfaces that make ontology data accessible to downstream applications and AI\-enabled workflows. * Work with the Ontology Architect to implement derived properties and rules and validate their behavior against business requirements. * Apply secure engineering practices for sensitive data, including appropriate access product teams to deliver dependable, maintainable data services. **Required Skills and Experience** * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or a closely related discipline. * orchestration or transformation tool such as Airflow, dbt, or Foundry Pipeline Builder. * Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following: Palantir Foundry, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or an RDF triple store, including the relevant query language or tooling. * Experience integrating SaaS and operational systems through REST APIs, webhooks, SFTP, and flat\-file exports. * Understanding of data modeling, data transformation, entity resolution, and data\-quality practices. * Experience building, monitoring, and troubleshooting production data pipelines. * Ability to work with technical and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve data issues. * Working knowledge of secure data\-handling practices, including access controls, encryption, audit logging, and data minimization. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with healthcare or staffing data, including VMS feeds, UKG/Kronos, or credentialing systems. * Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Familiarity with infrastructure as code and automated deployment practices. * Experience using TypeScript or React to build internal tools or applications that consume ontology data. * Experience supporting AI applications or agents through reliable data services, graph queries, or semantic data access. **Competencies** * Strong data jobs.title: Principal Software Architect - SaaS Platform Consolidation & Integration
jobs.description: **Full\-Time \| Contract\-to\-Hire \| Remote (U.S.)** OtterSoft is seeking an accomplished **Principal Software Architect** to lead the architectural strategy and technical execution of consolidating multiple existing software platforms into a unified, next\-generation SaaS product. Our objective is to bring Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and Vendor Management System (VMS) capabilities together into a cohesive, extensible platform that supports the complete workforce lifecycle—from recruiting and candidate management through workforce fulfillment, scheduling, timekeeping, invoicing, and billing. The unified platform will also provide robust integration capabilities with external enterprise systems, including Workday, workforce scheduling platforms, HRIS, payroll, ERP, and other third\-party applications. This role is specifically for an architect who has successfully consolidated multiple existing software products or platforms into a unified production system. We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to designing new applications, connecting systems through APIs, or producing high\-level architecture diagrams. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience resolving overlapping functionality, reconciling disparate data models, defining shared platform capabilities, establishing clear system boundaries, and executing phased migrations while preserving existing business operations. This is a senior individual\-contributor and technical leadership position with ownership of the target\-state architecture, architectural decisions, and technical direction of the consolidation initiative. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. SaaS Platform Consolidation \& Modernization * Lead the architectural consolidation of multiple existing applications into a unified, scalable, enterprise\-grade SaaS platform. * Assess existing platforms to identify duplicated functionality, inconsistent data models, architectural dependencies, technical debt, and opportunities for simplification. * Define the target\-state architecture, including shared platform services, domain boundaries, module responsibilities, service interfaces, and data ownership. * Determine which capabilities should be shared across the platform, which should remain domain\-specific, and which warrant independent deployment. * Develop a phased consolidation roadmap that supports incremental delivery, minimizes operational disruption, and preserves existing customer capabilities. * Establish architectural standards that support extensibility, maintainability, performance, security, reliability, and long\-term product evolution. * Lead architecture decisions that balance strategic modernization with practical delivery timelines and business priorities. 2\. Unified ATS, VMS \& Workforce Architecture * Define a cohesive domain architecture spanning recruiting, applicant tracking, candidate management, job requisitions, submissions, placements, vendor management, workforce orders, onboarding, credentialing, scheduling, timekeeping, invoicing, and billing. * Establish consistent domain models and lifecycle relationships across formerly independent applications. * Define authoritative data ownership for shared entities, including candidates, workers, clients, suppliers, jobs, assignments, and workforce schedules. * Design end\-to\-end workflows that span multiple platform modules without creating unnecessary dependencies or duplicating business logic. * Establish reusable capabilities for workflow configuration, business rules, identity, authorization, notifications, audit logging, reporting, and administration. * Preserve the ability to support customer\-specific processes and configurations without creating separate codebases or product forks. 3\. Enterprise SaaS Architecture * Design a modular, multi\-tenant SaaS architecture capable of supporting multiple customers, organizations, suppliers, staffing programs, and operating models. * Define tenant isolation, security boundaries, access controls, configuration management, and customer\-level customization strategies. * Establish architectural patterns for service communication, API contracts, event\-driven processing, background jobs, and distributed workflows. * Evaluate modular monolith, service\-oriented, microservices, and hybrid architectures based on actual business and technical requirements rather than technology trends. * Define standards for observability, resilience, availability, performance, scalability, and operational support. * Ensure the architecture can accommodate future modules, external partners, new business capabilities, and AI\-enabled features. 4\. Enterprise Integration Architecture * Establish an API\-first integration strategy for connecting the platform to Workday and other HRIS, ERP, payroll, scheduling, timekeeping, identity, and workforce management systems. * Define standardized integration contracts, canonical data models, API versioning, authentication, authori cumentation, interface specifications, system context diagrams, data models, and architecture decision records. * Mentor senior engineers and technical leads while establishing consistent engineering standards and design practices. * Collaborate with product management, security, infrastructure, DevOps, and implementation teams to address architectural dependencies and delivery risks. * Evaluate new technologies and engineering approaches based on measurable business value, maintainability, implementation effort, and total cost of ownership. **Required Qualifications** * 12\+ years of software engineering and architecture experience, including substantial responsibility for enterprise application and SaaS platform design. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience architecting and delivering the consolidation of two or more existing software products or platforms into a unified production system. * Significant experience designing and evolving enterprise SaaS products, preferably multi\-tenant platforms. * Deep understanding of domain\-driven design, modular architecture, distributed systems, data modeling, API design, and enterprise integration patterns. * Proven experience defining shared domain models and resolving overlapping functionality, conflicting data structures, and system\-of\-record ownership. * Experience leading application modernization, phased migrations, backward compatibility, and legacy\-system coexistence. * Strong knowledge of secure enterprise integrations, API lifecycle management, asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, and integration resiliency. * Experience designing platform security, identity and access management, tenant isolation, auditability, and operational resiliency. * Ability to translate business objectives into a target\-state architecture and a practical, prioritized implementation roadmap. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence architectural decisions across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ATS, VMS, staffing technology, contingent workforce management, healthcare staffing, or workforce management platforms. * Experience integrating with Workday and other enterprise HRIS, ERP, payroll, scheduling, or timekeeping systems. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, .NET/C\#, SQL Server, API gateways, message brokers, event streaming, and cloud\-native infrastructure. * Experience establishing canonical data models, master data management practices, and enterprise data synchronization strategies. * Experience modernizing mature commercial software products while maintaining active customer implementations. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled software development and incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise SaaS platforms. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate combines the strategic perspective of an enterprise architect with the practical judgment of an experienced software engineering leader. They have personally navigated the complexity of bringing independently developed products together: reconciling data models, defining shared business capabilities, managing system dependencies, establishing integration contracts, and guiding engineering teams through production implementation. They know when to consolidate, when to preserve modular boundaries, and when independent services are justified. They favor pragmatic architecture that supports rapid delivery without creating unnecessary complexity or long\-term technical debt. The mission is straightforward: transform multiple existing software platforms into one cohesive, extensible SaaS product with a unified architecture, consistent data, reusable integrations, and a sustainable path for future growth. Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $230,000\.00 per year Experience: * Proven SaaS Platform Consolidation: 10 years (Required) * Enterprise Software Architecture: 10 years (Required) * API Design and Enterprise Integration: 10 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

Able to take loosely defined problems, bring structure, and drive to resolution without needing constant direction** **What Success Looks Like:** * Programs are organized, on track, and progressing without constant intervention * Clear, consistent visibility into progress, risks, and next steps * Strong coordination across teams with minimal friction * Reliable execution that builds trust across the organization **﻿Benefits:** Overwatch Construction offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, and relocation assistance available. jobs.title: Data & AI Analyst
jobs.description: **Data \& AI Analyst** **The Opportunity** • Data and AI Analyst at a growth\-oriented energy company • Collaborate with senior technical professionals to develop the data and AI foundations that support critical Refining \& Logistics, Retail, and Finance operations across Par Pacific. • Gain hands\-on experience developing and deploying enterprise software solutions in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). • Work closely with business and technical teams to understand complex business processes and transform manual, repetitive work into automated, scalable cloud\-based workflows. • Grow your skills through hands\-on work by building real\-world solutions as part of larger technology initiatives, with experienced technical professionals providing mentorship and guidance on architecture, standards, and code reviews. • Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Data and Applications, you will work day\-to\-day with our Senior Developer and Data Architect, to contribute to the development of data pipelines, internal tooling, and AI\-enabled automation. Key activities include: Data \& SQL • Assist in building and maintaining ETL workflows on Google Cloud Platform, primarily in BigQuery, with support from the Data Architect on modeling and design decisions • Contribute to data quality checks, validation logic, and documentation for pipelines the team owns • Support ad hoc data pulls and analysis requests from business teams, escalating larger requests to the appropriate data resource Cloud \& Development Practices • Deploy and maintain assigned components in GCP under the direction of senior team members, building foundational fluency in the services Par Pacific already runs on • Learn and apply the team's development practices: version control, code review, environment promotion, basic CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code exposure • Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting for workflows the team supports • Follow established security, access, and governance standards; raise questions early when a requirement is unclear AI \& Automation • Sit with business stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done today — the manual steps, the handoffs, the spreadsheets — and help document those processes clearly • Partner with the Senior Developer and Data Architect to evaluate where AI and automation are a good fit, and where they are not • Translate agreed\-upon business logic into working prototypes, then help harden those prototypes into reliable, automated services deployed through the enterprise's existing cloud platforms • Assist in integrating AI components with enterprise data sources and identity/access tooling, connecting the pieces between systems that do not yet talk to each other • Contribute to testing, evaluation, and iteration of automated workflows once they are live Collaboration • Work closely with a small, lean technical team where your work is visible and your questions get answered directly • Coordinate with business, ERP, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements and confirm assumptions before building • Communicate progress, blockers, and findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences Note: This description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. Additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs. **Qualifications** To meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship. Additional qualifications include: • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred • Minimum 1 year of professional experience in software development, data engineering, data analysis, or a comparable technical role required; relevant internship, co\-op, bootcamp, or substantial personal project work will be considered • Working proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregation, and window functions, with the ability to reason about query performance, required • Proficiency in Python for scripting, data manipulation, and automation preferred • Foundational understanding of cloud concepts and at least introductory hands\-on exposure to GCP or AWS (compute, storage, IAM basics) required • Familiarity with modern AI tooling — LLM APIs, prompting, or agent frameworks — and a practical sense of what these tools are and are not good at, required • Demonstrated ability to break a problem down, ask clarifying questions, and communicate a solution in plain language required • Comfort working in a lean environment where priorities shift • Experience with Git and collaborative version control workflows preferred • Exposure to data modeling concepts (dimensional, relational, or semantic) preferred • Exposure to BI tooling such as Looker or Power BI preferred • Exposure to containers, CI/CD pipeli n, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know\-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments. **More Good Reasons to Work for Par Pacific** **Unique Culture and RICH Values** There is nothing ordinary about Par Pacific \- a niche player in the energy space. And there's certainly nothing ordinary about Par Pacific employees. We are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial\-minded professionals who love to win. Our RICH values describe how we approach our work: Respect for Others, Integrity, Collaborative Innovation, and Heart. If that describes you, you'll fit right in. **Location, Location, Location** Because Par Pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. The office where you'll work is in the CityCentre in Houston, Texas, located on the west side of Houston near I\-10 and the Sam Houston Tollway. It's a vibrant area of the city with plenty of places for lunch or to wind down after work. **Opportunistic Growth Strategy** At Par Pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. Our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies. **Focused on the Future** We are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. We are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions. **Excellent Compensation and Benefits** In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. Full\-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/AD\&D insurance, Flexible Spending Account and Employee Assistance Program. Employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the Employee Stock Purchase Program. **Our Headquarters** Par Pacific Holdings, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. We are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the Western United States. Par Pacific also owns 46% of Laramie Energy, LLC, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in Western Colorado. Our common stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the trading symbol "PARR". **Our Refineries and Logistics Operations** We own and operate refineries in Hawaii, Montana, Washington, and Wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 Mbpd. Establish standards for data ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, quality, lifecycle management, access control, AI usage, auditability, and enterprise data governance. * Protect customer and tenant data. Deep understanding of production AI systems including LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, semantic and vector search, agentic architectures, AI orchestration, evaluation, observability, governance, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems. * Enterprise data architecture. Significant experience directing the architecture of platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured enterprise data. * Document\-intensive domains. Experience with architectures where documents and unstructured information are important business assets supporting operational workflows, search, analytics, AI, and governance. * Cloud and modern data platforms. Experience establishing strategy around AWS\-native data services including S3, Redshift, streaming and event technologies, as well as platforms such as Snowflake and/or Databricks. * Modern data architecture. Overview: The Lead iOS Engineer is a leading velocity contributor for a cross\-functional delivery Pod, responsible for shaping, reinforcing, and executing the technical direction of iOS applications. This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in\-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work\-from\-home. jobs.title: Director, Operations Engineering
jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership. **About the role** The Director of Operations Engineering is responsible for the technical strategy, continuous improvement, and engineering support of Prime's operating data centers. This team is separate from Design and Construction; its focus is the facilities already in service and the people who run them. Reporting to the SVP of Critical Operations, the Director is the engineering partner to Critical Facility Managers (CFMs) and Chief Engineers (CEs) across the portfolio. The Director provides senior technical support and troubleshooting, owns the root cause analysis program, and drives measurable improvement in equipment reliability. The Director also brings rigor and visibility to the engineering requirements that govern how Prime's sites are operated, maintained, and changed, including studies, single\-lines, settings, procedures, and change control. This is a platform role. It requires strong planning abilities, leadership through influence, and a proactive partnership approach, underpinned by a robust engineering background. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineering leader with real time on the operations side of mission\-critical facilities, with experience in electrical and mechanical systems and an understanding of large\-scale data centers or comparable environments. They should be equally comfortable working through a UPS failure on a bridge call at 2 a.m. and building the program that keeps it from happening again. They earn credibility with site teams by showing up and solving problems, and they turn what they learn into standards, data, and feedback for the teams designing and building Prime's next facilities. This role supports a 24x7x365 operating environment and includes participation in an escalation on\-call rotation for critical events. **What you'll do** Site Engineering Support \& Troubleshooting * Build and lead a team of operations/reliability engineers (electrical, mechanical, and controls) dedicated to supporting operating sites. * Serve as the senior technical escalation path for CFMs and CEs on complex electrical, mechanical, controls, and fire/life safety issues. * Establish a clear intake, triage, and response model for site engineering requests, with defined response expectations and tracking. * Provide on\-site and remote troubleshooting support during critical events and recoveries, with the goal of achieving uptime and customer SLA commitments. **Root Cause Analysis Program** * Own Prime's RCA program: methodology, severity thresholds that trigger an RCA, report standards, training, corrective action tracking, and closure verification. * Provide technical support to CFMs and CEs, who own and lead site RCAs. This support includes failure analysis, data review, and coordination with OEMs, service vendors, and forensic labs. * Review RCAs for technical quality and consistency, and make sure corrective actions address true root causes. * Share findings and lessons learned across all sites so a failure at one site becomes a fix everywhere. **Equipment Reliability** * Develop and run a portfolio\-wide reliability program covering asset criticality ranking, failure trending, FMEA, and PM optimization (RCM\-based where appropriate). * Use CMMS, BMS/EPMS, and incident data to find bad actors, recurring failures, and fleet\-wide equipment issues, and drive resolution with OEMs. * Define critical spares strategy and condition\-based maintenance practices such as IR thermography, oil and vibration analysis, and battery monitoring. * Drive innovation in facilities programs and systems to improve quality and reliability and to reduce operating costs, with an environmentally conscious approach. * Report reliability KPIs to Critical Operations leadership. * Engineering Requirements, Visibility \& Rigor * Establish and maintain the engineering baseline for each operating site: current single\-lines, short\-circuit/coordination/arc flash studies, protective relay and breaker settings, sequences of operation, and as\-built documentation. * Implement and govern the engineering side of the formal change management process for operating sites so modifications receive appropriate technical review and documentation updates. * Provide technical review of higher\-risk Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and Emergency Operating/Response Procedures (EOPs/ERPs), in coordination with Prime's procedure policy. * Implement operating standards required for quality, safety, and ongoing operation, and assist site engineering and management with compliance with OSHA, national and local elect ctions, and turnover packages, and it gives sites a voice early in the project lifecycle so new facilities are built to be operated and maintained. * Hold regular touchpoints with CFMs and CEs to align on open issues, reliability concerns, and engineering needs. * Feed RCA findings, reliability data, and operability lessons back into design standards and equipment specifications. * Act as the bridge between site teams and Engineering/Design when operational issues trace back to design or construction decisions. * Interface with OEMs, service vendors, Prime Engineering, Development, and peer operations organizations. * Leadership * Hire, develop, and mentor a high\-performing engineering team; define roles, career paths, and regional coverage; ensure proper training and growth of staff. * Manage department staffing, expenditures, and budget in line with financial goals, along with outside engineering resources (study firms, OEM field engineering, forensic labs). * Maintain positive relationships and clear communication with site staff and executive leadership. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or a related discipline), or HVAC/critical power certifications, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree. * 8\+ years of professional experience managing teams, developing and implementing strategic initiatives, and overseeing departmental operations. * 8\+ years of direct engineering experience in a technical or critical environment (data center, hospital, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, nuclear, or industrial/commercial field engineering), including significant time supporting operating facilities rather than design/construction alone. * Demonstrated experience leading formal RCAs and implementing corrective actions. * Working knowledge of NFPA 70E, NFPA 70B, NEC, OSHA requirements, and relevant ASHRAE guidance. * Ability to travel an estimated 10\-30% and to respond to major incidents outside business hours. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Fluent in, and with an excellent working knowledge of, data center critical and construction environments. * Advanced understanding of mechanical and electrical equipment, systems, and design for data centers, including MV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, UPS, STS/ATS, PDUs, VFDs, generators, chillers (air\- and water\-cooled), pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, and liquid cooling. * Experience with emergency backup systems (generators, UPS, battery backup) and with BMS/EPMS and building controls. * Working knowledge of fire alarm/suppression and other life safety systems, and of building subsystems such as security and access control. * Ability to develop solutions and create technical, strategic, and tactical plans on complex projects, and to lead through influence across operations, development, and vendor organizations. * Ability to find creative solutions that improve quality and reliability while continuously driving down operating costs. * Familiarity with CMMS platforms, reliability analytics, and project/commissioning management software. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range and performance bonus jobs.title: Project Lead Engineer - High Voltage Industrial and Data Centers
jobs.description: We are a leading global provider of innovative automotive and industrial electronic products, including center stacks, switch banks, sensors, high\-voltage busbars, Battery Disconnect Units (BDU), Integrated Circuit Boards (ICB), park brake actuators, ambient lights, and Center High\-Mount Stop Lights (CHMSL). Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability positions us at the forefront of the industry, delivering high\-performance power distribution solutions to customers worldwide. **Role Purpose** We are seeking a highly qualified **Mechanical Engineer** to play a crucial role in the Product Development lifecycle of innovative high\-voltage power distribution components. This role owns the design, analysis, and validation of critical systems, with a core focus on **data center busbars**, industrial power pathways, and wire harnesses. Leading projects from concept to production launch, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry experts to ensure designs meet rigorous electrical, thermal, structural, and manufacturing specifications. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design \& New Product Development (NPD):** Specify, design, and develop high\-voltage components, focusing on **data center busbars** and high\-power wire harnesses. Utilize advanced 3D CAD software to generate detailed models, architectural layouts, and production\-ready manufacturing drawings. * **Vertical Busbar Engineering \& Attributes:** Optimize vertical busbar architectures for critical data center infrastructure, ensuring precise execution of core attributes: + *Electrical \& Thermal:* Manage high current density, skin effect, voltage drop constraints and short\-circuit current ratings. + *Mechanical \& Structural:* Design for seismic bracing requirements, structural loading, expansion joints (to handle thermal expansion/contraction across multi\-story risers), and joint integrity. + *Ingress \& Insulation:* Incorporate proper phase isolation, epoxy coating, heat\-shrink insulation, and appropriate Ingress Protection (IP) ratings. * **Analysis \& Simulation:** Collaborate with FEA analysts to define model setups, boundary conditions, and assumptions.
