jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **To apply:** **https://hr.cccs.edu/jobs/search/system\-office\-search\-page** **Description of Job** ---------------------- The Colorado Community College System is hiring a Senior Programmer Analyst to join our Career \& Technical Education (CTE) department at the CCCS System Office. We are looking for a skilled problem solver who can research, propose, and implement solutions. If you’re looking for a full stack developer opportunity on a small, tightknit team where your work will impact students throughout Colorado, this position may be for you! In this position you’ll provide technical support and problem solving for a variety of Career \& Technical Education (CTE) Gateway application and technical issues, working closely with the Customer Support Team, other CCCS\-IT teams, and other developers. This is a highly collaborative role, and you will need to be able to translate complex technical information for end users. You’ll be responsible for analyzing, designing, developing, documenting, reviewing, and testing complex functions, modules, and programs in order to support the CTE in Colorado database, web application, and data reports. The Colorado CTE Gateway is the single site in which all Career and Technical Education (CTE) program and contact management and reporting, including for state and federal CTE funding, is housed. This custom\-built, cloud\-based web application software is owned, developed, and maintained by the CTE Accountability team. It is built on Azure services such as Azure SQL, and Web Services. The API is written in C\# and front end is in ReactJS. **Note: All interviews for this position will be hosted in person at our office in Denver, Colorado. Travel reimbursement to the interviews is not available. All work for this role must be completed in the state of Colorado; relocation expenses are not available for this position.** **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Plan, design, develop, configure, test, deploy and support structure and content of the CTE web application (C \#, React, JavaScript, TypeScript), database, and reports (SQL), including both ad hoc and packaged reports. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Troubleshoot related issues as they arise and apply project management skills on development projects. * Conduct code reviews and other walkthroughs for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Develop and perform unit testing on programs/functions and work with others to contribute to test plans. * Participate in and complete work tickets related to review, troubleshooting, development, and testing of fixes to bugs or enhancements in the application or infrastructure. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, Common Table Expressions, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Conduct web accessibility mediation of CTE web applications and related duties, such as coaching/training staff, to support compliance with Section 508 and current WCAG standards. **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in technology, computer science, or related field. A combination of relevant education, training, and/or experience may substitute for the degree. * Minimum of two years of software or database development experience, at least some of which must be experience with Microsoft Azure, such as Webjobs, Cloud Architecture, Functions, Data Factory pipelines, storage, and B2C authentication. * Experience with programming languages, including C\# and React, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Competencies/KSAs** * Knowledgeable about CTE programs, especially in Colorado and with the Colorado CTE Gateway application preferred but not required. * Working knowledge of relational database applications such as MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, MySQL, Oracle, etc. * Practiced in running SQL queries. * Familiar with React\-Redux library. * Familiar with project management and application/software life cycle; methodologies like Agile scrum and Kanban; and tools like Team Foundation Server, Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. * Ability to identify user needs, conduct problem analysis, and provide technical solutions. * Awareness of Model View Controller pattern, Microsoft Entity framework, and design patterns usage. * Familiar with frontend and backend development of websites and applications. * Able to understand the importance of following established state and federal statutes and internal policies and business processes. * Ability to: work independently when given direction, work well in a team environment, and work well in a deadline driven environment, including adjusting to frequent changing work priorities. * Attention to detail while working timely under mandatory deadlines. * Strong Excel skills. * Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills with audiences of varying technical skills. * Familiar with, or ability to learn, Selenium. * Awareness of cloud\-based infrastructure design and implementation, specifically Azure and/or Dev Ops. * Moderate skills using IDE tools (i.e. Visual Studio). * Familiarity with continuous integration/delivery/deployment (CI/CD). * Practiced in multi\-tasking and with task prioritization when given various assignments. The Colorado Community College System is the state’s largest provider of higher education and workforce training, consisting of 13 colleges and over 35 locations across the state, educating approximately 130,000 postsecondary students annually. In addition, we train more than 4,000 Coloradans each year through customized employer training programs and coordinate delivery of career and technical education (CTE) programs to over 165,000 K\-12 learners annually. Our mission is to provide accessible, responsive learning environments where students can achieve their educational, professional and personal goals in an atmosphere that embraces academic excellence, diversity and innovation. We are an organization that encourages individuals to bring their whole selves to work. Work Location/Travel Expectations: * CCCS offices at 9101 E Lowry Blvd., Denver, CO 80230\. * Travel is rare for this position; on occasion there may be opportunities for in\-state or out\-of\-state meetings/conferences. * Alternative work arrangements, including flexible schedules and hybrid\-remote work may be available. All work must be completed in the state of Colorado. Note: per the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, an applicant may redact information from their resume, cover letter, and/or transcripts that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. If your position requires us to review an official transcript, without redacting, we will request one as part of our conditional offer process. In order to evaluate work experience against established requirements for positions, we are still requesting dates of service **(month and year)** for positions in the applicant’s work history.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed. ### **About the Role** You will own embedded firmware across Rainmaker’s vehicle and its integration with our onboard and ground control software systems. Your scope includes flight\-controller firmware, power distribution, sensor and payload controllers, and the interfaces connecting those systems to onboard Linux software. You will take work from architecture and board bring\-up through testing, manufacturing, deployment, and support in the field. We’re looking for a high\-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the hardware works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands\-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the firmware architecture and the responsibility to deliver it.### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of all embedded firmware across the vehicle, including flight\-controller firmware, power distribution, sensors, and seeding payloads. * Set firmware priorities, identify reliability risks and technical gaps, and drive projects from an ambiguous problem to a validated release. * Bring up new boards with electrical engineers: read schematics, validate interfaces, write drivers, and debug failures at the boundary between hardware and software. * Develop dependable device communication and command handling over CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C, with clear contracts for telemetry, timing, and fault behavior. * Integrate firmware with our vehicle software so commands, device state, and telemetry behave consistently from the microcontroller to the operator. * Design and validate safe startup states, watchdogs, interlocks, and recovery behavior for resets, communication loss, sensor faults, and interrupted updates. * Own firmware builds, versioning, flashing, over\-the\-air updates, and recovery workflows so deployed vehicles run known, traceable software. * Build automated tests, simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet. * Partner with manufacturing and flight operations to make provisioning, calibration, diagnostics, and servicing repeatable and practical. * Investigate bench and field failures using logs, telemetry, and lab instruments; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software and tests. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing embedded software or firmware for microcontroller\-based systems, including board bring\-up, hardware integration, and deployment into production or field use. * Demonstrated ownership of an embedded subsystem from design through release and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently, validating behavior on hardware, and resolving failures in real operating conditions. * Strong systems programming skills in Rust and/or C/C\+\+, with the ability and willingness to work across both Rust and C/C\+\+ codebases. * Practical experience with peripheral drivers and communication buses such as CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C. * Comfort reading schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers to isolate problems across electrical and software boundaries. * The ability to reason about system failures and implement robust state machines, fault detection, safe outputs, and recovery paths. * Experience building maintainable firmware with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices. * Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results. * Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can build and service what you ship. ### **What Will Set You Apart** * Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other systems where software controls physical equipment in demanding conditions. * Familiarity with PX4, MAVLink, flight\-controller development, or flight\-critical software. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You have mapped the vehicle’s firmware, hardware interfaces, build and update paths, and most consequential reliability risks, and the team has a clear plan for what to address first. You can independently build, flash, instrument, and debug the key embedded systems and trace their behavior through our vehicle software. You have delivered a meaningful firmware improvement through bench and integration testing into an operational release, working with flight operations to verify its behavior in the field. You have improved at least one recurring source of friction in testing, provisioning, updates, or diagnostics, and established a practical ownership and release cadence for the firmware stack. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * **A stake in what we build.** Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * **Support for your health.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **An investment in your future.** A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * **Time to recharge.** Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * **Time for a growing family.** Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * **Lunch together.** Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * **Help making the move.** Relocation assistance for eligible roles to support your transition to Rainmaker.

jobs.description: **DIRECTOR, AI \& DATA SCIENCE** Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science \| Full\-Time, Salaried \| Player\-Coach \| Reports to the Co\-CEOs *A hands\-on director who leads six or seven people, writes production code every week, and solves our most immediate problems first: fully automated moderation and AI customer support.* **Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media) **Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA **Team** Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps **Education** Master's degree required. You will lead our combined Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co\-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous\-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results. Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them. This role is for someone who manages a hands\-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading. **What You Will Do** **1\. Set the foundation in your first 30 days** * Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it. * Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps. * Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix. **2\. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%** * Test the AI and our moderators on the same held\-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy\-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals. * Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback. **3\. Build systems that keep getting better** * Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test. * Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back. **4\. Run production AI like a business** * Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills. * Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance. Keep one executive dashboard and run a weekly review with the Co\-CEOs. **5\. Automate support, then partner across Seeking** * Own AI customer support end to end: agents that resolve tickets and execute approved actions, such as subscription changes and eligible refunds, held to the same evaluation, rollout, and monitoring standards as moderation. * Once moderation and support are delivered, partner with the leaders of Marketing, Product, and other departments on fraud, matching, onboarding, monetization, and retention. Bring the Co\-CEOs a ranked list of opportunities by impact on cost, revenue, efficiency, and member experience. * In those partnerships, department leaders own their business outcomes. Your team owns the models, infrastructure, evaluation, and learning systems, and is acc ntly. * Strong Python and SQL, with production code you personally wrote in the past year. You will code in the interview. * Production ML and architecture judgment. You have designed, built, and operated ML and LLM systems end to end, from data pipelines through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, on a major cloud platform. * You have done this before. You led an AI automation program in moderation, trust and safety, support, or a comparable decision system, from a measured human baseline to automated decisions at scale. * Evaluation rigor and continuous learning. You measure false negatives and false positives separately, report uncertainty, keep test data clean, and have built systems that improve through feedback and controlled updates. * Measurable business impact. You can name the cost, revenue, efficiency, or member outcomes your work moved, with the numbers. * Cross\-functional influence. You have found AI opportunities in other departments, won over their leaders, and taken the solution from concept into production. * A record of mentoring engineers and scientists into stronger, more senior contributors. * Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable AI tools. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you. **Nice to Have** * A Ph.D. in a relevant field. Consumer, dating, or social platform experience. * Production work in multi\-modal or computer vision moderation, fraud detection, recommender systems, or marketing and monetization models such as propensity, pricing, and lifetime value. * Our stack: AWS (S3, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock), Looker, and Kubernetes. **Compensation** * $180,000 to $230,000 base, commensurate with experience. Full\-time, salaried, remote within the US. * 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision. 50% 401(k) match up to 6%. Flexible Spending Account and flexible paid time off. **How We Hire** * Recruiter screen: code you wrote in the last 90 days, the team you manage, and logistics. * Practical round: live SQL and Python, plus a production architecture discussion. * Systems round: work through a simplified moderation workflow. Find where items fall back to humans, define an honest automation rate, and design the evaluation against human moderators. * Co\-CEO round: treat it as a pitch. Study the product, ask sharp questions, and bring your 90\-day plan for moderation and customer support. * References, including a former direct report. **How to Apply** Send your resume to careers@seeking.com with the subject line "Director, AI \& Data Science Application" and answer these questions. Brevity is welcome. Specificity is required. * Describe an AI system you personally helped build that automated work people used to do. What code did you write, how did you prove it beat the prior baseline, and what did it save or earn? * Tell us about a time you inherited a mess: conflicting answers across teams, unclear ownership, or no baseline. What did you do in the first 30 days, and what changed? * How would you take customer support to AI resolution of member tickets, and how would you prove quality and member satisfaction held up? * Tell us about someone you mentored. What can they do now that they could not do before? **We hire by proof. Show us what you built, who you grew, and the results you moved.** **Equal Opportunity Employer** Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check. IIuzC1gZDg

Informed point of view on agentic AI, including multi\-step agent design with the judgment to know where these approaches outperform a conventional model and where they do not. * Understanding of MLOps practices, including model registry, feature store, retraining pipelines, and drift monitoring. * Strong business acumen and the credibility to work with field operations leaders and technical practitioners. * Demonstrated ownership of an analytics function serving a large operational or field\-based business such as waste, logistics, transportation, distribution, utilities, field services, or manufacturing. * Track record of delivering machine learning into production and sustaining it, including monitoring, retraining, drift management, and handoff to engineering. * Experience running enterprise analytics as a product at scale. * Hands\-on experience deploying generative AI or large language model solutions into enterprise production. * Experience leading through other managers within a large, matrixed organization with a history of partnering with Information Technology, Enterprise Data, and business stakeholders. * Experience building and championing a resourcing case covering headcount, contract labor, funding sources. * Route\-based or fleet operations experience preferred; geospatial analytics, telematics, and routing optimization experie  it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. **Our company values guide our daily actions:** * Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities. * Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations. * Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. * Driven: We deliver results in the right way. * Human\-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. In addition, our team positively impacted 5\.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend- Security
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for a hands\-on Senior Engineer to play a key role in building Rippling's Security program. Rippling's product’s scope provides a unique set of security challenges, but our management is especially supportive of security and compliance as a central function of the business. As an early member of Rippling's security team, you'll have a meaningful impact on the security program’s priorities and direction. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi\-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data. This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI\-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise\-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own the design and implementation of backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities. * Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems for high\-volume workflows across Spend, IT, identity, access, approvals, and compliance. * Make strategic technical decisions around architecture, infrastructure, data modeling, performance, and operational reliability. * Translate ambiguous business and customer needs into robust technical solutions in partnership with product, frontend, platform, design, and cross\-functional teams. * Build and evolve systems involving workflows, permissions, policy enforcement, financial operations, device and app management, procurement, and security controls. * Raise the technical bar through system design, code reviews, design reviews, mentorship, and backend engineering best practices. * Help create unified product experiences that replace fragmented point solutions for managing employees, spend, devices, apps, access, and business operations. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Go, or a similar high\-scale backend language. * Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases. * You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale. * Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery. * Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross\-functional stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large\-scale enterprise transformation. **About the role:** ------------------- We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production\-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real\-world data. You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re\-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low\-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions. * Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems. * Turn complex processes into multi\-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire\-to\-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs. * Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling. * Leverage full\-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high\-ownership, user\-facing agent systems. * Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human\-in\-the\-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time. * Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused. **Experience you’ll need:** --------------------------- * Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands\-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes. * Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces. * A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here. ### **Software engineering skills and best practices:** * System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures. * Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance. Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents. * Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve sy ext graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms. * Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks. * Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks. * Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores. * UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output. The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $188,500—$282,700 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Engineer 1 - Nuclear
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Sargent \& Lundy is seeking a Senior Mechanical Project Engineer to support nuclear plant modification and engineering projects at the Calvert Cliffs Clean Energy Center. The role will require approximately two to three days on\-site each week at CCCEC, with the flexibility to work remotely the other days. The successful candidate will provide senior\-level mechanical engineering direction, coordinate multidisciplinary activities, and serve as a key technical interface among Sargent \& Lundy, Constellation, CCCEC station personnel, vendors, and project stakeholders. The role will support mechanical system evaluations, plant modifications, Engineering Change packages, calculations, studies, equipment and piping design, specifications, design reviews, field walkdowns, and implementation support. The engineer will also contribute to project execution by managing assigned scope, budget, schedule, deliverables, risks, and technical interfaces. **Responsibilities:** * Lead or support mechanical engineering activities for nuclear plant modifications and related projects at CCCEC. * Develop and review mechanical design inputs, calculations, evaluations, studies, reports, drawings, specifications, and implementation documentation. * Support engineering for mechanical systems and equipment, including pumps, piping, heat exchangers, HVAC, balance\-of\-plant systems, supports, and mechanical interfaces, as assigned. * Prepare and review Engineering Change packages and related conceptual, detailed, and implementation\-phase deliverables. * Evaluate system performance, equipment impacts, operating conditions, design requirements, and mechanical interfaces associated with plant modifications and power uprate activities. * Review vendor drawings, calculations, specifications, equipment data, and other technical submittals; identify missing information and follow up on required vendor inputs. * Participate in project kickoff meetings, technical focus meetings, design reviews, milestone reviews, field walkdowns, constructability reviews, comment\-resolution meetings, and client coordination meetings. * Coordinate mechanical interfaces with electrical, I\&C, structural, civil, fire protection, licensing, procurement, construction, operations, and other disciplines. * Support installation, testing, startup, outage, and implementation activities, including development or review of implementation and testing documentation. * Serve as a technical liaison with Constellation and CCCEC personnel and communicate technical issues, assumptions, decisions, risks, and required actions clearly and promptly. * Develop mechanical input to multidisciplinary budgets, schedules, work plans, proposals, and resource plans. * Monitor assigned scope, budget, schedule, progress, and deliverable status; identify trends early and elevate risks before commitments are affected. * Support project controls and change management, including evaluation of scope growth, schedule impacts, budget impacts, and changes to technical requirements. * Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable Sargent \& Lundy procedures, client procedures, quality requirements, codes, standards, and project instructions. * Support client presentations, proposal development, technical discussions, and identification of follow\-on engineering opportunities. **Other Opportunities Provided:** * The opportunity to work on challenging nuclear power projects with experienced engineers and project professionals. * A multidisciplinary environment that supports technical growth, collaboration, and professional development. * The opportunity to contribute to projects that support safe, reliable, and carbon\-free energy. * A hybrid work arrangement that combines remote flexibility with regular onsite collaboration at CCCEC. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.*** **Required Qualifications:** + Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; equivalent experience may be considered. + Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible mechanical engineering and project experience. + Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating mechanical engineering work for complex industrial, utility, power\-generation, or nuclear projects. + Experience developing or reviewing mechanical calculations, evaluations, drawings, specifications, reports, and technical documentation. + Experience coordinating technical work across multiple disciplines and managing interfaces among engineering, design, procurement, vendors, construction, operations, and client organizations. + Experience with project planning, task budgeting, schedule development or monitoring, progress reporting, change management, and risk identification. + Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. + Ability  plier technical questions. + Familiarity with applicable nuclear industry codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and quality\-assurance practices. + Experience with field walkdowns, constructability reviews, installation support, testing, startup, or commissioning activities. + Proficiency with common engineering, project\-controls, document\-management, and Microsoft Office tools. Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description. About Sargent \& Lundy: At Sargent \& Lundy, we care about the health and well\-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work\-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award\-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024\. **Health \& Wellness** **Financial Benefits** **Work\-Life Balance** * Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision * Life \& Accident Insurance * Disability Coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Back\-Up Daycare * FSA \& HSA * 401(k) * Pre\-Tax Commuter Account * Merit Scholarship Program * Employee Discount Program * Corporate Charitable Giving Program * Tuition Assistance * First Professional Licensure Bonus * Employee Referral Bonus * Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST) * Paid Vacation * Paid Holidays * Paid Parental Leave * Paid Bereavement Leave * Flexible Work Arrangements Compensation Range: $118,023 \- $180,313 Transparency Statement: Sargent \& Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well\-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus. About This Business Unit: Join Sargent \& Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon\-free energy. Since 1954, we’ve been a trusted leader in nuclear engineering, design, and licensing, with expertise spanning small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactor technology (ART), and first\-of\-a\-kind commercial reactor restart projects. Our work supports life extensions and digital modernization of existing nuclear plants, coal\-to\-nuclear conversion initiatives with the Department of State, and international nuclear new\-build projects. With a commitment to safety, innovation, and sustainability, we provide cutting\-edge solutions that power communities worldwide while reducing emissions. Shape the future of global energy with us! Equal Opportunity: Sargent \& Lundy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any protected status as defined by applicable law.

jobs.description: Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is looking for someone to join our Manufacturing Operations team as a Process Engineer in Nampa, Idaho. If you are looking to grow your career and are motivated by solving meaningful problems, we encourage you to apply today! As a Process Engineer on the Inspection System team, you will help define and support the inspection technologies used across SEL’s manufacturing operations. Rather than supporting a single product or process area, you will specify, validate, and continuously improve SPI, AOI, and AXI systems deployed across multiple factories and product families. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * **Nice\-to\-have:** agentic systems depth beyond the gate above. Can speak concretely to how AI agents are actually built and operated — e.g., the MCP protocol and what a harne stem to enforce that. **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. jobs.title: Principal, Agentic Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **General Information** ----------------------- Locations * Atlanta, GA * Boston, MA * Chicago, IL * Dallas, TX * Denver, CO * Los Angeles, CA * Philadelphia, PA * Seattle, WA Business Function Cloud innovation \& modernization Date posted Monday, October 12, 2026 Ref \# JBR0001859 **Description and Requirements** -------------------------------- Job Description **Agentic Reliability Engineer (ARE)** Slalom · Agentic Managed Services · Remote (US) with possible client travel · Principal or Senior Principal level **ABOUT THE ROLE** AI agents are moving into production faster than most organizations can operate them reliably and closing that gap is exactly why Slalom built its Agentic Managed Services (AMS) practice. As an Agentic Reliability Engineer, you are the technical heart of that work: the engineer who makes AI agents dependable in the real world. Where a traditional Site Reliability Engineer keeps software services healthy, you own the reliability of AI agents. These are systems that reason, make decisions, and act on a client's behalf, but can fail in ways classical engineering never had to consider. You'll help design and stand up agentic solutions with clients, prove they hold up under real conditions, and then keep them performing in production: watching how they behave, diagnosing why they drift, tuning and evaluating them, and safely rolling out changes as they evolve. Your day to day will look like a small senior delivery pod working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the client and with Slalom's platform team. It's a collaborative, high\-ownership environment: you are the final technical authority on how the agents behave, and the person a client trusts to tell them their systems are reliable, well\-governed, and getting better over time. Because our agentic reliability engineering group is a new and fast\-growing practice, you'll also help shape *how* the work is done. We expect you to provide input in to the patterns, tooling, and standards that make running production agents repeatable. This is a role for engineers who want to be at the frontier of what AI systems actually do in production. You thrive on work with real stakeholders, measured outcomes, and sustained impacts. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Design \& deploy agentic solutions*** * Partner with clients to shape the opportunity and design the agent workflow — what the agents should do, how their performance will be judged, and what guardrails keep them safe. * Build the first working agents: stand up the initial workflow, evaluation harness, and guardrails, and demonstrate that the solution meets the client's acceptance criteria under real conditions. * Define the reliability baseline the solution must hold in production including the SLOs, evaluation criteria, and autonomy posture that govern it. ***Run \& continuously improve production agents*** * Own root\-cause analysis and ongoing performance of the agent workflow itself: why it behaves as it does, and how to make it measurably better over time. * Own the evaluation harness: configure, run, and interpret agent evaluations against workflow\-specific acceptance criteria. * Monitor drift signals (e.g. output\-quality degradation, latency trends, evaluation pass\-rate decline, cost anomalies) and remediate before they breach SLOs. * Run A/B and shadow evaluations when agent behavior changes are proposed * Capture operational findings, incident lessons, and evaluation\-calibration notes so the pod's knowledge compounds over time rather than resetting. ***Measure, analyze \& communicate performance*** * Define and track the KPIs that describe how well the agents are performing and investigate when they move in unexpected directions. * Translate telemetry into narratives the team and client can act on. * Develop and communicate clear plans to improve agent performance and reporting on their impact once shipped. * Serve as the final technical authority for AI agent incidents including owning root\-cause analysis of the agent workflow, remediation, and postmortem documentation. * Determine whether an incident reflects a transient error, agent drift, workflow\-logic failure, or an underlying model\-behavior change. ***Safe change \& controlled rollout*** * Manage change control for agent workflow updates: version the change, run the evaluation suite, document the expected behavioral delta, and propose the go\-live schedule. * Stage rollouts with shadow\-deployment patterns before promoting to full release; monitoring the stability window and rolling back per runbook if thresholds are breached. * Manage identity, access, and integrations: app registrations and credentials, access control and permissions, and the authentication, authorization, and contracts that govern how agents communicate with other tools and systems. * Manage cost and infrastructure: right\-sizing the compute agents run on, setting token and budget caps per agent, optimizing workflow steps for efficient resource use, and reportin tion \& partnership** — you make the people around you better: giving and acting on candid feedback, sharing what you learn, and partnering effectively with Slalom teammates across capabilities, platform, and client teams to move the work forward together. **WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW** AI agents are moving from novelty to critical infrastructure, and the engineers who build the discipline of running them reliably will define the field for the next decade. Being able to say “I have run agents in production, at SLA, and debugged them”, is one of the most exciting and evolving skillsets engineering today. This role puts you at the center of it: real clients, real outcomes, and a platform team investing in the tooling that makes the work tractable, at a firm building this practice as a long\-term strategic bet. **About Us** Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co\-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. **Compensation and Benefits** Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, \& vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long\-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well\-being\-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for Principal level is: * Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles; $171,000\-$210,000 * Atlanta, Dallas, Philadelphia; $157,000\-$195,000 The targeted base salary range for Senior Principal level is: * Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles; $216,000\-$254,000 * Atlanta, Dallas, Philadelphia; $198,000\-$235,000 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. We will accept applicants until November 12th, or until the position is filled. We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. **EEO and Accommodations** *Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. jobs.description: Location Memphis, TN Category Information Technology Department Information Services Shift Weekday Day Position Type Full Time Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Req \# JR6925 **Job Description** ------------------- At St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, technology serves a higher purpose: advancing cures and saving lives. We are seeking a Software Developer II with experience in AI to support our Research IT ecosystem by building intelligent, reliable, and scalable AI solutions that directly enable scientific discovery in pediatric catastrophic diseases. In this role, you will design and implement software solutions, including AI and large language model (LLM)–powered systems, that help researchers make sense of complex data, accelerate insights, and improve how research tools are delivered and sustained. Your work will bridge cutting\-edge AI innovation and dependable production systems, ensuring that models are performant, cost\-effective, interpretable, and maintainable in a research healthcare environment. You will collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and research teams to build data pipelines, APIs, and microservices that bring AI models from experimentation into daily use—supporting everything from knowledge discovery to decision support. Beyond deployment, you will help steward these models over time through monitoring, drift detection, and continuous improvement, recognizing that reliability and trust are critical when supporting life\-changing research. This role is ideal for someone driven by impact—who wants to apply modern software engineering and AI techniques such as LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases in service of a mission larger than any single product. At St. Jude, your work contributes not only to technical excellence, but to a global commitment: ensuring families never receive a bill for treatment, travel, housing, or food—so they can focus on helping their child lives. **Job Responsibilities:** * Design and implement AI solutions (e.g., recommendation systems, NLP pipelines, LLM\-powered features). * Build and maintain data pipelines for training, evaluation, and inference. * Integrate AI models into production systems via APIs and microservices. * Work with large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and evaluation. * Optimize model performance, latency, and cost in production environments. * Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure clean architecture and maintainable code. * Monitor and improve deployed models (drift detection, retraining, logging). * Stay current with advancements in AI and assess their practical application. * Contribute to defined system scope and objectives for assigned projects combining knowledge and disciplines of all aspects (e.g. program stack, memory management, networking utilization). * Assist all levels of software developers in developing software to support object oriented software applications. * Actively support and participate in the software development lifecycle management process (e.g. software coding, testing, debugging, documenting, installation). * Assist in developing detailed specifications from which programs will be written for group level systems. * Work with customers, vendors, and/or departments on technical issues including software system design and maintenance. * Ensure the rigorous application of information security/information assurance policies, principles, and practices. * Remain current and actively contribute in the evaluation and adaption of new methods and technologies. * Perform other duties as assigned to meet the goals and objectives of the department and institution. * Maintains regular and predictable attendance. **Minimum Education and/or Training:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information science, business, or related field required. * Master's degree preferred. **Minimum Experience:** * Minimum experience: 2\+years of IT experience in systems programming and development preferably in comparable industry. * Familiarity with SDLC methodologies (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, CI/CD). * Some experience working with business stakeholders to identify and document Requirements. * Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open\-source models) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS). * Knowledge of RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) architectures and background in NLP, recommendation systems, or deep learning. **Compensation** In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. jobs.description: **Position Summary** The SRE Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise observability solutions that enhance application performance, system reliability, operational efficiency, and end\-user experience. efforts through industry best practices in observability, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). **Responsibilities** **SRE Engineer and Solution Design** * Design, implement, and integrate enterprise observability solutions to improve system reliability, availability, and performance. * Evaluate observability technologies through Proof of Concept (PoC) initiatives and demonstrate solution effectiveness to stakeholders. * Gather and analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable observability architectures and implementation plans. * Recommend teams. * Implement synthetic monitoring solutions for critical web applications, portals, and APIs to ensure service availability and continuity. * Develop log monitoring capabilities utilizing experience. * Build operational and business\-focused dashboards that correlate technical performance metrics with key business outcomes and KPIs. **Dynatrace and Platform Engineering** * Lead the solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and increase service reliability. * Drive automation of repetitive operational and support activities to reduce costs and improve service delivery. * Promote observability\-as\-code and infrastructure automation practices to enable consistent and repeatable deployments. * Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational effectiveness using automation, analytics, and modern engineering practices. **DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering** * Implement and promote DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices across supported platforms and applications. * Contribute to post\-incident reviews and postmortem activities to drive continuous service improvement. * Support capacity initiatives. **Success Measures** A successful SRE Engineer will: * Improve visibility into application, infrastructure, and user experience performance. * Reduce operational overhead through automation and observability\-as\-code practices. * Enable faster detection and resolution of performance and reliability issues. * Deliver scalable monitoring and alerting solutions aligned with business requirements. * Support successful platform modernization and observability transformation initiatives. * Strengthen adoption of DevOps, SRE, and continuous improvement practices across the
