jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18448 **Base Salary Range** $129000\-$193000 **Date posted** 10/11/2026 ### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years in the trenches of timing signoff, and you know the difference between a clean sign\-off and one that comes back to haunt you three weeks before tapeout. You understand that static timing analysis is not just about running PrimeTime, it is about understanding what the silicon will actually do when variation, IR drop, temperature, and aging all hit at once. You have debugged enough false paths and multi\-cycle exceptions to know when a constraint deck is solid and when it is held together with hope. You are equally comfortable sitting with an R\&D architect discussing distributed STA algorithms and walking a customer's design team through a HyperGrid deployment that just cut their runtime by 40%. When a strategic account hits a blocker two weeks before their signoff milestone, you are the person they call because you will find the path through, whether that means a creative workaround, a targeted fix, or a hard conversation about what is actually achievable. You do not just react to problems, you see them coming. You connect dots between what customers are struggling with today and what the product roadmap needs to solve tomorrow. At Synopsys, you will shape the future of timing signoff for the designs that power everything from data centers to mobile devices. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Drive production deployment of PrimeTime capabilities including HyperGrid distributed STA, native IR\-aware timing analysis, thermal\-aware signoff, aging analysis, and multi\-die timing closure at strategic semiconductor customers * Lead direct technical engagements with design teams at leading\-edge accounts, translating their advanced\-node challenges into concrete product requirements, deployment strategies, and success metrics * Partner with R\&D teams to evaluate new architectures like cloud\-native PrimeTime and AI\-assisted constraint generation, validating functionality, identifying performance bottlenecks, and driving resolution of complex product issues * Own beta programs and pre\-production evaluations from kickoff through production readiness, defining test plans, tracking results, and ensuring customer success criteria are met * Resolve critical customer escalations through structured root\-cause analysis, building effective workarounds when needed and driving long\-term fixes back into the product * Translate deployment experience, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into clear roadmap recommendations for Product Management and engineering leadership * Create technical content including deployment guides, best\-practice methodologies, executive briefings, and training materials that accelerate adoption across the field organization and customer base ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Enable customers to achieve timing signoff on designs that would otherwise miss their tapeout windows, directly affecting product launch schedules for chips powering AI, automotive, and mobile applications * Shape the PrimeTime roadmap by connecting real customer pain points with engineering priorities, ensuring development resources focus on capabilities that will drive the most adoption * Accelerate time\-to\-production for next\-generation capabilities like ML\-based corner optimization and automated SDC generation, turning research concepts into deployed solutions * Build reusable deployment methodologies that scale across the customer base, turning one successful engagement into a repeatable playbook * Strengthen Synopsys competitive position in timing signoff by ensuring customers see measurable value from advanced features before competitors can catch up * Mentor Application and Product Engineers across the organization, raising the technical bar and building institutional knowledge around complex signoff challenges * Influence the architecture of future PrimeTime releases by representing real\-world deployment constraints and customer workflows in early design discussions ### **What You'll Need** * BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline * Deep hands\-on experience with PrimeTime or comparable timing signoff tools across multiple production tapeouts, including multi\-corner multi\-mode analysis, variation modeling, and advanced\-node signoff challenges * Strong understanding of static timing analysis fundamentals including setup/hold analysis, clock domain crossing, false paths, multi\-cycle paths, and constraint methodology * Proficiency in Tcl and Python for automation, analysis, and debugging of complex timing scenarios * Track record of solving hard technical problems in EDA, ASIC/SoC design, or physical implementation environments where the answer was not obvious and the stakes were high * Experience with distributed computing, cloud infrastructure, or HyperGrid technologies is a strong plus * Background deploying new EDA technologies at semiconductor companies, including managing beta programs, customer training, or production readiness activities is highly valued ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a room where a customer's timing closure is stuck and within an hour identify whether the issue is in their constraints, their methodology, the tool, or their design, and you know how to have that conversation without pointing fingers * When R\&D proposes a new algorithm, you immediately think about how it will behave on a real customer design with 500 modes, 200 corners, and a constraint deck that has evolved over three years * You write Tcl and Python that other engineers can actually read and modify six months later, because you know that one\-off scripts become production infrastructure * You can explain a complex timing analysis tradeoff to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance, and you can turn around and debug a multi\-threaded race condition with an engineer the next hour * When you commit to a customer delivery date or an internal milestone, people know it will happen because you build in contingency and you escalate early when something is at risk * You push back when a product plan does not account for real deployment complexity, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward rather than shutting it down ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join the PrimeTime Product Engineering team, working at the intersection of R\&D, Product Management, and customer\-facing Application Engineering. This team drives the technical strategy and production readiness for Synopsys timing signoff solutions, which are used by every major semiconductor company to sign off chips ranging from mobile processors to data center accelerators. Your work will directly influence both the product roadmap and how customers deploy PrimeTime across their most critical design programs. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)** Location: New York City \| In\-office **The Mission** =============== *“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”* Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems. Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people. **The Opportunity: Build the Product End to End** ================================================= As our Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you’ll build the application layer around Taxo’s AI agents. You’ll work across interfaces, application services, and product data, turning complex healthcare workflows into software that people can use every day. You’ll independently own features from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and production operation, building on shared healthcare services and connectors owned by the platform and Healthcare Intelligence teams. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Ship End to End:** Independently design, build, and ship end\-to\-end features for healthcare teams, from clear interfaces to the services and data models behind them. * **Connect the Workflow:** Develop application APIs and product workflows that use shared healthcare services and connectors to support scheduling, intake, and other operational workflows. * **Practice Product Engineering:** Turn product requirements and customer feedback into practical technical designs and shipped software. * **Build for Reliability:** Improve performance, reliability, and observability across the application and its external dependencies. Build secure sensitive\-data handling, access controls, and auditability into the product. * **Set the Standard:** Write tests, strengthen CI/CD, and make releases easier to validate and operate. * **Shape the Architecture:** Collaborate with voice AI engineers and product colleagues, review code, and help the team make sound architectural decisions. **The Stack** ============= We move fast with a modern toolkit: * **Frontend:** React, Next.js * **Backend:** Node.js (TypeScript) * **Data \& Infrastructure:** PostgreSQL, AWS * **Intelligence:** LLMs and Voice AI integration **Who You Are** =============== * **The Builder:** A track record of independently owning production web applications across frontend and backend systems, from technical design through launch and ongoing operation. * **The Full Stack Engineer:** Strong TypeScript and JavaScript skills, with hands\-on experience in React or Next.js and Node.js. * **The Systems Thinker:** Practical knowledge of relational databases, API design, authentication, authorization, and external integrations, with experience handling sensitive data securely and building auditable systems. * **The Problem Solver:** The ability to investigate production issues and balance speed with maintainability and testing. * **The Product Partner:** Product\-minded judgment and a habit of following a feature through to its impact on users. * **The Owner:** Clear communication and comfort making progress when requirements are still evolving. * **Bonus:** Experience with LLM\-powered products, voice AI, EHR integrations, or building an early\-stage product into a reliable production system. **Why Taxo** ============ Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible. * **Practical AI Work:** Build the interfaces and systems that turn AI capabilities into useful healthcare products. * **Impact That Matters:** Make it easier for healthcare teams to complete the administrative work around patient care. * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Work across the stack and see your decisions reach users, from the first release onward. **Compensation** ================ Base salary: $170,000–$210,000 USD annually Equity: 0\.15%–0\.40% Benefits: Health coverage **How We Work** =============== Taxo is a small, fast, high\-conviction team. We care deeply about the problem, move with urgency, and take ownership of the work. We collaborate closely, make practical decisions, and keep improving through what we learn from customers. If you want to build a healthcare AI product from the interface down to the infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Corporate \& TechnologyProduct **Compensation** ---------------- * $150K – $190K Talkiatry is looking for a **Staff Product Designer** to shape the future of mental health care experiences across multiple strategic product areas. In this role, you'll divide your time across several high\-impact areas: designing AI\-powered experiences that support patients between sessions, improving core patient portal flows that help people access and manage their care, and serving as a craft leader who modernizes our design system and raises the visual quality bar across all Talkiatry products. As a Staff designer, your impact will extend beyond any single product area. You'll work closely with product, engineering, clinical, and AI partners across multiple teams, bringing both deep craft and strategic thinking to ambiguous problems. You'll help establish interaction patterns for emerging technologies while also refining foundational experiences that serve patients every day. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. **About the role:** As an Application Security Engineer, you will secure how Tempus builds software, from design through release. You will partner with product and engineering teams to build security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and you will assess our applications and APIs the way an attacker would, through security assessments and penetration tests. The applications you secure handle sensitive clinical and genomic data and increasingly include AI\-powered capabilities, so securing AI and LLM\-enabled systems is a core part of the role. You will own well\-defined application security problems within your team's scope, with guidance from your lead. **What you'll do** * Embed security into the SDLC through threat modeling, design reviews, security requirements, and security\-focused code reviews with product and development teams. * Plan and conduct application security assessments and penetration tests of web applications, APIs, and cloud\-hosted services, and document findings with clear risk ratings and practical remediation guidance. * Threat model and assess AI and LLM\-enabled features (agents, RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integrations), including adversarial prompt testing and validation of guardrails, permissions, and data access controls. * Select, integrate, and tune SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines. * Build automation, secure\-by\-default patterns, and guardrails that prevent whole classes of vulnerabilities. * Use AI\-assisted tooling to scale code review, triage, and remediation, applying human judgment to validate the results. * Reproduce, triage, and prioritize application security vulnerabilities, and work with developers through to remediation. * Communicate the nature, severity, and business risk of security issues to development teams and leadership. * Design, implement, and document application security controls, standards, and secure coding guidance. * Run and support the vulnerability disclosure program. * Coach developers on secure design and coding through consulting, training, and everyday collaboration. **What you'll bring** * 3\-5 years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or software engineering with a security focus. * Hands\-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and cloud\-hosted services, using proxying and penetration testing tools (e.g. Burp Suite), and strong command of common security flaws and mitigations (e.g. OWASP Top 10\). * Experience performing security design reviews at the architecture level * Working experience securing AI and LLM\-enabled applications: how they are designed and how they fail, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure output handling (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications). * Practical experience with at least one threat modeling method (e.g. STRIDE, PASTA, attack trees). * Experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines. * Proficiency in Python, Go, or JavaScript for security tooling and automation, and the ability to read and review code. * Solid understanding of network and web protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S), authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth/OIDC), and cryptography fundamentals. * Able to work well with software development teams and Product Managers. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely. **Bonus points for:** * Hands\-on AI red teaming or security testing of agentic or RAG systems; familiarity with MITRE ATLAS or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GCP or AWS, and infrastructure\-as\-code scanning * Bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program experience * Experience with HIPAA and healthcare data protection * An interest in working in biotech, genomics, and precision medicine * Certifications such as GWAPT, OSCP, CSSLP, CISSP, or ISC2 CC (Certified in Cybersecurity) CHI: $85,000\-$130,000 The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world. Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, NLP
jobs.description: **Our company** At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. **What You’ll Do** We are building the next generation of AI\-powered knowledge, reasoning, and autonomous agent platforms that operate at enterprise scale. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal NLP Engineer** to own and lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced natural language technologies powering semantic and context graphs, context analysis, intelligent search, retrieval, question answering, knowledge extraction, reasoning systems, AI agents, and enterprise copilots for Teradata Context Engine, our Autonomous Knowledge Platform. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent\-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non\-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master. This is a deeply hands\-on technical leadership role for a recognized expert in Natural Language Processing who combines strong research foundations with proven experience shipping production systems that serve millions of users and process billions of documents. You will work at the intersection of large language models, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, semantic understanding, and agentic AI. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving breakthrough NLP capabilities from research to production and possesses deep expertise across classical NLP, modern transformer architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal understanding, information extraction, and large\-scale language model systems. Technical Leadership * Define and execute the strategic roadmap for NLP and language understanding capabilities across our Knowledge Platform. * Serve as the technical authority for large\-scale NLP architecture, algorithms, and production deployment. * Drive innovation in enterprise language understanding, semantic search, retrieval systems, knowledge extraction, and AI reasoning. NLP and Language Intelligence * Design and build advanced NLP systems for: * + Entity extraction + Relationship extraction + Information extraction + Document understanding + Semantic indexing + Context understanding and representation + Text classification + Topic modeling + Summarization + Question answering + Conversational AI + Knowledge grounding + Multi\-document reasoning + Extracting context from multi\-modal sources of language + Multi\-lingual solutions + Machine translation * Develop systems that transform unstructured enterprise content into structured knowledge assets. * Advance techniques for long\-context understanding, document intelligence, and multi\-hop reasoning. * Build domain\-adaptive language understanding models across diverse enterprise data sources. * Develop solutions with highest quality and performance * Develop solutions that are tested and validated Large Language Models * Design and optimize applications built on frontier foundation models. * Build advanced retrieval\-augmented generation architectures for enterprise\-scale environments. * Develop agentic workflows that leverage LLMs for planning, reasoning, execution, and tool usage. * Create evaluation methodologies that measure factuality, grounding, trustworthiness, and task completion. * Improve model performance through prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, continued pretraining, synthetic data generation, and reinforcement\-learning\-based approaches. Knowledge and Semantic Systems * Design NLP pipelines that power enterprise knowledge graphs and semantic layers. * Develop ontology\-aware language understanding systems. * Build entity resolution, canonicalization, taxonomy mapping, and concept extraction capabilities. * Connect language understanding with graph\-based reasoning and enterprise knowledge discovery platforms. Platform and Scale * Build highly scalable distributed NLP systems processing petabytes of enterprise content. * Optimize inference architectures for latency, throughput, cost efficiency, and reliability. * Lead deployment strategies across on\-prem, cloud\-native, hybrid, and enterprise environments. * Partner closely with platform engineering teams to operationalize NLP services at global scale. Research and Innovation * Stay at the forefront of advances in: * + Foundation models + Agentic AI + Retrieval systems + r enterprise copilots, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agents. * Expertise in enterprise search and knowledge management systems. * Experience with graph\-based reasoning and knowledge graph technologies. * Patent portfolio in NLP, machine learning, search, or language understanding. **What You’ll Bring** * Established reputation as an industry expert in NLP and language AI. * Proven record of taking breakthrough research into production at scale. * Experience building state\-of\-the\-art systems involving: * + Enterprise search + Enterprise copilots + Document intelligence + Retrieval systems + Knowledge extraction + AI agents + Semantic reasoning + Knowledge graphs * Ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations. * Strong balance of scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and product impact. Success Metrics Within 12 months, you will: * Define next\-generation NLP and language intelligence architecture for the platform. * Deliver measurable improvements in retrieval quality, answer accuracy, grounding, and user satisfaction. * Establish world\-class evaluation and benchmarking frameworks. * Lead development of enterprise\-scale knowledge extraction and semantic understanding capabilities. * Enable agentic AI experiences that leverage enterprise knowledge with high trust, transparency, and precision. * Raise the organization's NLP and AI capabilities to industry\-leading levels. **Why We Think You'll Love Teradata** We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are \#LI\-CP2 US Pay Rate: $182,700\.00 \- $228,400\.00 \- $274,000\.00 Annually Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on geographic location, internal equity, job\-related knowledge, skills, and candidate experience. Sales roles will be eligible for commission payments tied to quota achievement. All other permanent roles will be eligible for one of our annual incentive plans, which are based on company financial attainment and individual performance. Employees in this position are eligible to participate in the Company’s benefits programs, which generally include health care, life and disability insurance, retirement savings, and time\-off programs. Benefit details vary by country and plan, including eligibility and available options, and will be shared during the hiring process. Additional information is available here: https://www.teradata.com/About\-Us/Careers/Benefits Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability insurance plans, a 401(k)\-retirement savings plan, and time\-off programs. Specific details of these benefits, including eligibility criteria and plan options, will be provided during the hiring process and can be reviewed here: https://www.teradata.com/About\-Us/Careers/Benefits Teradata is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We welcome and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team, bringing their unique perspectives and experiences to help us innovate and grow. If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Columbus, OH Category: Data \& Analytics Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid or Remote Job Ref: R2627133\-174 Sr Data Engineer \- GE07BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. This position is in a small group that works directly with our customers and prides itself in delivery capabilities. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, results\-oriented individual with strong technical skills and project\-level leadership experience. We are looking for a well\-rounded individual that is comfortable working in a process light environment and willing to cross the traditional role boundaries of developer, BA, Architect and project lead. To be successful in this role you must be comfortable working directly with customers in an iterative fashion to achieve the desired result. As such, strong verbal communication and the ability to create your own technical specifications and designs based on customer needs is critical for success in this role. This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our locations will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office should maintain their current work arrangement with the expectation of coming into the office as business needs arise **Responsibilities**: * Regularly engage in continuing education and serve as a technical expert in Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, AI and Generative AI platforms, cloud\-native data services, CICD tooling, environment management, Oracle, metadata\-driven architectures, and enterprise data quality processes. * Evaluate, prototype, and operationalize emerging AI technologies, including Generative AI, Agentic AI workflows, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-based integrations. * Design and develop high quality, scalable data solutions to enable pricing and reserving activities for Employer Benefit Actuarial team. * Ability to synthesize, reconcile, and explain data differences between GB actuarial output against other standard published data. * Gain deep understanding on various Actuarial applications, data elements and business process. * Work closely with Actuarial customers during the close of current financial months to provide solutions to time sensitive issues while ensuring strategic solutions are planned for next release cycle. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers while fostering collaboration across onshore and offshore teams to deliver innovative, scalable, and sustainable data solutions. Leverage strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to discover, integrate, and optimize data from diverse sources, enabling informed decision\-making and supporting mission\-critical business processes. * Ability to discover, analyze and integrate data from various sources to support decision making and enable critical business processes * Consult with cross\-functional team partners to understand business needs and develop reliable and effective solutions that are easily maintainable. * Ability to work directly with the customers to understand their needs and provide solutions. * Willingness to develop deep functional knowledge in the pricing and rating process. * Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to support Insurance processing, actuarial analysis, and reporting. * Use Enterprise GitHub for version control, documentation, code collaboration, and technical project management. * Research, evaluate, and champion modern data technologies, frameworks, and best practices to drive operational excellence and accelerate data\-driven innovation. Build deep functional knowledge of pricing, rating, and actuarial processes while working within agile delivery frameworks and partnering across organizations to enhance enterprise data assets and capabilities. **Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of applicable work experience. * Experience in following is required: Snowflake, IDMC, Informatica, Oracle * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools, Snowflake Cortex and Agentic AI capabilities, Generative AI platforms, Model Context Protocol (MCP), cloud\-based AI services, and intelligent automation frameworks. * Experience building AI\-powered self\-service analytics, intelligent data catalogs, automated reconciliation frameworks, or knowledge management solutions. * Demonstrated passion for continuous learning in Artificial Intelligence, cloud architecture, automation, and emerging technologies. * Experience with CICD, GitHub, Autosys, and SQL * 7\+ years ETL / Data analysis / Warehouse Technologies experience * Strong data warehouse knowledge preferably in the insurance domain, Demonstrated expertise in Data analysis, Data Quality and reconciliation processes. * Group Benefits business knowledge is a plus. * Knowledge of AWS and cloud\-based data solutions is a plus * Strong experience in Python , R and other modern languages, including experience building APIs, automation frameworks, AI\-driven applications, and cloud\-native data services. * Experience in on\-premises to cloud migration of data pipelines, modernizing them to leverage full cloud potential. * Experienced in Agile and Kanban Methodologies **Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.** **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $117,200 \- $175,800 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Reports To:** Director of Technology **Work Location:** This is an in\-office role (Eden Prairie, MN) four days per week. **Position Summary:** The Product Quality Engineer plays a key role in ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of physics\-based machining simulation software used in complex engineering and manufacturing applications. This position combines hands\-on software testing, engineering analysis, defect investigation, and test automation to influence product quality throughout the software development lifecycle. Working closely with Product Owners, software developers, and DevOps engineers, this role contributes to feature scoping, verification strategy, test automation, and test\-platform development. The Product Quality Engineer helps establish and promote consistent testing standards, tools, and practices across the development team while remaining actively involved in hands\-on verification work. The successful candidate will independently manage most assignments, influence team quality practices, and provide technical guidance in established areas of expertise. **Requirements** **Major Job Accountabilities:** * Work as part of a cross\-functional software development team to create, maintain, and execute test scenarios for new features, enhancements, defect corrections, and regression testing * Verify physics\-based machining simulation software through structured testing and engineering analysis * Establish, document, and champion consistent testing standards, procedures, and best practices across the product quality and software development teams, drawing from industry practices and lessons learned * Translate product requirements into testable criteria and identify the inputs, environments, and acceptance criteria required for effective verification * Define and recommend technical approaches for verifying software features and defect corrections * Develop test coverage with an understanding of customer workflows, edge cases, failure conditions, use cases, and realistic parameter ranges * Analyze simulation outputs to determine whether software behavior is accurate, consistent, and aligned with product requirements * Work with Product Owners and engineering stakeholders to evaluate bug reports for completeness, reproducibility, technical impact, and customer relevance * Reproduce reported issues and document clear steps, test conditions, expected behavior, actual behavior, and supporting evidence * Verify defect corrections and determine the appropriate level of regression testing * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, error\-prone, or high\-value testing activities * Develop and maintain automated tests, scripts, test batteries, and supporting utilities with a focus on continuous improvement * Collaborate with DevOps engineers and software developers on test infrastructure, test environments, automated workflows, and test\-platform design * Maintain test documentation, reusable test data, scripts, and other verification assets * Participate in product development activities, including feature scoping, requirements review, technical planning, and release validation * Identify recurring quality risks and recommend improvements to testing, development, and release processes * Clearly communicate test results, technical findings, product risks, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field * 3\+ years experience in software testing, software quality, engineering verification, or a related discipline * Experience creating or executing structured test plans and documenting results * Programming or scripting experience using a language such as Python, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript, C\#, or an equivalent language * Experience with an automated UI testing framework such as Squish, Qt Test, Selenium, or an equivalent tool * Experience investigating technical issues and documenting clear reproduction steps * Ability to independently manage assigned work with limited direct supervision ***Preferred:*** * Experience testing engineering, scientific, numerical, or physics\-based simulation software * Familiarity with CAD/CAM software and engineering workflows * Knowledge of CNC machining, manufacturing processes, or cutting tools * Experience developing automated tests or test frameworks * Experience with source control, issue\-tracking systems, automated test pipelines, or software release processes * Familiarity with Agile or Scrum software development practices * Experience with quality methods such as root\-cause analysis, the 5 Whys, or design of experiments **Benefits** The salary range is $85,000\-$105,000\. Third Wave Systems offers a comprehensive employee benefits program for full\-time employees. * Health Insurance * Dental Insurance * HSA * 401 (k) \+ Employer Match * Paid time off * Holiday pay

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- As a **Legal AI Engineer** focused on helping law firms adopt generative AI, you will partner directly with customers to uncover their highest\-value legal workflows and show how Thomson Reuters Legal AI can address them. You’ll lead in\-person discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings, and you’ll turn what you learn into reusable use cases, prompts, and playbooks that scale across practice areas. This is a high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of customer strategy, hands\-on AI experimentation, and thought leadership. As the go\-to voice for legal AI in customer conversations, you’ll bring clarity and practical solutions to every engagement, helping firms decide when a Thomson Reuters product, a partner tool, or a custom approach is the right fit. **Key Responsibilities:** In the role of **Legal AI Engineer** , you will collaborate closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Product teams to: * Lead in\-person discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, workflow workshops, and executive briefings with law firm customers to identify priority legal workflows and show how Thomson Reuters Legal AI can address them. * Support customers throughout the lifecycle by scoping Legal AI use cases, advising on workflow and solution design, and demonstrating legal AI capabilities. * Partner with Customer Success Managers to develop Legal AI adoption strategies, support successful solution deployment, and move high\-value use cases into sustained use across practice areas. * Discover, test, and document best practices for applying Thomson Reuters Legal AI across customer workflows, creating reusable use cases, prompts, playbooks, and workflow patterns that can scale. * Apply a strong understanding of the legal technology ecosystem to determine when customer needs are best addressed through Thomson Reuters products, a partner solution, an integration, or custom development, and help orchestrate the right approach. * Support customer advocacy by communicating customer needs to Customer Success and our cross\-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and Marketing, and highlighting opportunities to improve and innovate our legal AI products. * Contribute to Thomson Reuters’ thought leadership by sharing expertise with customers and the broader market through events, advisory boards, or customer\-facing content. * Be an effective advocate for Thomson Reuters products. Understand their strengths, areas for improvement, and roadmaps, and be able to explain, on multiple levels, how they can be specifically applied to take customers’ client advocacy to new heights. * **Travel:** This role requires regular travel (approximately 25\-30%, varying by quarter) to customer and firm sites to support client engagements, demonstrations, and team initiatives. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as a condition of employment. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- You are a fit for the role of **Legal AI Engineer** if you have the following required qualifications: * J.D. from an accredited US law school required. * Prior experience practicing law required (e.g., in a law firm, in\-house legal department, government, clerkship, or comparable legal practice setting). * Proven experience in customer\- or client\-facing roles, ideally engaging with Enterprise or complex accounts. * Familiarity with legal workflows and processes such as due diligence, eDiscovery, large document review, compliance, or related domains — gained through direct practice, adjacent roles, or working with legal professionals. * Demonstrable experience with generative artificial intelligence applications. * Substantial experience using a variety of online legal research and practice tools (e.g., Westlaw, Practical Law, HighQ, Relativity, Everlaw, etc.). * Tech\-savvy with a strong aptitude for learning new AI tools and platforms; no formal technical or programming background is required. Experience with basic programming (Python) and/or exploratory coding for problem\-solving is a plus but not required. * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Bring experience in customer\-facing roles, ideally working with Enterprise accounts. * Understand the architecture and operation of large language models (LLMs) and are comfortable working hands\-on with AI tools, even without a formal technical or engineering background. * Approach challenges constructively, framing Thomson Reuters solutions positively and accurately. * Are knowledgeable in due diligence, eDiscovery, managing large document sets, data rooms, and related workflows where AI can accelerate results. * Excel at communicating technical concepts and creating clear, high\-quality documentation and learning materials, and can craft persuasive presentations that resonate with non\-technical and often skeptical customers by focusing on their needs and outcomes rather than just product features. * T catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $74,200 USD \- $137,800 USD.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; This job posting will close 12/31/2026\. **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. jobs.title: Business Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About** **Tia** ----------------- Tia is building a new model for women's healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in\-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike. **About the Role** ------------------ At Tia, our business teams support the people, processes, and systems that make women's healthcare possible. From credentialing providers to supporting clinic operations, too much of their time goes toward repetitive tasks, moving information between systems, tracking paperwork, and rebuilding reports. As our Business Automation Engineer, you'll help teams spend more time on the work that needs their expertise. You'll partner with People Operations, Credentialing, Clinical Operations, Data, Product, Business Analytics, and other teams to understand their workflows and build practical solutions using automation, AI, and code. You'll work with your manager to define problems and priorities, then own projects from discovery through launch and ongoing maintenance. Product partners will support architecture and data decisions. As your portfolio grows, you'll keep workflows reliable and adapt them as Tia's needs change. This role offers the opportunity to apply emerging technology to real business problems and make a measurable difference in how Tia operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Understand and improve business processes** * Work directly with teams to understand how work gets done, including exceptions, workarounds, and handoffs. * Map workflows and identify where human judgment is essential and where automation can reduce repetitive work. * Partner with your manager to define project scope, priorities, and measures of success. **Build practical, reliable solutions** * Design and build workflows using n8n or similar automation platforms, AI tools, and Python or JavaScript/Node.js. * Connect systems through APIs, webhooks, and other integrations. * Choose the simplest effective solution, whether that is a spreadsheet improvement, standard automation, or an AI\-assisted workflow. * Test normal operations and edge cases, and build in error handling, logging, alerts, and appropriate human review. **Own workflows after launch** * Monitor performance, troubleshoot failures, and update workflows as systems, policies, and business needs change. * Follow Tia's security, access, and AI governance controls when working with sensitive employee, business, or patient\-related information. * Maintain clear documentation so others can understand, review, and support your work. **Help teams adopt and sustain improvements** * Involve teams throughout discovery, design, and rollout. * Explain technical decisions in plain language and train teams to use their workflows. * Enable teams to make appropriate adjustments independently, with clear guidance on when technical support is needed. **Measure impact and share learning** * Establish baselines and measure time saved, accuracy, reliability, and adoption after launch. * Report results honestly, including limitations and approaches that did not work. * Partner with Product to transition solutions that could become part of Tia's products. * Evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and recommend where they can improve business operations. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** We value the quality of what you've built and how you approach problems. Candidates who demonstrate these capabilities through research or independent projects are encouraged to apply, even without traditional professional experience. * 1\+ year of relevant experience in workflow automation, software development, systems integration, or technical operations, or equivalent hands\-on experience through internships, research, or substantial independent projects. * Experience leading a substantial project from an unclear starting point to a working solution. * Hands\-on experience building and troubleshooting workflows in n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato, or a comparable platform, with the ability to learn n8n quickly. * Ability to write Python or JavaScript/Node.js scripts, call APIs, and handle logic beyond the capabilities of low\-code tools. * Working knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and data movement between systems. * Comfort using SQL to query and validate data, and working with complex Google Sheets. * Experience applying LLM tools or APIs to practical problems, with an understanding of their limitations, how to evaluate outputs, and when human review is needed. * Ability to break complex processes into manageable steps and anticipate exceptions and downstream effects. * A disciplined approach to testing, documentation, monitoring, and handling sensitive data. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to earn trust with nontechnical teams. * Initiative, persistence, and accountability: you make progress through ambiguity, raise blockers early, and learn from mistakes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Google Workspace automation, including Apps Script. * Experience building AI workflows that use tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agents. * Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and how to assess whether a model is appropriate for a task. * Experience handling sensitive data in healthcare, finance, or another regulated environment. * Experience measuring operational improvements through time studies or before\-and\-after comparisons. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- Success in this role means: * Delivering agreed\-upon projects and communicating progress and blockers clearly. * Building workflows that teams adopt and that remain reliable after launch. * Demonstrating measurable improvements in time spent, accuracy, or process quality. * Providing documentation and training that help teams use and sustain improvements. * Identifying opportunities to simplify work while protecting the human judgment and expertise essential to Tia's operations. **Work Location** ----------------- This is a remote role, based in the United States. \#LI\-Remote **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job\-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions. The expected annual compensation for this role is: **$90,000 \- $100,000**. You are also eligible for: * Medical, dental, and vision benefits * 401k * Parental leave * Performance\-based bonus * Equity * Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays #### **About Tia** Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our "Whole Woman, Whole Life" model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in\-person care and a national virtual platform. We are a Series D, venture\-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology\-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women. #### **About Tia's Culture** Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women. This position may require attendance at company and team off\-sites. #### **Scam Notice** Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact peopleservices@asktia.com. #### **Equal Opportunity** Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ\+ community to apply. If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high\-quality work, and making waves in women's healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Titan** Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7\. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market\-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K\+ tickets across 400\+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. ### **About the team** Titan's Forward Deployed Engineering team works with our partners and customers to put AI agents into production across their operations. We sit at the intersection of partner delivery and core platform engineering. ### **About the role** Forward Deployed Engineers lead Titan deployments end to end with our MSP and enterprise partners. You own discovery, scoping, the build, and the production rollout, working directly with partner IT teams. You'll architect integrations, write production code, and deploy agents at scale, then sit with customer and partner leadership to shape business outcomes and strategy. You own and measure success by adoption in production, measurable impact on customer and partners' operations, and field feedback that evolves our platform and agents. You work closely with other engineers, Operations, Product, and GTM. This role is based in San Francisco or New York City, in office. ### **In this role you will** * Own technical delivery across partner and customer deployments, from first integration to stable production * Define the problems needing solving in each deployment and scope what to build to solve them * Build performant and reliable agents, integrations, and systems each deployment needs * Embed with portfolio teams and customers, understand how they work, and drive adoption of the tools you build * Architect and build the high\-quality software systems that power Titan's core platform * Turn what works in one deployment into tools, playbooks, and building blocks the next one can reuse ### **You might thrive in this role if you** * Bring 3\+ years of experience in engineering or technical deployment, including customer\-facing work * Have owned and shipped complex systems in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments * Take extreme ownership of problems and delivery * Write and review production\-grade code in TypeScript, Python, or a comparable stack * Have built or shipped LLM\-powered systems and know how model behavior shapes the product experience * Communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and partner stakeholders * Bonus: experience in IT operations, MSPs, or infosec Compensation Range: $180K \- $480K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build the AI agents themselves—the harnesses, evals, orchestration, and model strategy the rest of Traba's product runs on.** We're seeking an entrepreneurial Senior AI Agent Engineer to join as a founding member of the Agents team and build the next layer of Traba's product—an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0\-to\-1 ideas to scaled deployments. **About You** ------------- * **Builder with an AI operator's instinct.** You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing. * **Domain\-immersed.** You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build. * **High\-agency in ambiguity.** Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half\-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec. * **Sweat both ends of the stack.** You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer\-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug. **You Will** ------------ * Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate. * Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub\-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and initiatives across multiple product platforms. * Focus on reducing quality\-related costs and improving overall product quality. * Develop and implement quality\-driven test systems and procedures to ensure products meet customer expectations. • **Customer Interaction and Support:** * Conduct site visits and gather information to address and resolve customer issues. * Perform customer research and investigations to identify root causes and calculate benefits of quality improvements. * Act as a liaison for key selling situations requiring information about the quality management system and processes. • **Data Analysis and Prioritization:** * Provide data and prioritize improvement opportunities for Product Growth Teams (PGTs). * Develop and present business cases for improvements, and track improvement timelines. * Utilize various tools to evaluate the effectiveness of the Field Quality function, including Gemba, management reviews, internal audits, and customer feedback. • **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** * Facilitate and complete Root Cause Analysis across multiple functions to ensure corrections improve component reliability and product performance. * Develop communication strategies with field service technicians to identify and resolve real issues through manufacturing and engineering changes. * Collaborate with suppliers to facilitate reliability improvements and integrate them into new product and project introduction phases. • **Project and Metrics Management:** * Create and manage a prioritized project pipeline to maximize customer and business benefits. * Track and ensure teams deliver agreed quality improvements. * Forecast and manage key metrics to align with plant financials and PGT Glide paths. • **Training and Communication:** Technical lead roles, project leadership, matrixed or dotted\-line supervision, and mentoring do not satisfy the people\-management portion of this requirement. * Expert knowledge of both equipment and software technology * Ability to supervise and manage people * Good written and oral communications skills * Ability to interact and manage vendors

jobs.title: Product Analyst, AI Solutions
jobs.description: Product Analyst, AI Solutions The Product Analyst, AI Solutions is responsible for shaping, optimizing, and maintaining advanced AI\-driven features and user experiences within our product suite. This role sits at the intersection of business analysis, AI tuning, and user experience—combining expertise in software requirements gathering, prompt engineering, and AI model evaluation. The Analyst is heavily focused on refining how AI systems behave in real\-world scenarios, ensuring outputs are accurate, trustworthy, and closely aligned with client needs. You partner with AI Engineers, Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, QA, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to extract user requirements, translate those into actionable User Stories and evaluation metrics, and continuously tune AI systems for best\-in\-class performance and usability. This role is pivotal in ensuring our AI solutions provide maximum business value, aligning advanced technology with end\-user needs while driving continuous improvement and reliability. The Analyst produces high\-quality deliverables using systematic processes, with impact across multiple projects, deadlines, and teams. Principal Duties AI Tuning \& Output Quality * Design, evaluate, and refine prompts, templates, and conversation flows for reliability, cost effectiveness, and user alignment. * Maintain prompt libraries, track changes, and manage versioning. * Systematically test AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, compliance, and tone, applying rerankers, guardrails, and validation layers to ensure business rules are met. * Collaborate with engineering and QA to promptly integrate feedback and resolve model drift or new scenarios. Requirements Gathering \& Documentation * Proactively gather requirements of moderate scope and complexity from diverse sources (clients, market analysis, SMEs) to drive product development and AI enhancements. * Document software and system requirements, including user stories, program functions, test cases, and steps required for new features or modifications. * Ensure all documentation supports future maintainability and growth of AI\-enabled features. Evaluation, Metrics, \& Continuous Improvement * Establish systematic evaluation frameworks for AI model outputs, leveraging quantitative and qualitative benchmarks. * Run experiments, A/B tests, and structured evaluations to compare tuning strategies and track performance metrics (accuracy, coverage, hallucination rates, latency). * Translate business and user feedback into actionable improvements, owning continuous iteration for released solutions. Collaboration \& UX Alignment * Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring clear, effective communication and alignment. * Work closely with product, development, and UX/UI teams to ensure AI\-driven features fit seamlessly into business workflows, are intuitive and user\-friendly, and meet client needs. * Help shape the overall user experience for AI interactions, promoting explainability and transparency. Education, Experience and Special Skills * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Science, Business, or related field OR equivalent work experience. * 1\+ years’ experience in software, AI/ML, or related product analysis roles. * Experience with AI/ML applications (LLMs, NLP, machine learning pipelines). * Strong understanding of prompt engineering and generative AI interaction design. * Basic knowledge of data modeling, relational database concepts, and SQL. * Familiarity with model evaluation techniques and performance metrics. * Proficiency with Python or JavaScript for prototyping and evaluation. * Experience with Agile SCRUM development processes. * Excellent planning, organization, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functional groups. * Experience in ERP systems, enterprise software, or complex business domains. * Familiarity with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation), embeddings, MLOps, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with fine\-tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), running structured evaluation series, or human\-in\-the\-loop systems.

jobs.description: **Position overview Position title:** Assistant Professor Salary range: The current salary range for this position is $111,400–$163,200 (9\-month academic year salary), however, off\-scale salary and other components of pay, which would yield compensation that is higher than this range, are offered to meet competitive conditions. Position description **Position Description:** The University of California, Berkeley invites applications for an approved faculty position at the non\-tenured (tenure\-track) Assistant Professor level in the area of AI for Materials. This appointment will start as a 100% Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) appointment, with the appointee joining the Bakar Institute for Digital Materials for the Planet (BIDMaP) in the College of Computing, Data Science, and Society (CDSS) as a member, with access to its collaborative resources and postdoctoral program. It is the intention to move to the position to a 50/50 split appointment between MSE and a future interdisciplinary data science unit if/when established in CDSS, with MSE as the home department. **About the Units:** The MSE department is part of the College of Engineering (COE) and maintains close ties with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL). It advances the understanding and design of materials through an interdisciplinary blend of chemistry, physics, and engineering, pairing rigorous fundamentals with modern, application\-driven approaches. Our key strength is our collaborative, cross\-disciplinary research community, with abundant opportunities for students and collaborators across campus and beyond. BIDMaP is an institute in CDSS, a new college at Berkeley, with the goal of advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in the core of computing, data science, and statistics, while making sustained progress on issues of human and societal significance. BIDMaP advances the synthesis, design, and translation of innovative materials aimed at mitigating critical global challenges. Through the integration of pioneering chemistry with machine learning, artificial intelligence, and robotic automation, BIDMaP transforms materials innovation into targeted solutions for clean air, clean water, advanced batteries, and sustainable chemical production. **About the Position:** We seek outstanding candidates demonstrating the potential to build a world\-class research program that uses and advances AI to enable transformational progress in materials science and engineering. Research may span the development of new AI methods motivated by materials challenges, co\-development of emergent AI with materials theory and experimentation, and the deployment of AI to accelerate materials research, discovery and innovation. Application areas are intentionally broad, encompassing the full breadth of materials science—from soft to hard matter and inorganic to organic systems—and all stages of the materials lifecycle, including synthesis, processing, modeling, theory, characterization, fabrication, integration, deployment, and reuse. Candidates are encouraged to pursue interdisciplinary and non\-traditional approaches, including autonomous experimentation and data generation, scientific foundation models, language\-based methods, multimodal learning, robotics and automation, AI/ML methods for characterization, and techno\-economic or lifecycle analysis. The successful candidate will help position Berkeley at the global forefront of both AI and materials innovation while contributing actively to the intellectual communities of MSE and BIDMaP.
