jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc (UTFI) invites applications and nominations to fill the position of **Data Engineer.** Reporting to the Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics, the Data Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, monitoring, and optimizing enterprise ETL/data pipeline and data transformation solutions across cloud and on\-premise environments. This position focuses on ensuring reliable and timely movement of data between platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, SFTP environments, and enterprise data warehouse solutions to support operational reporting, analytics, dashboards, and business processes. This role will collaborate closely with BI analysts, CRM administrators, Data Platform teams, and Data Science initiatives to support evolving business requirements, semantic\-layer development, reporting transformations, and analytics\-ready datasets. Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to: **ETL \& Data Pipeline Support:** Implements, monitors, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise ETL and data pipelines connecting Salesforce, cloud platforms, SFTP environments, Tableau, and enterprise data warehouse solutions. Reruns failed ETL jobs, reporting tables, and scheduled integration processes to keep reporting and operational data available on time. Supports daily data processing and time\-sensitive reporting requirements. Monitors pipeline execution and tunes existing integrations to catch issues early and improve reliability before they affect downstream analytics. **Data Engineering, Transformation \& Semantic Layer Support:** Develops and maintains reporting views, transformation logic, curated datasets, and semantic\-layer objects that power business intelligence and analytics initiatives. Translates business and reporting requirements into reporting\-ready datasets and reusable transformation processes. Creates and updates data warehouse objects, including tables, views, and stored procedures, while onboarding new Salesforce fields and data sources into enterprise reporting environments. Standardizes business logic, KPI calculations, and reporting definitions, and optimizes query and semantic\-layer performance across analytics platforms. **Analytics \& Reporting Support:** Collaborates with BI analysts, CRM administrators, and Data Platform teams to meet reporting, dashboarding, and operational data needs. Prepares and curates datasets that support Data Science, predictive modeling, and AI initiatives. Participates in discussions on business requirements, reporting structures, and analytics solutions. Communicates technical issues, integration impacts, and implementation updates clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and provides troubleshooting support for reporting and data integration issues. **Documentation \& Continuous Improvement:** Maintains technical documentation for ETL pipelines, workflows, transformation logic, semantic\-layer objects, configurations, and support procedures. Follows established standards and best practices for data governance, security, and change management. Researches emerging cloud, ETL, semantic modeling, and data engineering technologies to improve operational efficiency and reporting capabilities. Participates in training and professional development in data engineering, cloud data platforms, and analytics engineering practices. **Required Education and Experience** The candidate who fills the Data Engineer position is required to have:* Bachelor’s degree * 5\+ years of progressively responsible experience in business intelligence, enterprise data engineering, CRM technologies, analytics, business systems, or related technical disciplines. * Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data architecture. * Experience developing enterprise ETL/ELT initiatives. * Experience supporting enterprise CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce. * Experience developing enterprise reporting and analytics solutions. * Experience managing cloud\-based data environments, preferably Fabric and/or Azure A valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record is required due to travel responsibilities of the position. UTFI reserves the right to consider all appropriate circumstances. In general, any significant driving offense less than 12 months old will eliminate the application from consideration for the position. Note \- Candidates holding a graduate degree must have at least 3 years of experience.**Preferred Education and Experience** In addition to meeting the required qualifications, the preferred candidate will have:* Master's degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field . * Experience with enterprise UT systems, including DASH, Marketing Cloud, and Salesforce * Experience leading enterprise cloud modernization initiatives. * Experience with fundraising CRMs. **Application Process:** Priority will be given to applications received on or before October 26th vi a our DASH application system. Applications must include a completed candidate profile, cover letter, resume, and contact information for three professional references. References will not be contacted without explicit permission of the candidate. When determining minimum qualifications, only information entered into the candidate profile can be considered. Please ensure your candidate profile is completed in its entirety as it relates to qualifying education/work experience. Questions about the search may be directed to hr@utfi.org . **Target Start Date:** December 2026 **Benefits:** The Foundation’s greatest asset is our team. Foundation employees are eligible for a comprehensive suite of benefits that includes:* Generous paid leave , accruing up to 24 days of vacation and 12 days of sick leave annually, plus 14 paid holidays and administrative closing days * Flexible work arrangements, offering a hybrid schedule to most team members * Education benefits for employees and their dependents at UT System campuses * Retirement and deferred compensation plans, including 401(k), 403(b), etc. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * Employee discounts to attractions, services, and goods \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **The Foundation:** The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc. is a not\-for\-profit 501(c)3 organization that serves as the preferred channel for private contributions benefiting students and faculty within the UT System. With a vision of being one of the top\-performing advancement organizations in higher education, UTFI is committed to enhancing the educational landscape across the University of Tennessee campuses. **The UT System:** The University of Tennessee System is comprised of campuses at Knoxville, Chattanooga, Pulaski, Martin and the Health Science Center at Memphis; the Institute of Agriculture; and the Institute for Public Service. *The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc. is an EEO/AA/Title VI/Title IX/Section 504/ADA/ADEA employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, and parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law.*

This individual must have strong multitasking abilities to efficiently manage multiple priorities and tasks to ensure successful and accurate results. Must be able to reassess project priorities, perform daily work assignments with minimal supervision, and maintain effective communications with peers, co\-workers, and management. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Provide frontend \& backend support of Syteline ERP application and supporting database level programs through the Infor development toolset and SQL Server Management Studio. * Collaborate with end users, and other programmers to develop new features within the Syteline software. * Assist in projects to upgrade Unverferth Dealer website, and other web\-based applications that interface with the Syteline ERP backend, specifically in the areas of inventory management, order entry, and shipping processes. * Analyze business processes and make recommendations for long\-term software solutions. **Secondary Responsibilities:** * Research and experiment with new technologies and programming environments. * Organize and lead the training of end users on the use of company web and desktop applications. * Work closely with other programmers to develop company coding standards and best practices. * Organize and update system documentation according to company guidelines. **Education Requirements** Applicants are required to possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline, in addition to accumulating 3\-5 years of pertinent work experience. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer\-facing experience. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full\-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi\-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile\-web and full\-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well\-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way. **How you’ll make an impact** * Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend and full\-stack initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long\-term maintenance. * Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture and full\-stack patterns, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness. * Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high\-quality experiences. * Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower\-facing surfaces. * Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience. * Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team. * Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs. * Full\-stack experience designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, or Node.js. * Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business\-critical frontend or full\-stack projects in production. * Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience serving as the frontend or full\-stack technical le Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Ever imagined saying, "I helped launch the future of transportation"? We're rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives \- with no one inside \- powered by our world\-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets. We're live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door\-to\-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you'll feel right at home here. #### **What's happening at Vay** * First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside \& currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World. * We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote\-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy\-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US. * We've completed over 150,000 trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand! * **...And soon we'll be expanding across the US \& Europe** #### ***Why this role is exciting*** At Vay, backend engineering goes far beyond building APIs. We're developing the systems that coordinate vehicles, remote drivers and customers in real time, powering everything from intelligent dispatch and fleet operations to the customer experience. You'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges where reliability, scalability and real\-world impact aren't just engineering principles, they're fundamental to making our service work. As a **Senior Backend Engineer**, you'll have the opportunity to shape the architecture behind a growing mobility platform, take ownership of meaningful technical challenges and see the direct impact of your work on a service operating in the real world. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to push the boundaries of what's possible in mobility, we'd love to have you on board. #### ***What you'll be driving*** * **Design \& Develop:** Build and maintain scalable backend systems that support Vay's growing fleet, customer experience and operational infrastructure, using Go and modern cloud\-native technologies. * **Own End\-to\-End Solutions:** Take ownership of technical solutions from understanding the underlying problem and defining the approach through to implementation, deployment and continuous improvement. * **Shape Technical Architecture:** Influence architectural decisions, evaluate technical trade\-offs and help establish engineering practices that enable our platform to scale reliably. * **Solve Complex Engineering Challenges:** Work at the intersection of software, physical vehicles and operational systems, building reliable solutions to problems that go beyond conventional backend development. * **Drive Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with engineers across infrastructure, embedded software, mobile and product to design solutions that connect our technology and deliver a seamless customer experience. * **Own Quality \& Reliability:** Build maintainable, well\-tested systems, continuously improving performance, reliability and the way we develop and operate our software. #### jobs.title: Technical Trainer (PSP)
jobs.description: **About Veeco** You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud\-based services where all that information lives, to high\-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us. We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting\-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world. We’re looking for material difference\-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers. **OVERVIEW** The Technical Trainer delivers hands\-on and classroom\-based training that prepares customers and internal Field Service Engineers (FSEs) to safely operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and service Veeco Precision Surface Processing (PSP) systems. The Technical Trainer collaborates with engineering, product support, technical publications, and subject matter experts to develop accurate, practical course content aligned with system capabilities and service procedures. This role combines technical expertise, instructional skill, and customer focus to build learner proficiency, improve equipment performance, and support successful system installation, operation, and long\-term service. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Deliver existing Training Material to both third party customer operators and technicians. * Deliver classroom functional descriptions and procedure introduction and overview training to small groups (max 6\) of students * Deliver hands\-on lab training\- demonstrate performance and monitor student accurate completion of operation, maintenance, and service procedures, while providing coaching and validating proficiency through observed procedure performance. * Update existing training content and create scalable learning assets that support instructor\-led, online learning, and other delivery methods. * Update existing training documentation for upgrades and new components related to the PSP systems. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, completion of a vocational or technical program, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a Field Service Engineer supporting the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and service of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. * 5\+ years of relevant experience. * Experience delivering instructor\-led technical training to manufacturing, engineering, or field service audiences. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** * Advanced Field Service knowledge of Veeco Precision Surface Processing (PSP) systems, including system operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and service procedures, with the ability to translate technical expertise into clear, effective classroom and hands\-on training for customers and internal Field Service Engineers. * Skilled at translating complex engineering and manufacturing concepts into clear, actionable learning experiences. * Ability to build credibility and influence across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and quality organizations. * Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications. **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this position is $74,444\.00 — $99,258\.00, plus a bonus opportunity. jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** As a Dist Engr\-AI Engineer within our team of propensity modelers, you will be responsible for the technical execution of Verizon's transition to a modern, agile pod model. You will work directly at the critical touchpoints of the customer lifecycle and high\-impact trigger events, providing the advanced machine learning support needed to unlock deep microsegmentation and hyper\-personalization. Your work will directly empower marketers, optimize customer journeys, and drive down churn across our most critical customer segments. Responsibilities include: * Leading the design, development, and optimization of agentic AI, LLM, and machine learning/deep learning solutions. * Building, training, and deploying our high\-priority propensity models to predict customer behaviors, churn risk, and key lifecycle triggers. * Drive consolidation of overlapping propensity models into a shared customer state and unified models, reducing operational and development cost. * Operating independently to manage end\-to\-end model development pipelines, from advanced feature engineering to production deployment and monitoring. * Serve as a subject matter expert on agentic development, machine learning and predictive modeling, providing technical guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists. * Owning the lifecycle of models deployed in high\-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and measurable business performance. * Presenting complex model insights, performance metrics, and strategic recommendations clearly to senior leadership and cross\-functional business partners. **What we're looking for...** You are a data science professional who thrives on solving complex analytical problems with minimal guidance. You have a proven track record of managing high\-priority machine learning projects, and you excel at collaborating directly with business partners to deliver data\-driven customer experiences that impact the bottom line. **You will need to have:** * Bachelor's degree or six or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Experience working on high\-priority or high\-visibility technical initiatives within a corporate setting. * Experience designing and measuring A/B tests or uplift models for targeting. * Strong expertise and experience in machine learning/deep learning algorithms, including transformer, transfer learning, NLP, expertise in using Pytorch and scikit\-learn packages, as well as probability calibration and time\-based validation. * Experience with Python, R, and SQL for advanced statistical modeling and large\-scale data extraction. * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure) and production MLOps tools for tracking and maintaining model workflows. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Knowledge of LLM agent architecture: Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph, multi\-agent orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation RAG , MCP, A2A protocols, ONNX\-based embeddings, vector databases and semantic search. * Knowledge of cloud\-scale data engineering: Big Query pipelines, GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $137,000\.00 \- $263,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Opportunity** As a **Principal Engineer**, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API\-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross\-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access data—moving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in\-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real\-time APIs. You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high\-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration. **Primary Responsibilities** * Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR\-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services * Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare\-specific optimizations * Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling * Design, build, and maintain public\-facing REST and event\-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider\-facing applications * Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers * Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2\.0, scope\-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access * Design and optimize real\-time or near\-real\-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIs—ensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes * Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs — including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems * Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements * Define and measure clinical impact metrics — adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence * Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems * Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery * Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs * Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high\-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications * Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold\-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements * Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns) * Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction * Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well\-defined and predictable * Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates) * Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms * Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting * Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design * Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, ser ical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data) * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs * Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns * Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR) * Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs * Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement * Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience * Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services) * Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams * Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non\-specialists * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints **Strong Pluses** * Hands\-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments * Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation * Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C\-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3 * Experience designing and operating real\-time or near\-real\-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems * Knowledge of value\-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification * Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns * Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and safe deployment practices * Background supporting provider\-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints * Experience in a healthcare startup or high\-growth healthcare technology environment * Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks * Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems **Perks/Benefits** * Competitive base compensation * Annual bonus potential * Health benefits effective on start date * Health \& Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well\-being available on start date * 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary * Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days * Company paid STD/LTD * Technology setup * Ability to help build a market leader in value\-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization *Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. Any communication received from a Vytalize Health recruiter during your screening, interviewing, or selection process will come from an email ending in @**vytalizehealth.com*

jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider Craft Education as the next step in your career. Our flagship product \- Craft Connect \- helps organizations administer apprentice degree programs and address mission\-critical data and reporting needs. If you’re looking to join the work\-based learning revolution, we’d love to talk with you. At Craft, you’ll have the opportunity to solve hard problems in a high\-growth startup environment and make a lasting impact on the future of education and workforce development. We couldn’t be more excited to advance this work as a team of innovative, collaborative and mission\-oriented professionals \- we hope you’ll consider joining us. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. This role partners closely with software development teams, architects, and infrastructure engineers to build reliable, efficient, and secure platforms that support the technologies serving our students, partners and employees. The ideal candidate is adaptable across tools and platforms, brings deep cloud expertise, and thrives in solving complex technical challenges at scale. enterprise\-grade solutions. * Supervise and contribute to the development, optimization, and deployment of Apache Spark workloads and cloud technologies. * Research, analyze, and solve complex business and technical problems. * Monitor job performance and optimize Spark SQL queries to improve efficiency and system responsiveness. * Build and maintain automation for software deployment, infrastructure provisioning, and operational workflows. * Proactively identify and resolve operational issues before they impact system performance and reliability. * Partner with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to communicate solutions, drive initiatives, and continuously improve reporting, analytics, automation, and production support processes. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or a related field. * 9 years of prior relevant experience. * Expertise with the standard software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile/iterative methodologies. * Expertise implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments. * Experience with highly available and fault\-tolerant enterprise and web\-scale software deployments. * Expertise in infrastructure automation through DevOps scripting (e.g., Shell, Python, Node.js, Ruby, PowerShell). * Strong Linux and Windows systems administration experience in cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or virtualized environments. * Experience leading cloud operations, including monitoring, alerting, notification management, and operational assurance. * Experience scripting and programming in Bash, Java, and Node.js. * Understanding of DevOps, Scrum, and ITIL concepts. * Understanding of virtualization and containerization technologies. * Experience with GitFlow workflows and continuous integration tools such as Jenkins or Travis CI. * Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef and SaltStack. * Experience using monitoring tools such as New Relic, Nagios, CloudWatch, or IPMonitor. * Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders to design cloud infrastructure solutions while evaluating risks, tradeoffs, and best practices. * Ability to lead the design, development, and deployment of business\-critical software and infrastructure at scale. * Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills. * Self\-starter who can work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. * Strong customer service mindset and service\-oriented approach. **Experience in Lieu of Education** ----------------------------------- Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this role may substitute for education requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as one year of experience for one year of education and is at the discretion of the hiring manager. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Strong experience supporting distance education or distance learning environments. * Expertise in at least one modern programming language. * Expertise in cloud cost optimization strategies and serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda. * Experience integrating cloud services with on\-premises technologies from Microsoft, IBM, Oracle, HP, SAP, and similar enterprise platforms. * Expertise with compliance and risk management requirements, including security, PCI, privacy, SOX, and HIPAA. * Strong proficiency with JSON and YAML. Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business\-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements. **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. jobs.title: Network Infrastructure and Security | YAS Networks | Full Time
jobs.description: **Role Summary** YAS Networks is seeking a hands\-on Technical Lead to own engineering delivery and operational quality across customer network and security environments. You will lead engineers and technicians, make sound technical decisions, and remain directly involved in complex troubleshooting, designs, migrations, and production changes. You will coordinate with operations and project management to turn customer requirements into clear engineering plans, assign work, and verify results. The role combines hands\-on engineering with technical leadership across multiple customer environments, with accountability for safe changes, reliable service, and complete documentation. **Key Responsibilities** * Technical ownership: Own technical delivery for assigned customer environments. Prioritize risks and escalations with operations, estimate engineering effort, assign work, and track technical dependencies through completion. Escalate resource constraints and major risks early, with clear options and recommendations. * Team leadership: Delegate work, mentor engineers and technicians, conduct design and configuration reviews, and verify completed work. Establish technical standards, practical runbooks, and backup coverage across the team. * Architecture and implementation: Lead campus, data center, WAN, wireless, and segmentation projects from discovery through handover. Produce designs, migration sequences, implementation plans, service validation criteria, and rollback procedures validated where practical. * Network security: Own firewall policy, NAT, site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPNs, high availability, and network access control. Review security changes for routing, identity, application, and business impacts. * Incident leadership: Lead major network incidents, coordinate engineers and vendor TAC, maintain a timeline, and provide clear customer updates. Restore service safely, document root cause where established, and close corrective actions. * Change quality: Own technical readiness reviews and recommend go or no\-go decisions within the agreed approval process. Confirm peer review, backups, customer approval, rollback readiness, and post\-change validation before closing changes. * Operational improvement: Maintain usable diagrams, inventories, configuration backups, and monitoring. Track certificate expiry, software lifecycle, capacity, and recurring faults; prioritize corrective work and automate repeatable tasks with appropriate safeguards. * Customer collaboration: Lead technical discussions, explain risks and options clearly, and provide timely incident and project updates. Support scopes of work, equipment selections, effort estimates, and assumptions; coordinate scope changes with project management before committing work. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience, including proven technical leadership of engineers and delivery of production projects or managed services. * Strong Cisco Catalyst and Nexus skills, including OSPF, BGP, VLANs, VRFs, STP, LACP, first\-hop redundancy, and resilient campus and data center designs. * Production experience with Cisco Secure Firewall FTD and FMC or cloud\-delivered management: access policies, NAT order, VPNs, HA, upgrades, packet captures, and fault isolation. * Working knowledge of enterprise wireless and network access control, including 802\.1X, RADIUS, certificate\-based authentication, and guest access. Ability to troubleshoot these services and coordinate with specialist engineers when needed. * Ability to trace an application path across DNS, DHCP relay, switching, routing, firewalls, NAT, and VPNs using packet captures, logs, counters, and structured testing. * Evidence of leading complex migrations and incidents, delegating effectively, reviewing other engineers’ work, and communicating clearly with technical teams and customer leadership. * Experience using network monitoring and logs to investigate service health, alongside strong documentation and change management habits. Ability to assess unfamiliar environments and prioritize remediation based on evidence and business impact. * Ability to support scheduled maintenance windows, participate in an agreed escalation rotation, and attend customer sites as required. **Preferred Qualifications** * CCNP Enterprise or Security, CCIE, or comparable demonstrated technical depth. Certifications strengthen an application but do not replace practical experience. * Deeper experience with Cisco ISE, Catalyst 9800 wireless, SD\-Access, LISP, Catalyst Center, TrustSec, SD\-WAN, or migrations from legacy wireless platforms. * Azure networking and hybrid connectivity; Nexus vPC or VXLAN/EVPN; and experience coordinating network dependencies with server, virtualization, storage, and cabling teams. * MSP, higher education, healthcare, or other environments with strict availability requirements and multiple stakeholders. * Python or Ansible automation, configuration management, and log analysis or SIEM tools such as Splunk. Experience with additional firewall vendors is also valuable. **What Success Looks Like** First 30 days: Assess assigned environments, meet customer and delivery teams, validate critical documentation and access, and establish a prioritized risk register and clear ownership. By 60 days: Lead engineering assignments and escalations for the agreed portfolio; apply consistent peer reviews, change plans, and handovers; and complete initial priority improvements. By 90 days: Demonstrate reliable delivery and team coverage, maintain current documentation, and report measurable progress against agreed baselines for change success, recurring incidents, corrective actions, and project acceptance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I / II — AWS & .NET
jobs.description: **Summary** The Software Engineer builds and maintains Shopify\-based solutions supporting Young Living’s global member and customer experience across more than 30 markets, processing over 6 million orders and $800 million in annual transaction volume. This role contributes to storefront functionality, custom applications, APIs, and backend integrations using Shopify, JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, and AWS. Software Engineer II is the primary hiring target. Candidates demonstrating strong foundational skills and development potential may be considered at Software Engineer I, with responsibilities and expectations aligned to their experience and capabilities. Software Engineer I works under close supervision to complete assigned development tasks, contribute to established solutions, and develop technical proficiency. Software Engineer II independently completes development work, leads smaller projects, participates in peer code reviews, mentors less\-experienced engineers, and supports production systems. Agentic coding tools are the primary development workflow. Engineers are expected to use these tools from the start of employment, with guidance appropriate to their level, and remain accountable for the quality, security, and accuracy of their submitted work. Preference is given to candidates residing in Utah. Exceptional out\-of\-state candidates willing to relocate at their own expense may be considered. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not provided. **Essential Functions** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of Shopify custom applications, including embedded applications using React and Shopify App Bridge. * Work with Shopify Admin API, Storefront API, Webhooks, and GraphQL to support commerce functionality and extend platform capabilities. * Develop and maintain APIs and integrations connecting Shopify with internal and third\-party platforms, including order management, supply chain, and logistics systems. * Develop frontend and backend components using JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, and C\#/.NET. * Contribute to backend services and integrations running on AWS, including solutions using Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and DynamoDB. * Write clean, testable, well\-documented code and participate in peer code reviews appropriate to the position’s level. * Use agentic coding tools to support development, including effective prompting, context management, and determining when manual development is appropriate. * Review and test AI\-generated changes to verify functionality, security, and alignment with team standards before submission. * Support troubleshooting, production issue resolution, root\-cause analysis, and ongoing system improvements. Occasionally provide support outside regular business hours, including evenings and weekends, to respond to critical Priority 1 (P1\) production incidents. These situations are expected to be infrequent, with support responsibilities appropriate to the employee’s level. * Collaborate with engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and contribute to technical solutions. * Participate in Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, task estimation, standups, retrospectives, and demonstrations. * Support quality assurance and user acceptance testing to verify that solutions meet acceptance criteria before release. * Assist with Shopify configuration and deployment across Young Living’s global storefronts. * Maintain documentation of technical decisions, integration maps, and operational runbooks. * Follow established practices for security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Continue developing technical skills and learning emerging technologies as directed by senior IT leadership. * **Software Engineer I:** Complete assigned, well\-defined development tasks under close supervision, contribute to established designs, and incorporate feedback from senior engineers. * **Software Engineer II:** Independently design, develop, and deliver frontend, backend, and integration solutions within established architecture and team standards. Evaluate technical approaches, understand cross\-system dependencies and downstream impacts, and serve as the lead developer on smaller projects. * **Software Engineer II:** Mentor Software Engineer I team members, conduct peer code reviews, and guide effective use of agentic development tools. * **Software Engineer II:** Participate in the on\-call rotation and production incident response. **Skills \& Qualifications** * Effective communication, collaboration, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work with technical and business teams and follow established development and security standards. * Ability to use agentic coding tools responsibly and review and test generated code. * Willingness to learn the team’s techno  including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript. * Introductory knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Ability to complete assigned coding, testing, and debugging tasks with guidance. * Willingness to learn Shopify, React, backend API development, AWS services, and agentic coding workflows through supervised work and mentorship. **Software Engineer II** * Production development proficiency in C\#/.NET. * Full\-stack development skills involving React and backend API development using Node.js or .NET. * Familiarity with REST and/or GraphQL APIs. * Hands\-on production experience with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, AWS CDK, or API Gateway. Certification alone or Azure\-only experience does not meet this requirement. * Daily professional use of agentic coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, to deliver production code. * Solid understanding of the Agile development lifecycle. * Ability to independently deliver assigned development work, review code, troubleshoot production issues, and mentor less\-experienced engineers. The team’s technology environment includes: * **Commerce:** Shopify, Shopify Plus, Admin and Storefront APIs, Webhooks, App Bridge, Liquid, and multi\-market storefronts. * **Frontend:** React, JavaScript ES6\+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Alpine.js on select storefronts. * **Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, and C\#/.NET. * **Cloud:** AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and AWS CDK. * **Data and ERP:** JD Edwards EnterpriseOne 9\.2, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL. * **Development tools:** Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Jira. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Hands\-on Shopify development experience involving custom applications, Admin API, Storefront API, Webhooks, App Bridge, and OAuth. * Experience with Shopify Liquid, theme customization, Shopify Plus, or multi\-store and multi\-market environments. * Experience with or exposure to JD Edwards EnterpriseOne 9\.2 integrations, including APIs, Orchestrator, or business functions. * Experience supporting supply chain or order management processes. * Experience in direct selling or network marketing environments, including Exigo or other MLM platform integrations. * Experience using AWS CDK for infrastructure as code. * Experience with headless or composable commerce, event\-driven architecture, or microservices. * Experience deploying agentic AI tools or workflows to production, including MCP servers, AI agents, prompt\-engineered workflows, or Claude Code skills. * Experience with theme performance tools and measures, including Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals. * **Software Engineer I:** Internship, project, or relevant employment experience in software development; exposure to Agile methodologies, Jira, and version control. * **Software Engineer II:** Experience participating in production systems on\-call rotations. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. A combination of education and relevant experience may meet this requirement. * **Software Engineer I:** Demonstrated foundational software development ability through relevant education, internships, projects, or employment. Prior production experience with every technology listed is not required. * **Software Engineer II:** Three to five years of production C\#/.NET development experience, extending beyond coursework, personal projects, or QA/test automation. * **Software Engineer II:** Hands\-on production AWS experience and full\-stack development experience using React and Node.js or .NET. * **Software Engineer II:** Daily professional experience using agentic coding tools to deliver production code. * Current authorization to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Employer visa sponsorship is not available for this position. * Utah residency or willingness to relocate to Utah at the candidate’s own expense.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer, Agentic Chat
jobs.description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. You'll make things happen–fast. Principal Product Designer, Agentic Chat You'll lead the design of how people experience agents inside GTM One, ZoomInfo's unified go\-to\-market platform for sellers, marketers, and revenue teams. In agentic chat, the agent's behavior is the experience, and you own that experience end to end: how it acts, how it asks, what it costs, and how it proves itself before a customer finds out otherwise. This is a Principal seat defined by surface ownership, not feature delivery — you'll set direction for agent experience across every way a customer reaches an agent, and you'll be expected to bring proposals forward rather than wait for a brief. You will: * Own the agent experience across universal chat, including how the agent communicates status, asks for input, and reports back on long\-running work. * Design the interactions that let agents create artifacts, apps, and automations built on context, and define how those outputs show up to the customer. * Build cost estimation and credit\-approval moments into chat, so customers understand what an agent action costs before and after it runs. * Establish evals as a design instrument, using evaluation results to prove an experience is ready before launch and to guide what changes after real users touch it. * Design the trust mechanics that let customers calibrate confidence in agent output, including how failure, uncertainty, and partial results are shown. * Prototype in code, open pull requests, and ship working proposals directly into the codebase alongside engineering. * Partner with product management and engineering on orchestration and tool infrastructure while owning what the customer actually experiences of it. * Define problems alongside solutions, operating with thin briefs and acting as a product thinker on your surface area. What You Bring Must\-Have: * At least 2 years designing AI or agentic products where the model's behavior was the product itself (not AI features layered onto a conventional surface), and you can speak candidly to what went wrong in front of real users. * Experience running evals: you have built or used an evaluation setup for an agent, and you can explain how you knew it was ready before launch and what changed after real users touched it. * A track record of shipping in code: you prototype with AI coding tools (not only in Figma), you open pull requests, and you can read a backend contract, even if you are not an engineer by title. * A working understanding of how LLMs behave in production, including latency, streaming, tool calling, confidence, and failure modes, and you design for those honestly rather than defaulting to the happy path. * Experience working directly with engineering in their channels and on their timelines, as a core part of how you ship. Preferred: * Domain depth designing for sellers, marketers, RevOps, or CS inside a CRM, sales\-engagement, data, or revenue\-intelligence product. * Experience with enterprise complexity, data\-dense interfaces, bulk operations, or long\-running jobs without losing clarity for the end user. * Experience designing for a product where usage directly costs the customer money. * Comfort blending UX research with agentic design — using research to predict and evals to confirm. How We Evaluate You'll be assessed across four axes, shared with you in advance: context engineering and agentic systems (including eval experience); the blend of UX research and agentic design; aesthetic quality and experience craft; and engineering fundamentals. No one is expected to score highest on all four — we want to know where you'd place yourself so we know how to work together. Interviews include walking through a real agent\-surface decision (including an argument you lost), an eval you ran and what it changed, a live conversation about a go\-to\-market workflow, a working session on an open problem, and a look at your own tooling. No spec work, no unpaid take\-home, and no design challenge we'd actually ship. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-ST2 **About us:** ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go\-To\-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI\-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller. ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information. ZoomInfo may use a software\-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here. ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - 3D Sensor Simulation
jobs.description: The Zoox 3D Sensor Simulation team’s work is at the core of creating in\-the\-loop simulation and high fidelity synthetic data for training and testing autonomous vehicle AI. We are looking for a machine learning professional with experience applying ML to sensor data, such as LiDAR, radar, and cameras. This role lies at the intersection of machine learning and 3D simulation at Zoox, ranging from learned sensor models to neural 3D reconstruction. By improving the realism of simulated sensors (lidar, radar, and cameras), you’ll enable the Zoox robotics autonomy stack to learn, improve, and enhance the mobility of humans. ### **In this role, you will:** * Design, train, and validate ML models that improve the realism of simulated lidar, radar, and camera data in autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation pipelines. * Collaborate with Synthetic Data and HIL Sim teams to integrate 3DGS and NeRF\-based 3D reconstruction with simulation of all sensor modalities. * Build and curate training datasets from real and simulated sensor data, including GenAI\-based data augmentation. * Partner with Sim V\&V and Perception engineers to define sensor realism metrics and close the sim\-to\-real gaps with the greatest impact on autonomy. * Mentor engineers and interns, and establish best practices for training and deploying ML on Zoox sensor data. ### **Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of experience developing ML models in Python with PyTorch or TensorFlow * Industry experience applying ML to sensor data (lidar, radar, and/or cameras) * Solid understanding of customizing, tuning, and validating ML training pipelines ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience with generative techniques such as diffusion, flow matching, or VAEs * Experience with 3D reconstruction (3DGS, NeRFs) or differentiable rendering * Prior experience developing autonomy in AVs or other robotics and computer vision **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. jobs.title: Senior AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role:** AutoStore is transforming how we operate, serve customers and partners, and scale our commercial organization. We are looking for a Senior AI \& Automation Engineer to build and deploy intelligent solutions that fundamentally improve how work gets done. Your first proving ground will be Sales Support, a global operation with rich data, complex workflows and significant opportunities for AI and automation. From there, the capabilities you build will expand across the broader Commercial organization. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can move from **business problem prototype production measurable impact.** **You won't simply automate existing processes. You'll help us rethink them.** **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** You will design AI\-powered capabilities combining agentic AI, automation, enterprise data and workflow orchestration, including: * AI agents that understand requests, retrieve knowledge, reason across business rules and recommend or take actions * Intelligent case intake, classification, routing and prioritization * Automated order and PO quality validation * Knowledge and support agents grounded in enterprise data and documentation * AI\-assisted exception handling and next\-best actions * Pattern recognition across operational data to identify recurring issues and opportunities * Intelligent self\-service experiences for employees, partners and customers * **The goal is simple: less manual work, better decisions, faster execution and better customer and partner experiences.** **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **Build Agentic AI —** Design, prototype and productionize AI agents and intelligent workflows using LLMs, RAG, tool use, orchestration and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * **Find the Right Problems —** Work directly with business teams and operational data to identify friction, repetitive work, rework and high\-value opportunities. Challenge unnecessary complexity before automating it. * **Turn Data Into Intelligence —** Use historical and real\-time data to uncover patterns and create reusable intelligence for classification, recommendations, knowledge retrieval and decision support. * **Engineer for Production —** Move beyond demos. Build secure, scalable and observable solutions with strong practices around APIs, integrations, testing, evaluation, monitoring and governance. * **Deliver Measurable Impact —** Measure success through outcomes such as cycle time, quality, manual touches, self\-service, adoption and capacity created. * **Scale Across Commercial —** Take successful capabilities beyond Sales Support into sales productivity, partner and customer experience, revenue and account intelligence, and digital commercial experiences such as AutoStore Sphere. **Key Qualifications:** We care more about what you can build and how you think than matching every technology on a checklist. * Strong software engineering skills, particularly Python and modern APIs * Experience building applications using LLMs, generative AI or agentic AI * Experience with RAG, enterprise search, tool/function calling or agent orchestration * Strong understanding of data, workflow automation and systems integration * Experience taking AI solutions from prototype to production * Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, security and responsible AI * Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable solutions * Curiosity, ownership and a strong bias toward action Experience with Azure, Databricks, Salesforce, SAP, GitHub or modern AI development frameworks is valuable, but the ability to learn, connect systems and ship matters more than any specific technology. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description: **About Campfire** Campfire is a next\-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid\-market finance teams. We’re building the future of ERP by replacing outdated systems and manual accounting processes with an AI\-native platform that helps finance teams move faster and operate more efficiently. **The role** Campfire is hiring its first full\-time CISO to own security, compliance and customer trust as we sell to larger enterprises. * Campfire is an AI\-native ERP and financial automation platform. We raised a $65M Series B led by Accel and Ribbit Capital. * Customers trust us with their general ledger, bank details, payroll and vendor data. * Today, security is run by a fractional vCISO firm plus a few engineers. Deals are increasingly gated on security reviews. * You will turn that into an in\-house program that closes deals faster and keeps us safe. **What you'll own** ------------------- **Customer security reviews and deal support** * Answer security questionnaires, TPRMs and RFPs (SIG, CAIQ, custom) with a fast, predictable turnaround. * Join customer and prospect calls with CIOs and IT security teams, including implementation kickoffs. * Maintain a trust center and security collateral pack: policies, pentest reports, network architecture, insurance certificate. **Compliance and audits** * Own SOC 1 and SOC 2 (Type I and II): scope, auditor management, bridge letters, and customer follow\-up questions. * Decide and lead the path to ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and other frameworks customers ask about. * Run Vanta as the system of record for controls and evidence. **Privacy and contracts** * Partner with Legal on DPAs, BAAs, GDPR transfer mechanisms (SCCs / DPF), DORA and non\-US privacy laws. * Review security and audit\-cooperation clauses in customer contracts. * Own data retention, export and residency answers, including new\-region or GovCloud requests. **Security operations and incident response** * Own the incident response plan, run tabletop tests, and lead response when incidents happen. * Own customer breach notification decisions and post\-incident write\-ups. * Own detection and email security: SIEM, EDR, email protection, identity alerting. **Identity and access** * Own Okta (SSO, phishing\-resistant MFA, SCIM), MDM and least\-privilege access to production. * Support customer\-facing SSO/SCIM setups. **Resilience and policy** * Own BCDR plans, RTO/RPO targets, backup and restore testing. * Maintain information security, responsible AI and vendor management policies. * Run background and sanctions screening for employees and vendors. **AI security** * Answer customer questions on our AI assistant: underlying models, prompt and response retention, logging, and opt\-out. * Govern AI vendors and subprocessors. **First 90 days** ----------------- * Take over customer security reviews from the vCISO firm and set a clear intake and turnaround process for Sales. * Finish the Vanta migration and publish a trust center with standard collateral. * Finalize and test the BCDR and incident response plans. * Close out post\-incident hardening: email security, Okta alerting, MDM and EDR coverage. * Present a 12\-month security and certification roadmap to the CTO. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 10\+ years in security, with 3\+ leading a program at a B2B SaaS company. * Has owned SOC 1 / SOC 2 audits end to end. ISO 27001 experience a plus. * Comfortable on calls with enterprise CIOs and auditors, and enjoys helping close deals. * Hands\-on with AWS, Okta, Google Workspace, EDR and SIEM tooling. * Working knowledge of GDPR, DPAs and contract security terms. * Has led real incident response, including customer communication. * Fintech, ERP or accounting software background a strong plus. * Pragmatic builder: starts as a team of one, hires as we grow. **Reporting and logistics** --------------------------- * Reports to the CEO. Works closely with Sales, Legal and Engineering. * Location: Bay Area preferred.
